The dimension does not depend on the choice of basis. Any two bases of $V$ are maximal independent subsets of $V$, so by the preceding node they contain the same number of vectors, namely $r(V)$. Thus $\dim V$ is an invariant of $V$ itself; apart from the zero subspace, $V$ has infinitely many bases. Here $V$ must be a subspace: a line or plane not passing through the origin is not closed under addition and does not contain the zero vector, so it has no linear structure of this kind.

There are several standard criteria for a basis. Let $\dim V=r$, and recall two basic facts: any linearly independent set in $V$ has at most $r$ vectors, and any spanning set has at least $r$ vectors (otherwise extension or deletion would produce a basis contradicting the definition of dimension). (i) Any $r$ linearly independent vectors in $V$ form a basis: they span an $r$-dimensional subspace $U\subseteq V$; if $U\ne V$, choose $\alpha\in V\setminus U$, and the $r$ vectors together with $\alpha$ are still independent, giving $r+1$ independent vectors in $V$, contradicting the first fact. (ii) Any $r$ vectors in $V$ that span $V$ form a basis: if they were dependent, deleting a redundant vector would leave a spanning set with fewer than $r$ vectors, contradicting the second fact. (iii) An independent set can be extended to a basis, and a spanning set can be trimmed to a basis.

In the $r$-dimensional subspace $V$ fix an old basis $\varepsilon_1,\dots,\varepsilon_r$ and a new basis $\varepsilon'_1,\dots,\varepsilon'_r$, and write
$$(\varepsilon'_1,\dots,\varepsilon'_r)=(\varepsilon_1,\dots,\varepsilon_r)P,\qquad P=(p_{ij}),$$
so $\varepsilon'_j=\sum_i p_{ij}\varepsilon_i$: the $j$-th column of $P$ holds the coordinates of the new basis vector in the old basis. If $\alpha=\sum_j x'_j\varepsilon'_j$, substitution gives
$$\alpha=\sum_i\left(\sum_j p_{ij}x'_j\right)\varepsilon_i=\sum_i(P\boldsymbol{x}')_i\varepsilon_i.$$
By uniqueness of old coordinates, $\boldsymbol{x}=P\boldsymbol{x}'$, hence $\boldsymbol{x}'=P^{-1}\boldsymbol{x}$. The matrix $P$ is invertible because the new basis is independent. The direction is easy to reverse by mistake: the columns of $P$ are the new basis vectors in the old basis, not the old ones in the new basis.

Example: in $\mathbb{R}^2$ take the basis $\varepsilon_1=(1,2)^{\mathrm T}$, $\varepsilon_2=(2,5)^{\mathrm T}$ and find the coordinates of $\beta=(4,9)^{\mathrm T}$. Writing $\beta=x\varepsilon_1+y\varepsilon_2$ gives $x+2y=4$, $2x+5y=9$, hence $y=1,x=2$ and coordinates $(2,1)^{\mathrm T}$. Check with the change-of-basis formula: $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&5\end{pmatrix}$, $\det P=1$, $P^{-1}=\begin{pmatrix}5&-2\\-2&1\end{pmatrix}$, so $\boldsymbol{x}'=P^{-1}(4,9)^{\mathrm T}=(2,1)^{\mathrm T}$. The same vector has standard coordinates $(4,9)^{\mathrm T}$ and new coordinates $(2,1)^{\mathrm T}$: the vector is unchanged, its coordinates change with the basis.

formulas.note: ℝⁿ 的标准基是 e₁,…,e_n：它们线性无关，且每个向量 (x₁,…,x_n)ᵀ 都等于 x₁e₁+⋯+x_ne_n。
formulas.noteEn: The standard basis of ℝⁿ consists of e₁,…,e_n: independent, and (x₁,…,x_n)ᵀ = x₁e₁+⋯+x_ne_n.

formulas.note: 向量在给定基下的展开式；系数 (x₁,…,x_r)ᵀ 是 α 在该基下的坐标，并且唯一。
formulas.noteEn: Expansion of a vector in a given basis; the coefficients are the coordinates of α and are unique.

formulas.note: 由一组向量张成的空间，其维数等于这组向量的秩；它们的任一最大无关组就是该空间的一组基。
formulas.noteEn: The dimension of a span equals the rank of the spanning vectors; any maximal independent subset of them is a basis.

formulas.latex: \dim V=r\ \Longrightarrow\ V\ \text{中任意}\ r\ \text{个线性无关的向量都构成一组基}
formulas.note: 特别地，ℝⁿ 中任意 n 个线性无关的向量都是 ℝⁿ 的基；少于 n 个向量只能张成更小的子空间。
formulas.noteEn: In particular, any n linearly independent vectors in ℝⁿ form a basis of ℝⁿ; fewer than n vectors span a proper subspace.

properties: 基不唯一、维数唯一：同一个非零向量空间（$\dim V\ge1$）可以有无穷多组基（唯一例外是零空间 $\{\boldsymbol{0}\}$：它只有空集这一组基），但任意两组基含向量个数相同，都等于 dim V，并且互相等价。
ℝⁿ 中任意 n 个线性无关的向量都是 ℝⁿ 的一组基；多于 n 个向量必线性相关，不可能成为基。
给定一组基后，每个向量的坐标唯一；同一个向量在不同基下的坐标一般不同（坐标如何随基变化是换基问题）。
过原点的直线是一维子空间（基可取直线上任一非零向量），过原点的平面是二维子空间（基可取平面上任意两个不共线的向量）；不含原点的直线、平面不是子空间。
若 V=span{α₁,…,α_s}，则 α₁,…,α_s 中任一最大无关组都是 V 的基，dim V=r(α₁,…,α_s)；反过来，V 的任何一组基都能张成 V。
propertiesEn: Bases are not unique but the dimension is: a vector space has infinitely many bases, yet any two contain the same number of vectors, equal to dim V, and are mutually equivalent.
Any n linearly independent vectors in ℝⁿ form a basis of ℝⁿ; more than n vectors are always dependent and can never be a basis.
Relative to a fixed basis every vector has unique coordinates; the same vector generally has different coordinates in different bases (how coordinates change is the change-of-basis problem).

A line through the origin is a 1-dimensional subspace (take any nonzero vector on it as a basis), and a plane through the origin is 2-dimensional (take any two non-collinear vectors). Lines and planes not through the origin are not subspaces.
If V=span{α₁,…,α_s}, then any maximal independent subset of α₁,…,α_s is a basis of V and dim V=r(α₁,…,α_s); conversely any basis of V spans V.

examples.problem: 验证 {(1,2)ᵀ,(2,5)ᵀ} 是 ℝ² 的一组基，并求 v=(4,9)ᵀ 在这组基下的坐标。
examples.solution:
两向量不成比例：$\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\2&5\end{vmatrix}=5-4=1\ne0$，故线性无关；而 $\dim\mathbb{R}^2=2$，ℝ² 中 2 个线性无关的向量自动构成一组基。设 $v=x(1,2)^{\mathrm T}+y(2,5)^{\mathrm T}$，即
$$\begin{cases}x+2y=4,\\ 2x+5y=9,\end{cases}$$
解得 $y=1$、$x=2$。验算：2(1,2)+(2,5)=(4,9) ✓。所以 v 在这组基下的**坐标为 (2,1)ᵀ**——注意它与 v 在标准基下的坐标 (4,9)ᵀ 不同，同一个向量换一组基坐标就变了。

examples.problem: 设 V=span{α₁,α₂,α₃}，其中 α₁=(1,1,0)ᵀ，α₂=(0,1,1)ᵀ，α₃=(1,2,1)ᵀ，求 dim V 与 V 的一组基。
examples.solution:
注意 $\alpha_3=(1,2,1)^{\mathrm T}=\alpha_1+\alpha_2$（验算：(1,1,0)+(0,1,1)=(1,2,1) ✓），所以 α₃ 可由 α₁,α₂ 线性表示，整组的秩不超过 2；而 α₁,α₂ 不成比例、线性无关，故 $r(\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3)=2$，于是
$$\dim V=r(\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3)=2,$$
$\{\alpha_1,\alpha_2\}$ 是 V 的一组基（$\{\alpha_1,\alpha_3\}$、$\{\alpha_2,\alpha_3\}$ 也都是）。这正说明：基不唯一，维数唯一。

homogeneous-solutions.definition:
形如 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$（右边常数项全为零）的方程组称为**齐次线性方程组**，其中 $A$ 是 $m\times n$ 矩阵，$\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$。它永远有解：$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 总是解，称为**零解**；如果还有别的解，那些解称为**非零解**。有没有非零解只看秩：**有非零解 ⟺ r(A)<n**（$n$ 是未知数个数）；当 $r(A)=n$ 时只有零解。
齐次方程组最漂亮的地方是解集的形状。若 $\boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{y}$ 都是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 的解，则 $\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y}$ 也是解、$k\boldsymbol{x}$ 也是解（因为 $A(\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y})=A\boldsymbol{x}+A\boldsymbol{y}=\boldsymbol{0}$，$A(k\boldsymbol{x})=kA\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$）。也就是说**解集对加法与数乘封闭**，是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的一个子空间，称为**解空间**，记作 $N(A)$。设 $r(A)=r$，则
$$\dim N(A)=n-r.$$
直观地说：未知数有 $n$ 个，独立的方程只有 $r$ 条，剩下的 $n-r$ 个变量可以自由取值——维数正好是自由度的个数；行化简后，非主元列的个数（自由变量个数）就是这个 $n-r$。
取解空间 $N(A)$ 的一组基 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$，称为方程组的一个**基础解系**：它们是 $n-r$ 个线性无关的解，且方程组的每一个解都能由它们线性表示。于是方程组的**通解**为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_1,\dots,k_{n-r}\in\mathbb{R},$$
其中 $k_i$ 是任意常数。基础解系不唯一（解空间的任何一组基都可以），但它含的向量个数 $n-r$ 是唯一确定的。
homogeneous-solutions.definitionEn:
A system of the form $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ (all constant terms zero) is a **homogeneous linear system**, where $A$ is an $m\times n$ matrix and $\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$. It is always consistent: $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$, the **zero solution**, always works; any other solution is called a **nonzero solution**. Whether nonzero solutions exist depends only on the rank: **there is a nonzero solution iff $r(A)<n$** ($n$ = number of unknowns); if $r(A)=n$ the zero solution is the only one.
The beauty of homogeneous systems lies in the shape of the solution set. If $\boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{y}$ solve $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$, then so do $\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y}$ and $k\boldsymbol{x}$, since $A(\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y})=A\boldsymbol{x}+A\boldsymbol{y}=\boldsymbol{0}$ and $A(k\boldsymbol{x})=kA\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$. The solution set is thus **closed under addition and scalar multiplication**: a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^n$, called the **solution space** (or null space) $N(A)$. If $r(A)=r$, then $\dim N(A)=n-r$. Intuitively: there are $n$ unknowns but only $r$ independent equations, leaving $n-r$ free variables — precisely the number of degrees of freedom, and also the number of non-pivot columns after row reduction.
Choosing a basis $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ of $N(A)$ gives a **fundamental system of solutions**: $n-r$ linearly independent solutions in terms of which every solution can be expressed. The **general solution** is then
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_1,\dots,k_{n-r}\in\mathbb{R},$$
with arbitrary constants $k_i$. A fundamental system is not unique — any basis of the solution space will do — but the number of vectors in it, $n-r$, is uniquely determined.
derivation: 设 $A$ 为 $m\times n$ 实矩阵，齐次方程组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 的未知向量 $\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$。$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 永远是解。若 $A\boldsymbol{x}_1=\boldsymbol{0}$、$A\boldsymbol{x}_2=\boldsymbol{0}$，则 $A(\boldsymbol{x}_1+\boldsymbol{x}_2)=\boldsymbol{0}$、$A(k\boldsymbol{x}_1)=kA\boldsymbol{x}_1=\boldsymbol{0}$，所以解集对加法与数乘封闭；它非空且含零向量，从而是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的子空间，称为解空间或零空间 $N(A)$。

解空间的大小由秩决定。把 $A$ 行化简为行最简形，设 $r(A)=r$，则有 $r$ 个主元列、$n-r$ 个非主元列。主元对应的变量由自由变量唯一表示；令某个自由变量为 1、其余自由变量为 0，就得到一个非零解。因此 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 有非零解 $\iff n-r>0\iff r(A)<n$；当 $r(A)=n$ 时没有自由变量，只有零解。特别地，$m<n$ 时 $r(A)\le m<n$，必有非零解。

进一步，$\dim N(A)=n-r(A)$，而且可以显式写出基。对每个自由变量 $x_{f_j}$，令它等于 1、其余自由变量等于 0，解出主变量，得到解 $\eta_j$（$j=1,\dots,n-r$）。这 $n-r$ 个解线性无关：若 $\sum k_j\eta_j=\boldsymbol{0}$，只看自由坐标就得到 $k_j=0$。它们也张成 $N(A)$：任取解 $\boldsymbol{x}$，减去 $\sum x_{f_j}\eta_j$ 后所有自由坐标为零，而主变量又被自由变量唯一决定，故差向量为零。因此 $\{\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}\}$ 是 $N(A)$ 的一组基。

取 $N(A)$ 的一组基 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$，称为齐次方程组的一个基础解系：它们是 $n-r$ 个线性无关的解，且每个解都能由它们线性表示。通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_1,\dots,k_{n-r}\in\mathbb{R}.$$
由于基线性无关，给定解的系数还是唯一的。基础解系不唯一（解空间的任何一组基都可以），但所含向量个数 $n-r(A)$ 唯一确定；$r(A)=n$ 时基础解系为空，通解只有 $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$。

从矩阵语言看，$N(A)$ 的维数就是 $A$ 的零化度，$r(A)+\dim N(A)=n$。若 $A$ 的列向量为 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n$，则 $\boldsymbol{x}\in N(A)$ 正好给出列向量之间的一组线性关系 $\sum x_i\alpha_i=\boldsymbol{0}$；因此列向量线性相关 $\iff N(A)\ne\{\boldsymbol{0}\}\iff r(A)<n$。这也说明：齐次方程的非零解、列向量组的线性相关、秩小于列数，是同一事实的三种表述。
derivationEn: Let $A$ be an $m\times n$ real matrix and consider $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ with $\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$. The zero vector is always a solution. If $A\boldsymbol{x}_1=\boldsymbol{0}$ and $A\boldsymbol{x}_2=\boldsymbol{0}$, then $A(\boldsymbol{x}_1+\boldsymbol{x}_2)=\boldsymbol{0}$ and $A(k\boldsymbol{x}_1)=kA\boldsymbol{x}_1=\boldsymbol{0}$, so the solution set is closed under addition and scalar multiplication. It is nonempty and contains the zero vector, hence is a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^n$, called the solution space or null space $N(A)$.

The size of the solution space is controlled by the rank. Reduce $A$ to reduced row echelon form and let $r(A)=r$; there are $r$ pivot columns and $n-r$ non-pivot columns. Each pivot variable is uniquely determined by the free variables; setting one free variable to 1 and the others to 0 produces a nonzero solution. Therefore $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ has a nonzero solution iff $n-r>0$ iff $r(A)<n$; if $r(A)=n$ there are no free variables and only the zero solution. In particular, when $m<n$ we have $r(A)\le m<n$, so a nonzero solution must exist.

Moreover $\dim N(A)=n-r(A)$, and a basis can be written explicitly. For each free variable $x_{f_j}$, set it equal to 1 and the other free variables to 0, then solve for the pivot variables; this gives a solution $\eta_j$ ($j=1,\dots,n-r$). These $n-r$ solutions are independent: if $\sum k_j\eta_j=\boldsymbol{0}$, looking only at the free coordinates yields $k_j=0$. They span $N(A)$: given any solution $\boldsymbol{x}$, subtract $\sum x_{f_j}\eta_j$; the difference has all free coordinates zero, and since the pivot variables are uniquely determined by the free ones, the difference is zero. Hence $\{\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}\}$ is a basis of $N(A)$.

A basis $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ of $N(A)$ is called a fundamental system of solutions of the homogeneous system: it consists of $n-r$ independent solutions, and every solution is a linear combination of them. The general solution is
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_1,\dots,k_{n-r}\in\mathbb{R}.$$
Because the basis is independent, the coefficients of a given solution are unique. A fundamental system is not unique (any basis of the solution space qualifies), but the number of vectors, $n-r(A)$, is uniquely determined; when $r(A)=n$ the fundamental system is empty and the only solution is $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$.

Example: solve $x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4=0$, $x_1+2x_2+3x_3+4x_4=0$. Row reduction of the coefficient matrix gives
$$\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&4\end{pmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{pmatrix}1&0&-1&-2\\0&1&2&3\end{pmatrix},$$
so $r(A)=2$ and $\dim N(A)=4-2=2$. The pivot variables satisfy $x_1=x_3+2x_4$ and $x_2=-2x_3-3x_4$. Setting $(x_3,x_4)=(1,0)$ gives $\eta_1=(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T}$; setting $(0,1)$ gives $\eta_2=(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$. The general solution is $\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+k_2\eta_2$.

In matrix language, $\dim N(A)$ is the nullity of $A$ and $r(A)+\dim N(A)=n$. If the columns of $A$ are $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n$, then each $\boldsymbol{x}\in N(A)$ is exactly a linear relation $\sum x_i\alpha_i=\boldsymbol{0}$ among the columns; hence the columns are dependent iff $N(A)\ne\{\boldsymbol{0}\}$ iff $r(A)<n$. Thus a nonzero solution of the homogeneous system, linear dependence of the columns, and rank less than the number of columns are three descriptions of one and the same fact.

formulas.note: n 是未知数个数；等价地，方程个数少于未知数个数（m<n）时必有非零解。
formulas.noteEn: n is the number of unknowns; equivalently, fewer equations than unknowns (m<n) always forces a nonzero solution.

formulas.note: 解空间（齐次方程组全部解的集合）的维数等于未知数个数减去系数矩阵的秩，即自由变量的个数。
formulas.noteEn: The dimension of the solution space equals the number of unknowns minus the rank, i.e. the number of free variables.

formulas.note: 齐次方程组的通解：基础解系 η₁,…,η_{n−r} 的任意线性组合，k_i 为任意常数。
formulas.noteEn: General solution of the homogeneous system: arbitrary linear combinations of a fundamental system η₁,…,η_{n−r}, with arbitrary constants k_i.

formulas.note: 解集对加法与数乘封闭——这正是它能成为向量空间、能谈「基」的原因。
formulas.noteEn: The solution set is closed under addition and scalar multiplication — the reason it is a vector space admitting a basis.

properties: 齐次方程组必有零解；只有零解 ⟺ r(A)=n；有非零解（因而有无穷多解）⟺ r(A)<n。
方程个数少于未知数个数时（m<n）必有非零解，因为 r(A)≤m<n；此时解空间维数至少为 1。
解空间是 ℝⁿ 的子空间，dim N(A)=n−r(A)；基础解系恰含 n−r(A) 个向量——个数唯一，但基础解系本身不唯一（解空间的任何一组基都是基础解系）。
给定基础解系后，通解是其任意线性组合，系数为任意常数；反过来，每个解写成基础解系的组合时系数还是唯一的（因为基础解系线性无关）。
齐次方程组的任意两个解之差仍是解、任意有限个解之和仍是解、解的任意倍数仍是解；所有这些解合起来正好取遍解空间。
propertiesEn: A homogeneous system always has the zero solution; the zero solution is unique iff r(A)=n, and nonzero solutions (hence infinitely many) exist iff r(A)<n.
If there are fewer equations than unknowns (m<n) then nonzero solutions always exist, since r(A)≤m<n; the solution space then has dimension at least 1.

The solution space is a subspace of ℝⁿ with dim N(A)=n−r(A); a fundamental system contains exactly n−r(A) vectors — that number is unique although the fundamental system itself is not (any basis of the solution space qualifies).

Once a fundamental system is fixed, the general solution is an arbitrary linear combination of it; conversely the coefficients expressing a given solution are unique, because a fundamental system is linearly independent.
Differences, finite sums and scalar multiples of solutions are again solutions; taken together they fill the entire solution space.

examples.problem:
求齐次方程组
$$\begin{cases}x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4=0,\\ x_1+2x_2+3x_3+4x_4=0\end{cases}$$
的基础解系与通解。
examples.solution:
系数矩阵 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&4\end{pmatrix}$，第 2 行减第 1 行得 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\0&1&2&3\end{pmatrix}$，所以 $r(A)=2$，而 $n=4$，基础解系应含 $n-r=2$ 个向量。
主变量取 x₁,x₂，自由变量取 x₃,x₄：由 $x_2+2x_3+3x_4=0$ 得 $x_2=-2x_3-3x_4$，代入第一式得 $x_1=-x_2-x_3-x_4=x_3+2x_4$。
令 (x₃,x₄)=(1,0) 得 $\eta_1=(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T}$；令 (x₃,x₄)=(0,1) 得 $\eta_2=(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$。通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+k_2\eta_2,\qquad k_1,k_2\in\mathbb{R}.$$
验算：Aη₁=(1−2+1+0, 1−4+3+0)ᵀ=(0,0)ᵀ ✓；Aη₂=(2−3+0+1, 2−6+0+4)ᵀ=(0,0)ᵀ ✓。

examples.problem:
讨论 a 的取值，求齐次方程组
$$\begin{cases}x_1+x_2+x_3=0,\\ x_1+ax_2+ax_3=0\end{cases}$$
的通解。
examples.solution:
无论 a 取何值，$r(A)\le2<3=n$，所以必有非零解。两式相减得 $(a-1)(x_2+x_3)=0$。
当 **a≠1** 时：$x_2+x_3=0$，即 $x_2=-x_3$，代回第一式得 $x_1=0$，于是解空间维数为 $3-2=1$，基础解系取 $\eta=(0,-1,1)^{\mathrm T}$，通解 $\boldsymbol{x}=k(0,-1,1)^{\mathrm T}$，$k\in\mathbb{R}$。
当 **a=1** 时：两个方程完全相同（都是 $x_1+x_2+x_3=0$），$r(A)=1$，解空间维数为 $3-1=2$，取基础解系 $\eta_1=(-1,1,0)^{\mathrm T}$，$\eta_2=(-1,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$，通解 $\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+k_2\eta_2$，$k_1,k_2\in\mathbb{R}$。
验算：a≠1 时 η=(0,−1,1)ᵀ 满足第一式 0+(−1)+1=0 ✓，第二式 0+a(−1)+a(1)=0 ✓；a=1 时 η₁=(−1,1,0)ᵀ：−1+1+0=0 ✓，η₂=(−1,0,1)ᵀ：−1+0+1=0 ✓。

nonhomogeneous-solutions.definition:
常数项不全为零（$\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$）的方程组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 称为**非齐次线性方程组**；把右边改成 0 得到的 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 称为它的**导出组**（对应齐次方程组）。判别有解没有新公式，还是看两个秩（$n$ 为未知数个数，$(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ 为增广矩阵）：（1）$r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=n$ 时**唯一解**；（2）$r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})<n$ 时**无穷多解**（解集含 $n-r$ 个自由参数）；（3）$r(A)<r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ 时**无解**。注意增广矩阵的秩最多比系数矩阵的秩大 1，所以无解时必定 $r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=r(A)+1$。
有解时，解集的形状非常规整。设 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的一个**特解**，$\eta$ 是导出组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 的任一解，那么
$$A(\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta)=A\boldsymbol{x}^*+A\eta=\boldsymbol{b}+\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{b},$$
所以 $\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$ 还是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的解；反过来，若 $\boldsymbol{x}$ 是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的任一解，则 $A(\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*)=\boldsymbol{b}-\boldsymbol{b}=\boldsymbol{0}$，即 $\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 是导出组的解。两边一凑就得到结构定理：$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$，其中 $\eta$ 取遍导出组的全部解。写成通解就是
$$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},$$
其中 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ 是导出组的基础解系，$k_i$ 为任意常数。
非齐次方程组的解集不再是向量空间（零向量不是它的解），它的形状是把导出组的解空间沿 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 平移得到的集合 $\boldsymbol{x}^*+N(A)$，称为仿射子空间。一个常用推论是：**任意两个特解之差必是导出组的解**——所以已知多个特解时，两两相减就能得到导出组的解，进而凑出基础解系。
nonhomogeneous-solutions.definitionEn:
A system $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ with $\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$ is called a **nonhomogeneous linear system**; replacing the right-hand side by 0 gives the **associated homogeneous system** $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$. Consistency is tested by ranks, with $n$ the number of unknowns and $(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ the augmented matrix: (i) $r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=n$ gives a **unique solution**; (ii) $r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})<n$ gives **infinitely many solutions** ($n-r$ free parameters); (iii) $r(A)<r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ means **no solution**. Appending one column raises the rank by at most 1, so in the inconsistent case necessarily $r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=r(A)+1$.
When the system is consistent, the solution set has a clean structure. Let $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ be one **particular solution** and $\eta$ any solution of the associated homogeneous system. Then $A(\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta)=\boldsymbol{b}+\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{b}$, so $\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$ is again a solution; conversely, for any solution $\boldsymbol{x}$ we have $A(\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*)=\boldsymbol{0}$, so $\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*$ solves the associated homogeneous system. This yields the structure theorem $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$, with $\eta$ running over all homogeneous solutions — the general solution is **one particular solution plus the general solution of the associated homogeneous system**: $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r}$, where $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ form a fundamental system of the associated homogeneous system and the $k_i$ are arbitrary.
The solution set itself is no longer a vector space (the zero vector is not a solution), but an affine set $\boldsymbol{x}^*+N(A)$: the homogeneous solution space translated by $\boldsymbol{x}^*$. A useful consequence: **the difference of any two particular solutions is a solution of the associated homogeneous system**, so several known particular solutions can be subtracted to build homogeneous solutions and hence a fundamental system.
derivation:
设 $A$ 为 $m\times n$ 矩阵，$\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$，方程组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的增广矩阵为 $(A|\boldsymbol{b})$。对增广矩阵作初等行变换，解集不变。化为行阶梯形后，若最后一列出现主元，就会出现形如 $0=d$（$d\ne0$）的方程，无解；若最后一列没有主元，则 $\boldsymbol{b}$ 可由 $A$ 的列向量表示，回代可得解。因此
$$A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}\ \text{有解}\iff r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b}),$$
等价地 $\boldsymbol{b}\in\operatorname{Col}(A)$。由于只多一列，必有 $r(A)\le r(A|\boldsymbol{b})\le r(A)+1$；无解时恰有 $r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=r(A)+1$。

有解时解的个数由 $r=r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ 与未知数个数 $n$ 决定。行最简形有 $r$ 个主元、$n-r$ 个自由变量：若 $r=n$，没有自由变量，解唯一；若 $r<n$，自由变量可任意取值，得到一个含 $n-r$ 个参数的无穷解族。合起来就是三种互斥情形：$r=n$ 唯一解；$r<n$ 无穷多解；$r(A)<r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ 无解（此时上面已证增广秩恰为大 1）。

解的结构由「特解 + 齐次解」给出。设 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的一个特解，$\eta\in N(A)$。则
$$A(\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta)=A\boldsymbol{x}^*+A\eta=\boldsymbol{b}+\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{b},$$
故 $\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$ 仍是解。反过来，若 $\boldsymbol{x}$ 也是解，则 $A(\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*)=\boldsymbol{b}-\boldsymbol{b}=\boldsymbol{0}$，即 $\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*=\eta\in N(A)$，于是 $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$。因此解集恰为
$$\{\boldsymbol{x}:A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}\}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+N(A),$$
它是把解空间沿 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 平移得到的仿射子空间；$\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$ 时零向量不是解，所以解集本身不是向量空间。

取导出组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 的基础解系 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$，非齐次方程组的通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_i\in\mathbb{R}.$$
这里 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 是任意一个特解，$k_i$ 任意；改变特解只改变公式中的常数项，不改变解集。求法固定为三步：先对增广矩阵行化简并由两秩判断有解性，再解导出组得基础解系，最后令自由变量全为 0（或任取方便值）解出主变量得到一个特解，相加即得通解。

任意两个解之差是齐次解：若 $A\boldsymbol{x}_1=\boldsymbol{b}$、$A\boldsymbol{x}_2=\boldsymbol{b}$，则 $A(\boldsymbol{x}_1-\boldsymbol{x}_2)=\boldsymbol{b}-\boldsymbol{b}=\boldsymbol{0}$。因此已知多个特解时，两两相减即可造出 $N(A)$ 中的向量；若能找到 $n-r$ 个线性无关的差向量，它们就构成导出组的基础解系，再取其中一个解作特解即可写出通解。注意差向量必须线性无关且个数达到 $n-r$，仅有一个差向量不能张成整个解空间。

例：解 $x_1+x_2+x_3=1$，$x_1+2x_2+3x_3=3$，$2x_1+3x_2+4x_3=4$。对增广矩阵行化简：
$$\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&3\\2&3&4&4\end{pmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\0&1&2&2\\0&0&0&0\end{pmatrix},$$
故 $r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=2<3$，有无穷多解。由 $x_2+2x_3=2$、$x_1+x_2+x_3=1$ 得 $x_2=2-2x_3$，$x_1=-1+x_3$。令 $x_3=0$ 得特解 $\boldsymbol{x}^*=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}$；导出组令 $x_3=1$ 得 $\eta=(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T}$。通解 $\boldsymbol{x}=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}+k(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T}$，$k\in\mathbb{R}$。验算：$A\boldsymbol{x}^*=(1,3,4)^{\mathrm T}$，$A\eta=\boldsymbol{0}$。
derivationEn:
Let $A$ be $m\times n$, $\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$, and let $(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ be the augmented matrix of $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$. Elementary row operations on the augmented matrix preserve the solution set. After reduction to row echelon form, a pivot in the last column produces an equation $0=d$ with $d\ne0$, so there is no solution; if the last column has no pivot, then $\boldsymbol{b}$ is representable by the columns of $A$ and back-substitution gives a solution. Therefore
$$A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}\ \text{is consistent}\iff r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b}),$$
equivalently $\boldsymbol{b}\in\operatorname{Col}(A)$. Since only one column is added, $r(A)\le r(A|\boldsymbol{b})\le r(A)+1$; in the inconsistent case $r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=r(A)+1$ exactly.

When the system is consistent, the number of solutions is determined by $r=r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ and the number $n$ of unknowns. The reduced row echelon form has $r$ pivots and $n-r$ free variables: if $r=n$ there are no free variables and the solution is unique; if $r<n$ the free variables are arbitrary and give an infinite family with $n-r$ parameters. Thus there are three mutually exclusive cases: $r=n$ gives a unique solution; $r<n$ gives infinitely many; $r(A)<r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ gives no solution (and then the augmented rank is exactly one larger).

The structure of the solution set is “particular solution plus homogeneous solution”. Let $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ be a particular solution of $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ and $\eta\in N(A)$. Then
$$A(\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta)=A\boldsymbol{x}^*+A\eta=\boldsymbol{b}+\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{b},$$
so $\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$ is again a solution. Conversely, if $\boldsymbol{x}$ is any solution, then $A(\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*)=\boldsymbol{b}-\boldsymbol{b}=\boldsymbol{0}$, so $\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*=\eta\in N(A)$ and $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$. Hence the solution set is exactly
$$\{\boldsymbol{x}:A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}\}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+N(A),$$
the null space translated by $\boldsymbol{x}^*$, an affine subspace. When $\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$ the zero vector is not a solution, so the solution set itself is not a vector space.

Taking a fundamental system $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ of the associated homogeneous system $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$, the general solution of the nonhomogeneous system is
$$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_i\in\mathbb{R}.$$
Here $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ is any particular solution and the $k_i$ are arbitrary; changing the particular solution changes only the constant term in the formula, not the solution set. The recipe has three steps: row-reduce the augmented matrix and use the two ranks to decide consistency; solve the associated homogeneous system for a fundamental system; set the free variables to 0 (or any convenient values), solve for the pivot variables to get one particular solution, and add.

The difference of any two solutions is homogeneous: if $A\boldsymbol{x}_1=\boldsymbol{b}$ and $A\boldsymbol{x}_2=\boldsymbol{b}$, then $A(\boldsymbol{x}_1-\boldsymbol{x}_2)=\boldsymbol{b}-\boldsymbol{b}=\boldsymbol{0}$. Therefore, when several particular solutions are known, their pairwise differences produce vectors in $N(A)$; if one can find $n-r$ independent difference vectors, they form a fundamental system of the associated homogeneous system, and together with any one of the known solutions they yield the general solution. The differences must be independent and must number $n-r$; a single difference vector cannot span the whole solution space.

Example: solve $x_1+x_2+x_3=1$, $x_1+2x_2+3x_3=3$, $2x_1+3x_2+4x_3=4$. Row reduction of the augmented matrix gives
$$\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&3\\2&3&4&4\end{pmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\0&1&2&2\\0&0&0&0\end{pmatrix},$$
so $r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=2<3$ and there are infinitely many solutions. From $x_2+2x_3=2$ and $x_1+x_2+x_3=1$ we get $x_2=2-2x_3$ and $x_1=-1+x_3$. Setting $x_3=0$ gives the particular solution $\boldsymbol{x}^*=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}$; for the associated homogeneous system, setting $x_3=1$ gives $\eta=(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T}$. The general solution is $\boldsymbol{x}=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}+k(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T}$, $k\in\mathbb{R}$. Check: $A\boldsymbol{x}^*=(1,3,4)^{\mathrm T}$ and $A\eta=\boldsymbol{0}$.

formulas.note: 判别准则：系数矩阵与增广矩阵同秩就有解；无解时增广矩阵的秩恰好大 1。
formulas.noteEn: Consistency test: the system is solvable iff the coefficient and augmented matrices have equal rank; in the inconsistent case the augmented rank is exactly one larger.

formulas.note: 三种情形（n 为未知数个数）：两秩相等且等于 n 唯一解；两秩相等且小于 n 无穷多解（含 n−r 个自由参数）；两秩不等无解。
formulas.noteEn: The three cases (n = number of unknowns): equal ranks equal to n give a unique solution; equal ranks below n give infinitely many solutions with n−r free parameters; unequal ranks mean no solution.

formulas.note: 通解 = 一个特解 x* + 导出组的通解；η_i 为导出组的基础解系，k_i 为任意常数。
formulas.noteEn: General solution = one particular solution plus the general solution of the associated homogeneous system; η_i form a fundamental system, k_i are arbitrary constants.

formulas.note: 两个特解之差是对应齐次方程组的解——用多个特解构造齐次解、求通解的关键技巧。
formulas.noteEn: The difference of two particular solutions solves the associated homogeneous system — the key trick for building homogeneous solutions from known particular solutions.

formulas.note: 有解时解集是一次特解加上解空间：把 N(A) 沿 x* 整体平移，称为仿射子空间。
formulas.noteEn: When consistent, the solution set is a particular solution plus the solution space: the null space N(A) translated by x*, an affine subspace.

properties: 增广矩阵只比系数矩阵多一列，所以 r(A)≤r(A|b)≤r(A)+1；无解时恰好 r(A|b)=r(A)+1，有解时两秩相等。
三种情形彼此不相容（记 r=r(A)）：r(A)=r(A|b)=n 唯一解；r(A)=r(A|b)=r<n 无穷多解，解集含 n−r 个自由参数；r(A)<r(A|b) 无解。
解集不是向量空间（b≠0 时零向量不是解），但形状是仿射子空间 x*+N(A)：一个特解加上导出组的解空间。
特解与齐次解可以自由组合：特解 + 导出组的任何解仍是解；两个解之差是导出组的解。已知基础解系 η₁,…,η_{n−r} 与一个特解 x*，就掌握了解集的全貌。
求通解三步：① 行化简增广矩阵，由两秩判断有解性与主元；② 解导出组得基础解系（令自由变量依次取 1 与 0 的标准取法）；③ 找一个特解（常令自由变量全取 0 解出主变量），相加即得通解。
propertiesEn: The augmented matrix has only one extra column, so r(A)≤r(A|b)≤r(A)+1; in the inconsistent case r(A|b)=r(A)+1 exactly, while consistency means equal ranks.
The three cases are mutually exclusive (write r=r(A)): r(A)=r(A|b)=n gives a unique solution; r(A)=r(A|b)=r<n gives infinitely many solutions with n−r free parameters; r(A)<r(A|b) means no solution.
The solution set is not a vector space (for b≠0 the zero vector is not a solution) but an affine set x*+N(A): one particular solution plus the homogeneous solution space.

Particular and homogeneous solutions combine freely: a particular solution plus any homogeneous solution is again a solution, and the difference of two solutions is homogeneous. Knowing a fundamental system η₁,…,η_{n−r} and one particular solution x* determines the whole solution set.

Recipe: (i) row-reduce the augmented matrix and read off consistency and pivots from the two ranks; (ii) solve the associated homogeneous system for a fundamental system (setting free variables to 1 and 0 in turn); (iii) find one particular solution (often by setting all free variables to 0), then add.

examples.problem:
求解非齐次方程组
$$\begin{cases}x_1+x_2+x_3=1,\\ x_1+2x_2+3x_3=3,\\ 2x_1+3x_2+4x_3=4.\end{cases}$$
examples.solution:
增广矩阵为
$$(A|\boldsymbol{b})=\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&3\\2&3&4&4\end{pmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\0&1&2&2\\0&0&0&0\end{pmatrix},$$
其中第 3 行等于第 1 行加第 2 行（化为零行），$r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=2<3=n$，故有无穷多解，自由参数 1 个。
由 $x_2+2x_3=2$ 得 $x_2=2-2x_3$，再由第一式得 $x_1=1-x_2-x_3=-1+x_3$。取 x₃=0 得特解 $\boldsymbol{x}^*=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}$；导出组同解过程给出基础解系 $\eta=(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T}$。通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}+k(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T},\qquad k\in\mathbb{R}.$$
验算：特解代入三式分别得 1、3、4 ✓；η 代入左端三式均为 0 ✓。

examples.problem:
设 4 元非齐次线性方程组 Ax=b 满足 r(A)=r(A|b)=2，已知它的三个解
x₁=(0,1,0,0)ᵀ，x₂=(1,-1,1,0)ᵀ，x₃=(2,-2,0,1)ᵀ，求 Ax=b 的通解。
examples.solution:
两个解之差是导出组 Ax=0 的解，于是
$$x_2-x_1=(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T},\qquad x_3-x_1=(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$$
都是齐次解。导出组的解空间维数为 $n-r=4-2=2$，而这两个向量线性无关（它们的第 3、4 个分量分别是 (1,0)、(0,1)，一眼可见无关），所以它们恰好构成导出组的基础解系。
取特解 x₁，通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=(0,1,0,0)^{\mathrm T}+k_1(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T}+k_2(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T},\qquad k_1,k_2\in\mathbb{R}.$$
说明：改用 x₂ 或 x₃ 作特解，写出的公式形式不同，但表示的解集完全相同——这正是「通解 = 特解 + 导出组通解」的含义。

inner-product-orthogonality.definition:
在 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中，两个列向量 $\alpha=(a_1,\dots,a_n)^T$ 与 $\beta=(b_1,\dots,b_n)^T$ 的**内积**定义为 $(\alpha,\beta)=\alpha^T\beta=a_1b_1+\cdots+a_nb_n$。它把点积推广到任意维数：结果是一个数，而不是向量。由内积立刻得到**长度（范数）** $\|\alpha\|=\sqrt{(\alpha,\alpha)}$ 以及夹角 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|}$。

当 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$ 时，称 $\alpha$ 与 $\beta$ **正交**，记作 $\alpha\perp\beta$。正交就是「垂直」在高维的推广——没有图可看，但「内积为零」这个定义完全够用。零向量与任何向量正交，不过正交向量组里约定向量都非零：**两两正交的非零向量组一定线性无关**，这让正交组比普通的线性无关组好用得多。

给定线性无关组 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$，**施密特（Gram–Schmidt）正交化**的做法是逐个减掉它在前面所有方向上积累的投影：先取 $\beta_1=\alpha_1$，再取 $\beta_2=\alpha_2-\dfrac{(\alpha_2,\beta_1)}{(\beta_1,\beta_1)}\beta_1$，一般地 $\beta_i=\alpha_i-\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\dfrac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j$。注意分子是 $\alpha_i$ 与 $\beta_j$ 的内积，**分母是 $(\beta_j,\beta_j)$**，两者不能写反。最后把每个 $\beta_i$ 单位化，$\eta_i=\beta_i/\|\beta_i\|$，就得到**标准正交组**。

如果 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_n$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的一组标准正交基，那么向量的坐标可以直接用内积读出：$x=(\eta_1^Tx)\eta_1+\cdots+(\eta_n^Tx)\eta_n$。把标准正交基按列排成矩阵 $Q$，就得到正交矩阵（$Q^TQ=E$，因而 $Q^{-1}=Q^T$）。配备内积的 $n$ 维实向量空间称为**欧几里得空间（简称欧氏空间）**——这里就是 $\mathbb{R}^n$；上面的长度、夹角、正交与标准正交基本来就是欧氏空间的语言。这套工具是后面实对称矩阵正交对角化、二次型化标准形的技术底座。
inner-product-orthogonality.definitionEn:
In $\mathbb{R}^n$, the **inner product** of two column vectors $\alpha=(a_1,\dots,a_n)^T$ and $\beta=(b_1,\dots,b_n)^T$ is $(\alpha,\beta)=\alpha^T\beta=a_1b_1+\cdots+a_nb_n$. It generalizes the dot product to any dimension: the result is a scalar, not a vector. It immediately yields the **norm (length)** $\|\alpha\|=\sqrt{(\alpha,\alpha)}$ and the angle through $\cos\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|}$.

When $(\alpha,\beta)=0$ we call $\alpha$ and $\beta$ **orthogonal**, written $\alpha\perp\beta$. Orthogonality is perpendicularity in higher dimensions — there is nothing to draw, but the definition 'the inner product is zero' is exactly right. The zero vector is orthogonal to everything, yet vectors of an orthogonal set are required to be nonzero: **any set of pairwise orthogonal nonzero vectors is linearly independent**, which makes orthogonal sets far more convenient than merely independent ones.

Given a linearly independent set $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$, **Gram–Schmidt orthogonalization** subtracts, step by step, the projection onto everything accumulated so far: start with $\beta_1=\alpha_1$, then $\beta_2=\alpha_2-\dfrac{(\alpha_2,\beta_1)}{(\beta_1,\beta_1)}\beta_1$, and in general $\beta_i=\alpha_i-\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\dfrac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j$. The numerator is the inner product of $\alpha_i$ with $\beta_j$, while **the denominator is $(\beta_j,\beta_j)$** — the two must never be swapped. Normalizing each $\beta_i$ as $\eta_i=\beta_i/\|\beta_i\|$ produces an **orthonormal set**.

If $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_n$ is an orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$, the coordinates of a vector can be read off directly by inner products: $x=(\eta_1^Tx)\eta_1+\cdots+(\eta_n^Tx)\eta_n$. Placing an orthonormal basis as the columns of a matrix $Q$ gives an orthogonal matrix ($Q^TQ=E$, hence $Q^{-1}=Q^T$). A real vector space of dimension $n$ equipped with an inner product is called a **Euclidean space**—here it is $\mathbb{R}^n$; length, angle, orthogonality and orthonormal bases are precisely the language of Euclidean spaces. This machinery is the technical foundation for the orthogonal diagonalization of real symmetric matrices and for reducing quadratic forms to canonical form.
derivation: 在 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中定义 $(\alpha,\beta)=\alpha^{T}\beta=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_ib_i$。它满足双线性、对称性与正定性：$(\alpha,\alpha)=\sum_i a_i^2\ge0$，且等号成立当且仅当 $\alpha=0$。因此可定义范数 $\|\alpha\|=\sqrt{(\alpha,\alpha)}$，只有 $\alpha\ne0$ 时才能单位化；正交定义为 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$。由 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式 $|(\alpha,\beta)|\le\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|$，夹角 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|}$ 才有定义。

设 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ 两两正交且都非零。若 $\sum_{k=1}^{m}c_k\alpha_k=0$，对固定的 $j$ 两边取与 $\alpha_j$ 的内积，交叉项因正交性全部消失，只剩 $c_j(\alpha_j,\alpha_j)=0$。由 $\alpha_j\ne0$ 得 $(\alpha_j,\alpha_j)>0$，故 $c_j=0$。由于 $j$ 任意，所有系数为零，所以该正交组线性无关。非零条件不能去掉：含零向量的正交组必定线性相关。

设 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ 线性无关。令 $\beta_1=\alpha_1$，并归纳假定 $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}$ 两两正交、非零，且 $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}=\operatorname{span}\{\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_{i-1}\}$。定义 $$\beta_i=\alpha_i-\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\frac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j.$$ 对每个 $k<i$，用 $(\cdot,\beta_k)$ 作用；由正交性，除第 $k$ 项外其余项全为零，于是 $$\begin{aligned}(\beta_i,\beta_k)&=(\alpha_i,\beta_k)\\&\quad-\frac{(\alpha_i,\beta_k)}{(\beta_k,\beta_k)}(\beta_k,\beta_k)\\&=0.\end{aligned}$$ 分母 $(\beta_j,\beta_j)>0$，故上述定义合法。

还需说明 $\beta_i\ne0$。若 $\beta_i=0$，则 $\alpha_i=\sum_{j<i}\dfrac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j\in\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}$。由归纳假设 $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}=\operatorname{span}\{\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_{i-1}\}$，这与 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_i$ 线性无关矛盾。故 $\beta_i\ne0$。又 $\beta_i$ 与 $\alpha_i$ 只相差 $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}$ 的线性组合，所以 $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_i\}=\operatorname{span}\{\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_i\}$，归纳可以继续。

最后单位化 $\eta_i=\beta_i/\|\beta_i\|$，得到与 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ 张成同一子空间的标准正交组。若 $m=n$，它就是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的标准正交基。此时任意 $x=\sum_{i=1}^{n}c_i\eta_i$ 满足 $(\eta_j,x)=c_j(\eta_j,\eta_j)=c_j$，所以 $$x=\sum_{j=1}^{n}(\eta_j^{T}x)\eta_j.$$ 把 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_n$ 按列排成 $Q$，正交列给出 $Q^{T}Q=E$，从而 $Q^{-1}=Q^{T}$，且 $QQ^{T}=E$，上式正是 $x=QQ^{T}x$。

条件核查：若 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ 线性相关，施密特过程必在某个 $i$ 处产生 $\beta_i=0$，单位化随即失败。例如 $\alpha_2=2\alpha_1$ 时，$\beta_2=\alpha_2-\dfrac{2(\alpha_1,\alpha_1)}{(\alpha_1,\alpha_1)}\alpha_1=0$。所以「线性无关」是前提而不是结论。几何上，$\beta_i$ 是 $\alpha_i$ 减去它在 $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}$ 上的正交投影后的余量，因而与整个前面的子空间正交。
derivationEn: On $\mathbb{R}^n$ define $(\alpha,\beta)=\alpha^{T}\beta=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_ib_i$. It is bilinear, symmetric and positive definite: $(\alpha,\alpha)=\sum_i a_i^2\ge0$, with equality iff $\alpha=0$. Hence the norm $\|\alpha\|=\sqrt{(\alpha,\alpha)}$ is defined, and only a nonzero vector can be normalized; orthogonality means $(\alpha,\beta)=0$. The Cauchy–Schwarz inequality $|(\alpha,\beta)|\le\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|$ is what makes the angle $\cos\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|}$ well defined.

Let $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ be pairwise orthogonal and nonzero. If $\sum_{k=1}^{m}c_k\alpha_k=0$, take the inner product of both sides with a fixed $\alpha_j$; all cross terms vanish by orthogonality, leaving $c_j(\alpha_j,\alpha_j)=0$. Since $\alpha_j\ne0$ gives $(\alpha_j,\alpha_j)>0$, we get $c_j=0$. As $j$ is arbitrary, all coefficients vanish, so the orthogonal set is linearly independent. The nonzero hypothesis is essential: an orthogonal set containing $0$ is necessarily linearly dependent.

Let $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ be linearly independent. Put $\beta_1=\alpha_1$, and assume inductively that $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}$ are pairwise orthogonal, nonzero, and satisfy $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}=\operatorname{span}\{\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_{i-1}\}$. Define $$\beta_i=\alpha_i-\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\frac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j.$$ For each $k<i$, take the inner product with $\beta_k$; by orthogonality every term except the $k$-th one vanishes, so $$\begin{aligned}(\beta_i,\beta_k)&=(\alpha_i,\beta_k)\\&\quad-\frac{(\alpha_i,\beta_k)}{(\beta_k,\beta_k)}(\beta_k,\beta_k)\\&=0.\end{aligned}$$ The denominators $(\beta_j,\beta_j)$ are positive, so the definition is legitimate.

We must also show $\beta_i\ne0$. If $\beta_i=0$, then $\alpha_i=\sum_{j<i}\dfrac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j\in\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}$. By the induction hypothesis this span equals $\operatorname{span}\{\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_{i-1}\}$, contradicting the linear independence of $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_i$. Hence $\beta_i\ne0$. Moreover, $\beta_i$ differs from $\alpha_i$ only by a linear combination of $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}$, so $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_i\}=\operatorname{span}\{\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_i\}$ and the induction continues.

Finally normalize $\eta_i=\beta_i/\|\beta_i\|$; the result is an orthonormal set spanning the same subspace as $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$. If $m=n$, it is an orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$. For $x=\sum_{i=1}^{n}c_i\eta_i$, taking the inner product with $\eta_j$ gives $(\eta_j,x)=c_j(\eta_j,\eta_j)=c_j$, hence $$x=\sum_{j=1}^{n}(\eta_j^{T}x)\eta_j.$$ Placing $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_n$ as the columns of $Q$, the orthonormal columns give $Q^{T}Q=E$, so $Q^{-1}=Q^{T}$ and $QQ^{T}=E$; the displayed formula is exactly $x=QQ^{T}x$.

Hypothesis check: if $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$ are linearly dependent, Gram–Schmidt must produce $\beta_i=0$ at some stage, and normalization fails immediately. For example, if $\alpha_2=2\alpha_1$, then $\beta_2=\alpha_2-\dfrac{2(\alpha_1,\alpha_1)}{(\alpha_1,\alpha_1)}\alpha_1=0$. Thus linear independence is a hypothesis, not a conclusion. Geometrically, $\beta_i$ is the residual of $\alpha_i$ after subtracting its orthogonal projection onto $\operatorname{span}\{\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{i-1}\}$, so it is orthogonal to that entire subspace.

formulas.note: 内积的定义：对应分量相乘再相加，结果是数。写成 αᵀβ 便于套用矩阵运算。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of the inner product: multiply matching components and add; the result is a scalar. Writing it as αᵀβ lets matrix algebra do the work.

formulas.note: 范数（长度）由内积诱导；模长为 1 的向量称为单位向量（标准向量）。
formulas.noteEn: The norm (length) is induced by the inner product; a vector of norm 1 is called a unit vector.

formulas.note: 柯西–施瓦茨不等式，等号成立当且仅当 α 与 β 线性相关；有了它，夹角才有定义。
formulas.noteEn: The Cauchy–Schwarz inequality; equality holds exactly when α and β are linearly dependent. It is what makes the angle well defined.

formulas.note: 施密特正交化：分子是 αᵢ 与 βⱼ 的内积，分母是 (βⱼ,βⱼ)，写反是最常见的错误。
formulas.noteEn: Gram–Schmidt: the numerator is the inner product of αᵢ with βⱼ, the denominator is (βⱼ,βⱼ); swapping them is the classic mistake.

formulas.note: 单位化得到标准正交组；按列排成 Q 就是正交矩阵，满足 QᵀQ=E。
formulas.noteEn: Normalizing gives an orthonormal set; placing the vectors as columns gives an orthogonal matrix Q with QᵀQ=E.

properties: 内积是双线性的：对两个变量都满足加性与数乘，(α,β)=(β,α)，且 (kα,β)=k(α,β)。
(α,α)≥0，并且 (α,α)=0 当且仅当 α=0；因此只有非零向量才有正的长度、才能单位化。
正交就是内积为零；当 α⊥β 时勾股定理成立：‖α+β‖²=‖α‖²+‖β‖²。
两两正交的非零向量组一定线性无关；反过来，线性无关组未必正交，这正是需要施密特正交化的原因。
正交矩阵满足 AᵀA=E ⟺ A⁻¹=Aᵀ，其行列式为 ±1；正交变换保持内积、长度与夹角不变。
propertiesEn: The inner product is bilinear: additive and homogeneous in each variable, with (α,β)=(β,α) and (kα,β)=k(α,β).
(α,α)≥0, and (α,α)=0 exactly when α=0; hence only nonzero vectors have positive length and can be normalized.
Orthogonality means the inner product vanishes; when α⊥β the Pythagorean identity holds: ‖α+β‖²=‖α‖²+‖β‖².
A set of pairwise orthogonal nonzero vectors is always linearly independent; conversely, an independent set need not be orthogonal, which is exactly why Gram–Schmidt is needed.
An orthogonal matrix satisfies AᵀA=E ⟺ A⁻¹=Aᵀ and has determinant ±1; orthogonal transformations preserve inner products, lengths and angles.

examples.problem: 把线性无关组 $\alpha_1=(1,1,1)^T$，$\alpha_2=(0,1,1)^T$，$\alpha_3=(0,0,1)^T$ 用施密特正交化变成标准正交组。
求 $\alpha=(1,1,0)^T$ 与 $\beta=(1,0,1)^T$ 的夹角，以及 α 在 β 方向上的投影向量。
examples.solution:
$(\alpha,\beta)=1\cdot1+1\cdot0+0\cdot1=1$，$\|\alpha\|=\|\beta\|=\sqrt{2}$，所以 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}\cdot\sqrt{2}}=\dfrac{1}{2}$，即夹角 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$。

投影系数为 $\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{(\beta,\beta)}=\dfrac{1}{2}$（**分母是被投影方向的 (β,β)**），故投影向量为 $\dfrac{1}{2}\beta=(\frac{1}{2},0,\frac{1}{2})^T$。

验算：余量 $\alpha-\frac{1}{2}\beta=(\frac{1}{2},1,-\frac{1}{2})^T$ 与 $\beta$ 正交，$(\frac{1}{2})\cdot1+1\cdot0+(-\frac{1}{2})\cdot1=0$，说明投影分解正确。

eigenvalue-eigenvector.definition:
设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶方阵。若存在**非零**向量 $\alpha$ 与数 $\lambda$ 使 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，就称 $\lambda$ 是 $A$ 的**特征值**，$\alpha$ 是 $A$ 的属于 $\lambda$ 的**特征向量**。$\alpha\neq 0$ 这个条件不能省：零向量对任何 $\lambda$ 都满足等式，没有任何信息量。几何上看，特征向量是在 $A$ 作用下方向不变的向量，$\lambda$ 是伸缩倍数（$\lambda>0$ 保持指向并伸缩，$\lambda<0$ 反向，$\lambda=0$ 被压到原点）。

把 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ 改写成 $(\lambda E-A)\alpha=0$：这是齐次线性方程组，它有非零解当且仅当系数矩阵不可逆，即 $|\lambda E-A|=0$。左端是关于 $\lambda$ 的 $n$ 次多项式，称为**特征多项式**，所以 $n$ 阶方阵在复数域内恰有 $n$ 个特征值（计代数重数）。注意 $|A-\lambda E|$ 与 $|\lambda E-A|$ 只相差符号 $(-1)^n$，根完全相同，本页统一使用 $|\lambda E-A|$。

对固定的 $\lambda$，属于它的全部特征向量再加上零向量构成 $(\lambda E-A)x=0$ 的解空间，称为 $\lambda$ 的**特征子空间**；它的维数 $n-r(\lambda E-A)$ 叫**几何重数**，而 $\lambda$ 作为特征多项式根的重数叫**代数重数**，恒有几何重数 ≤ 代数重数。

两条免费的校验：$n$ 个特征值之和等于 $\operatorname{tr}(A)$，之积等于 $|A|$，算完特征值代回去查一查即可。还要小心：**属于不同特征值的特征向量之和一般不再是特征向量**，因为 $A(\alpha+\beta)=\lambda_1\alpha+\lambda_2\beta$ 一般提不出公共倍数；只有同一个特征值的特征向量的线性组合（非零时）仍是特征向量。特征值与特征向量是线性代数的「主轴」：对角化、二次型、微分方程组、主成分分析都从这里出发。
eigenvalue-eigenvector.definitionEn:
Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix. If there is a **nonzero** vector $\alpha$ and a number $\lambda$ with $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$, then $\lambda$ is an **eigenvalue** of $A$ and $\alpha$ is an **eigenvector** belonging to $\lambda$. The condition $\alpha\neq 0$ cannot be dropped: the zero vector satisfies the equation for every $\lambda$ and carries no information. Geometrically, an eigenvector keeps its direction under $A$, while $\lambda$ is the stretch factor ($\lambda>0$ stretches, $\lambda<0$ reverses, $\lambda=0$ collapses it to the origin).

Rewriting $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ as $(\lambda E-A)\alpha=0$ makes it a homogeneous system, which has a nonzero solution exactly when the coefficient matrix is singular, i.e. $|\lambda E-A|=0$. The left side is a polynomial of degree $n$ in $\lambda$, the **characteristic polynomial**, so an $n\times n$ matrix has exactly $n$ eigenvalues over the complex numbers, counted with algebraic multiplicity. Note that $|A-\lambda E|$ differs from $|\lambda E-A|$ only by the factor $(-1)^n$, so the roots are identical; throughout this page we use $|\lambda E-A|$.

For a fixed $\lambda$, all eigenvectors belonging to it, together with the zero vector, form the solution space of $(\lambda E-A)x=0$, called the **eigenspace** of $\lambda$; its dimension $n-r(\lambda E-A)$ is the **geometric multiplicity**, while the multiplicity of $\lambda$ as a root of the characteristic polynomial is the **algebraic multiplicity**, and the geometric multiplicity never exceeds the algebraic one.

Two free sanity checks: the eigenvalues sum to $\operatorname{tr}(A)$ and multiply to $|A|$, so plug your answers back in. Beware too that **the sum of eigenvectors belonging to different eigenvalues is usually not an eigenvector**, since $A(\alpha+\beta)=\lambda_1\alpha+\lambda_2\beta$ generally has no common factor; only a linear combination of eigenvectors of the *same* eigenvalue remains an eigenvector (when it is nonzero). Eigenpairs are the 'principal axes' of linear algebra: diagonalization, quadratic forms, linear ODE systems and principal component analysis all start here.
derivation: 设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶方阵，$\alpha\neq0$。由 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ 移项得 $(\lambda E-A)\alpha=0$，这是以 $\alpha$ 为未知量的 $n$ 元齐次方程组。它有非零解当且仅当系数矩阵不可逆，即 $$\det(\lambda E-A)=0.$$ 左端记为 $f_A(\lambda)$，展开后是 $\lambda$ 的 $n$ 次首一多项式，称为特征多项式。因此在复数域上按代数重数恰有 $n$ 个根，它们就是 $A$ 的全部特征值；实矩阵的复特征值成共轭对出现。

以 $2\times2$ 为例，$A=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$ 时 $$\begin{aligned}f_A(\lambda)&=(\lambda-a)(\lambda-d)-bc\\&=\lambda^2-(a+d)\lambda+(ad-bc).\end{aligned}$$ 一般地 $f_A(\lambda)=\lambda^n-\operatorname{tr}(A)\lambda^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^n\det A$。由韦达定理，$$\sum_{i=1}^n\lambda_i=\operatorname{tr}(A),\qquad \prod_{i=1}^n\lambda_i=\det A.$$ 这两条是算完特征值后的免费校验；特别地 $\det A=0$ 当且仅当 $0$ 是特征值。

固定特征值 $\lambda_0$，其特征子空间为 $V_{\lambda_0}=\ker(\lambda_0E-A)$，几何重数 $g=\dim V_{\lambda_0}=n-r(\lambda_0E-A)$。取 $V_{\lambda_0}$ 的一组基 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_g$，扩充为全空间的基 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_g,\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{n-g}$。由于 $A\alpha_i=\lambda_0\alpha_i$，$A$ 在这组基下的矩阵为分块上三角 $$\begin{pmatrix}\lambda_0E_g&*\\0&B\end{pmatrix},$$ 故 $f_A(\lambda)=(\lambda-\lambda_0)^g\det(\lambda E_{n-g}-B)$。于是 $\lambda_0$ 的代数重数 $m\ge g$：代数重数总不小于几何重数。

不同特征值的特征向量线性无关。设 $A\alpha_i=\lambda_i\alpha_i$，$\alpha_i
eq0$，$\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_s$ 两两不同，且 $\sum_{i=1}^s c_i\alpha_i=0$。对每个 $k$，用 $\prod_{j
eq k}(A-\lambda_jE)$ 作用。含 $i
eq k$ 的项被因子 $(A-\lambda_iE)$ 杀死，只剩 $$c_k\prod_{j
eq k}(\lambda_k-\lambda_j)\,\alpha_k=0.$$ 系数与 $\alpha_k$ 都非零，故 $c_k=0$；对 $k=1,\dots,s$ 都成立，所以这些特征向量线性无关。

例：$A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$。$f_A(\lambda)=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-1)$，特征值为 $2,1$。$\lambda=2$ 时 $(2E-A)x=0$ 给出 $x_2=0$，取 $\alpha_1=(1,0)^T$；$\lambda=1$ 时 $(E-A)x=0$ 给出 $x_1+x_2=0$，取 $\alpha_2=(1,-1)^T$。校验：$\operatorname{tr}(A)=3=2+1$，$\det A=2=2\cdot1$。而 $A(1,1)^T=(3,1)^T$ 与 $(1,1)^T$ 不成比例，故 $(1,1)^T$ 不是特征向量。

三个边界不能忽略。其一，零向量不是特征向量，因为 $A0=\lambda0$ 对一切 $\lambda$ 成立。其二，不同特征值的特征向量之和一般不是特征向量：$A(\alpha_1+\alpha_2)=\lambda_1\alpha_1+\lambda_2\alpha_2$，当 $\lambda_1\neq\lambda_2$ 时提不出公共倍数。其三，若 $A$ 可逆（等价于所有特征值非零），则 $A^{-1}\alpha=\lambda^{-1}\alpha$，且 $A^k\alpha=\lambda^k\alpha$；$\lambda=0$ 时 $A$ 不可逆，$A^{-1}$ 不存在。
derivationEn: Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix and $\alpha\neq0$. Rewriting $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ as $(\lambda E-A)\alpha=0$ gives a homogeneous system of $n$ equations in the unknown $\alpha$. It has a nonzero solution exactly when the coefficient matrix is singular, that is, $$\det(\lambda E-A)=0.$$ The left side, denoted $f_A(\lambda)$, is a monic polynomial of degree $n$, the characteristic polynomial. Hence over $\mathbb{C}$ it has exactly $n$ roots counted with algebraic multiplicity, and these are precisely the eigenvalues of $A$; for a real matrix, nonreal eigenvalues occur in conjugate pairs.

For a $2\times2$ example, if $A=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$, then $$\begin{aligned}f_A(\lambda)&=(\lambda-a)(\lambda-d)-bc\\&=\lambda^2-(a+d)\lambda+(ad-bc).\end{aligned}$$ In general $f_A(\lambda)=\lambda^n-\operatorname{tr}(A)\lambda^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^n\det A$. By Vieta's formulas, $$\sum_{i=1}^n\lambda_i=\operatorname{tr}(A),\qquad \prod_{i=1}^n\lambda_i=\det A.$$ These identities are free checks after computing the eigenvalues; in particular $\det A=0$ if and only if $0$ is an eigenvalue.

Fix an eigenvalue $\lambda_0$. Its eigenspace is $V_{\lambda_0}=\ker(\lambda_0E-A)$, with geometric multiplicity $g=\dim V_{\lambda_0}=n-r(\lambda_0E-A)$. Choose a basis $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_g$ of $V_{\lambda_0}$ and extend it to a basis $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_g,\beta_1,\dots,\beta_{n-g}$ of the whole space. Since $A\alpha_i=\lambda_0\alpha_i$, the matrix of $A$ in this basis is block upper triangular $$\begin{pmatrix}\lambda_0E_g&*\\0&B\end{pmatrix},$$ so $f_A(\lambda)=(\lambda-\lambda_0)^g\det(\lambda E_{n-g}-B)$. Therefore the algebraic multiplicity $m$ of $\lambda_0$ satisfies $m\ge g$: the algebraic multiplicity is always at least the geometric one.

Eigenvectors belonging to distinct eigenvalues are linearly independent. Let $A\alpha_i=\lambda_i\alpha_i$ with $\alpha_i
eq0$ and pairwise distinct $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_s$, and suppose $\sum_{i=1}^s c_i\alpha_i=0$. For each $k$, apply $\prod_{j
eq k}(A-\lambda_jE)$. Every term with $i
eq k$ is killed by the factor $(A-\lambda_iE)$, leaving only $$c_k\prod_{j
eq k}(\lambda_k-\lambda_j)\,\alpha_k=0.$$ Both the coefficient and $\alpha_k$ are nonzero, so $c_k=0$; this holds for every $k$, hence the eigenvectors are linearly independent.

Example: $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$. Then $f_A(\lambda)=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-1)$, so the eigenvalues are $2$ and $1$. For $\lambda=2$, the system $(2E-A)x=0$ gives $x_2=0$, so take $\alpha_1=(1,0)^T$; for $\lambda=1$, $(E-A)x=0$ gives $x_1+x_2=0$, so take $\alpha_2=(1,-1)^T$. Checks: $\operatorname{tr}(A)=3=2+1$ and $\det A=2=2\cdot1$. On the other hand, $A(1,1)^T=(3,1)^T$ is not proportional to $(1,1)^T$, so $(1,1)^T$ is not an eigenvector.

Three boundary cases matter. First, the zero vector is not an eigenvector, since $A0=\lambda0$ holds for every $\lambda$. Second, a sum of eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues is generally not an eigenvector: $A(\alpha_1+\alpha_2)=\lambda_1\alpha_1+\lambda_2\alpha_2$ has no common factor when $\lambda_1\neq\lambda_2$. Third, if $A$ is invertible (equivalently, all eigenvalues are nonzero), then $A^{-1}\alpha=\lambda^{-1}\alpha$ and $A^k\alpha=\lambda^k\alpha$; when $\lambda=0$, $A$ is singular and $A^{-1}$ does not exist.

formulas.note: 定义式。特征向量必须非零，特征值可以是实数也可以是复数。
formulas.noteEn: The definition: an eigenvector must be nonzero, while an eigenvalue may be real or complex.

formulas.note: 特征方程：解它得到全部特征值（含重数）。等价写法 |A−λE|=0 只差一个符号，根完全一样。
formulas.noteEn: The characteristic equation: solve it for all eigenvalues with multiplicities. The variant |A−λE|=0 differs only by a sign and has the same roots.

formulas.note: 迹与行列式两个不变量给出快速校验；特别地 |A|=0 当且仅当 0 是特征值。
formulas.noteEn: Trace and determinant give quick checks; in particular |A|=0 holds exactly when 0 is an eigenvalue.

formulas.note: 解这个齐次方程组得到属于 λ 的全部特征向量（再加零向量即特征子空间）；基础解系含 n−r(λE−A) 个向量，就是几何重数。
formulas.noteEn: Solving this homogeneous system yields all eigenvectors for λ (plus the zero vector they form the eigenspace); a fundamental system has n−r(λE−A) vectors, the geometric multiplicity.

formulas.note: 同一个 α 也是幂矩阵与逆矩阵的特征向量：A^k 的特征值为 λ^k；当 A 可逆（即全部特征值均非零）时 A⁻¹ 的特征值为 1/λ。
formulas.noteEn: The same α is an eigenvector of powers and inverses: λ^k for A^k, and 1/λ for A⁻¹ when A is invertible (equivalently, when all eigenvalues are nonzero).

properties: 特征值与特征向量是矩阵固有的量：相似矩阵有相同的特征多项式与特征值，换基不会改变伸缩倍数。
n 阶矩阵在复数域内恰有 n 个特征值（计代数重数）；实矩阵的复特征值成共轭对出现。
属于不同特征值的特征向量线性无关；属于同一特征值的全部特征向量连同零向量构成特征子空间，其维数（几何重数）不大于该特征值的代数重数。
不同特征值的特征向量之和一般不是特征向量；只有同一特征值的特征向量的线性组合（非零时）仍是特征向量。
λ 是 A 的特征值 ⟺ |λE−A|=0 ⟺ 齐次方程组 (λE−A)x=0 有非零解 ⟺ r(λE−A)<n。
propertiesEn: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors are intrinsic to a matrix: similar matrices share the same characteristic polynomial and eigenvalues, since changing bases does not change stretch factors.
An n×n matrix has exactly n eigenvalues over the complex numbers, counted with algebraic multiplicity; a real matrix has its complex eigenvalues in conjugate pairs.

Eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are linearly independent; all eigenvectors for one eigenvalue λ, together with the zero vector, form the eigenspace of λ, whose dimension (the geometric multiplicity) never exceeds the algebraic multiplicity of λ.
The sum of eigenvectors for different eigenvalues is generally not an eigenvector; only linear combinations of eigenvectors for the same eigenvalue (when nonzero) remain eigenvectors.
λ is an eigenvalue of A ⟺ |λE−A|=0 ⟺ the system (λE−A)x=0 has a nonzero solution ⟺ r(λE−A)<n.

examples.problem: 求 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的全部特征值与特征向量，并说明 $A(1,0)^T$ 与 $A(1,1)^T$ 的几何效果。
examples.solution:
特征方程：$|\lambda E-A|=\begin{vmatrix}\lambda-2&-1\\0&\lambda-1\end{vmatrix}=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-1)=0$，得 $\lambda_1=2$，$\lambda_2=1$。

校验：$\operatorname{tr}(A)=3=2+1$ ✓；$|A|=2=2\times1$ ✓。

对 $\lambda=2$：解 $(2E-A)x=0$，$2E-A=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_2=0$，特征向量取 $\alpha_1=(1,0)^T$。

对 $\lambda=1$：$E-A=\begin{pmatrix}-1&-1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_1+x_2=0$，特征向量取 $\alpha_2=(1,-1)^T$。

几何效果：$A(1,0)^T=(2,0)^T$，方向不变、长度变成 2 倍（$\lambda=2$）；$A(1,-1)^T=(1,-1)^T$，方向与长度都不变（$\lambda=1$）；而 $A(1,1)^T=(3,1)^T$ 与 $(1,1)^T$ 不成比例、方向已改变，所以 $(1,1)^T$ 不是特征向量。

examples.problem: 求 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2&2\\2&1&2\\2&2&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的全部特征值与特征向量，并验证特征值之和、之积与 $\operatorname{tr}(A)$、$|A|$ 的关系。
examples.solution:
注意到 $A=2J-E$（$J$ 为全 1 矩阵），也可直接算：$A(1,1,1)^T=(5,5,5)^T$，故 $\lambda_1=5$，特征向量 $\alpha_1=(1,1,1)^T$。

特征多项式 $|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-5)(\lambda+1)^2=\lambda^3-3\lambda^2-9\lambda-5$，所以特征值为 $5,-1,-1$（代数重数 2）。

校验：$5+(-1)+(-1)=3=\operatorname{tr}(A)$ ✓；$5\times(-1)\times(-1)=5=|A|$（按第一行展开：$1(1-4)-2(2-4)+2(4-2)=-3+4+4=5$）✓。

对 $\lambda=-1$：解 $(A+E)x=0$，$A+E=\begin{pmatrix}2&2&2\\2&2&2\\2&2&2\end{pmatrix}$，即 $x_1+x_2+x_3=0$，得两个线性无关的特征向量 $(1,-1,0)^T$ 与 $(1,0,-1)^T$。几何重数 2 = 代数重数 2，特征子空间是平面 $x_1+x_2+x_3=0$。

expression.note: 先由特征方程 |λE−A| = 0 解出全部 λ，再解齐次方程组 (λE−A)x = 0 得特征向量。
expression.noteEn: First solve |λE−A| = 0 for all λ, then solve the homogeneous system (λE−A)x = 0 for the eigenvectors.

matrix-similarity-diagonalization.definition:
设 $A,B$ 都是 $n$ 阶方阵。若存在可逆矩阵 $P$ 使 $P^{-1}AP=B$，就称 $A$ 与 $B$ **相似**，记作 $A\sim B$。同一个线性变换在不同基下的矩阵恰好相似（$P$ 就是两组基之间的过渡矩阵），所以相似是「换个角度看同一个变换」。相似关系是等价关系：自反、对称、传递。

相似矩阵共享一切与基无关的量：特征多项式、特征值（含重数）、行列式、迹、秩都相同。但**反过来不成立**：特征值相同不一定相似。例如 $E=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 与 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的特征值都是 $1,1$，却不相似（否则 $A=PEP^{-1}=E$，矛盾）。

若 $A$ 相似于对角矩阵，就称 $A$ **可对角化**。判据是：$A$ 有 $n$ 个线性无关的特征向量；等价地，$A$ 的每个特征值的几何重数都等于它的代数重数。此时 $A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$，其中 $P$ 的**第 $i$ 列**是特征向量、$\Lambda$ 的第 $i$ 个对角元是对应的特征值——**列的次序必须和特征值的次序一一对应**，写错位置是常见错误。

还有一条漂亮的充分条件：$n$ 阶矩阵若有 $n$ 个互不相同的特征值，则必可对角化；但它不是必要条件——单位矩阵只有特征值 1，却已经是对角矩阵。可对角化的价值在于「降低幂次」：$A^k=P\Lambda^kP^{-1}$，把矩阵乘法变成对角元的幂，这是线性递推、图论计数与马尔可夫链的常用手法。
matrix-similarity-diagonalization.definitionEn:
Let $A$ and $B$ be $n\times n$ matrices. If $P^{-1}AP=B$ for some invertible $P$, then $A$ and $B$ are **similar**, written $A\sim B$. Matrices of the same linear transformation with respect to two different bases are exactly similar ($P$ is the transition matrix between the bases), so similarity means 'the same transformation viewed from another angle'. Similarity is an equivalence relation: reflexive, symmetric and transitive.

Similar matrices share everything independent of the basis: the characteristic polynomial, the eigenvalues with multiplicities, the determinant, the trace and the rank. The converse fails: equal eigenvalues do not imply similarity. For instance $E=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ both have eigenvalues $1,1$, yet they are not similar, since otherwise $A=PEP^{-1}=E$, a contradiction.

If $A$ is similar to a diagonal matrix, it is called **diagonalizable**. The criterion: $A$ has $n$ linearly independent eigenvectors; equivalently, the geometric multiplicity of every eigenvalue equals its algebraic multiplicity. Then $A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$, where the **i-th column** of $P$ is an eigenvector and the i-th diagonal entry of $\Lambda$ is the matching eigenvalue — **the order of the columns must agree with the order of the eigenvalues**, and mismatching them is a classic mistake.

There is also a neat sufficient condition: an $n\times n$ matrix with $n$ distinct eigenvalues is always diagonalizable; this is not necessary, since the identity matrix has only the eigenvalue 1 and is already diagonal. The payoff is reducing powers: $A^k=P\Lambda^kP^{-1}$ turns matrix multiplication into powers of diagonal entries, a standard device in linear recurrences, graph counting and Markov chains.
derivation: 设 $A,B$ 为 $n$ 阶方阵。若存在可逆矩阵 $P$ 使 $B=P^{-1}AP$，称 $A$ 与 $B$ 相似。相似是等价关系：自反取 $P=E$，对称取 $P^{-1}$，传递把两个过渡矩阵相乘。几何上，$A$ 与 $B$ 是同一个线性变换在两组基下的矩阵，$P$ 是两组基之间的过渡矩阵；因此相似就是「换基看同一个变换」。

相似不变量：$$\begin{aligned}f_B(\lambda)&=\det(\lambda E-P^{-1}AP)\\&=\det\bigl(P^{-1}(\lambda E-A)P\bigr)\\&=\det(P^{-1})f_A(\lambda)\det P=f_A(\lambda).\end{aligned}$$ 所以相似矩阵有相同的特征多项式、特征值（含重数）、迹、行列式与秩。反过来不成立：$E$ 与 $J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的特征多项式都是 $(\lambda-1)^2$，但 $E$ 只相似于自己，而 $J\neq E$，故二者不相似。

可对角化的含义：$A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$，$\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$，等价于 $AP=P\Lambda$。比较第 $i$ 列得 $Ap_i=\lambda_ip_i$。$P$ 可逆保证 $p_1,\dots,p_n$ 线性无关且非零，所以它们是一组特征向量基。反之，若 $A$ 有 $n$ 个线性无关的特征向量 $p_i$，令 $P=(p_1,\dots,p_n)$，则 $AP=P\Lambda$，即 $P^{-1}AP=\Lambda$。因此 $$A\ \text{可对角化}\iff A\ \text{有}\ n\ \text{个线性无关的特征向量}.$$ 列的顺序必须与对角元的顺序一致。

重数判据：设互异特征值为 $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_s$，代数重数 $m_i$，几何重数 $g_i=n-r(\lambda_iE-A)$。对每个 $\lambda_i$，取其特征子空间的一组基并扩充为全空间的基，可知 $A$ 的矩阵呈分块上三角，故 $g_i\le m_i$。不同特征值的特征子空间之和是直和，且 $\sum m_i=n$。于是 $$\begin{aligned}A\ \text{可对角化}&\iff \sum_{i=1}^s g_i=n\\&\iff g_i=m_i\quad(i=1,\dots,s).\end{aligned}$$ 理由：$\sum g_i=n$ 说明这些特征子空间的基拼成 $n$ 个线性无关特征向量；而 $\sum g_i\le\sum m_i=n$，取等当且仅当每一项都取等。

$n$ 个互异特征值是可对角化的充分条件：此时每个 $m_i=1$，而特征值必有非零特征向量，故 $g_i\ge1$，于是 $g_i=m_i=1$。它不是必要条件：$E_n$ 只有特征值 $1$，$m_1=n$，但 $g_1=n$，本身已是对角阵。例：$A=\begin{pmatrix}3&-1\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}$，$f_A=(\lambda-4)(\lambda-2)$，取 $p_1=(1,-1)^T$、$p_2=(1,1)^T$，则 $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}$ 可逆，且 $P^{-1}AP=\operatorname{diag}(4,2)$。

不可对角化的典型例子：$J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$，$f_J=(\lambda-1)^2$，代数重数 $m_1=2$，但 $g_1=2-r(J-E)=2-1=1$，故不可对角化。这也说明特征值相同远弱于相似。可对角化时，幂与多项式有简单公式：$$A^k=P\Lambda^kP^{-1},\qquad f(A)=Pf(\Lambda)P^{-1};$$ 若 $A$ 可逆（所有 $\lambda_i\neq0$），还有 $A^{-1}=P\Lambda^{-1}P^{-1}$。这把矩阵乘法降为对角元的运算。
derivationEn: Let $A,B$ be $n\times n$ matrices. If $B=P^{-1}AP$ for some invertible $P$, then $A$ and $B$ are similar. Similarity is an equivalence relation: reflexivity uses $P=E$, symmetry uses $P^{-1}$, and transitivity multiplies the two transition matrices. Geometrically, $A$ and $B$ are matrices of the same linear transformation in two bases, with $P$ the transition matrix; similarity means viewing one transformation from two angles.

Similarity invariants: $$\begin{aligned}f_B(\lambda)&=\det(\lambda E-P^{-1}AP)\\&=\det\bigl(P^{-1}(\lambda E-A)P\bigr)\\&=\det(P^{-1})f_A(\lambda)\det P=f_A(\lambda).\end{aligned}$$ Thus similar matrices share the characteristic polynomial, eigenvalues with multiplicities, trace, determinant and rank. The converse fails: $E$ and $J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ both have characteristic polynomial $(\lambda-1)^2$, but $E$ is similar only to itself and $J\neq E$, so they are not similar.

Diagonalizability: $A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$ with $\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$ is equivalent to $AP=P\Lambda$. Comparing the $i$-th columns gives $Ap_i=\lambda_ip_i$. Since $P$ is invertible, $p_1,\dots,p_n$ are linearly independent and nonzero, hence form an eigenvector basis. Conversely, if $A$ has $n$ linearly independent eigenvectors $p_i$, set $P=(p_1,\dots,p_n)$; then $AP=P\Lambda$, i.e. $P^{-1}AP=\Lambda$. Therefore $$A\ \text{is diagonalizable}\iff A\ \text{has}\ n\ \text{linearly independent eigenvectors}.$$ The order of the columns must match the order of the diagonal entries.

Multiplicity criterion: let $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_s$ be the distinct eigenvalues, with algebraic multiplicities $m_i$ and geometric multiplicities $g_i=n-r(\lambda_iE-A)$. For each $\lambda_i$, take a basis of its eigenspace and extend it to a basis of the whole space; the matrix of $A$ becomes block upper triangular, so $g_i\le m_i$. Eigenspaces for distinct eigenvalues are independent, so their sum is direct, and $\sum m_i=n$. Hence $$\begin{aligned}A\ \text{is diagonalizable}&\iff \sum_{i=1}^s g_i=n\\&\iff g_i=m_i\quad(i=1,\dots,s).\end{aligned}$$ Indeed, $\sum g_i=n$ means the bases of the eigenspaces combine into $n$ linearly independent eigenvectors; since $\sum g_i\le\sum m_i=n$, equality holds exactly when every term is equal.

Having $n$ distinct eigenvalues is sufficient for diagonalizability: then $m_i=1$, while every eigenvalue has a nonzero eigenvector, so $g_i\ge1$ and hence $g_i=m_i=1$. It is not necessary: $E_n$ has only the eigenvalue $1$ with $m_1=n$, but $g_1=n$, and it is already diagonal. Example: $A=\begin{pmatrix}3&-1\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}$ has $f_A=(\lambda-4)(\lambda-2)$; taking $p_1=(1,-1)^T$ and $p_2=(1,1)^T$, the matrix $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}$ is invertible and $P^{-1}AP=\operatorname{diag}(4,2)$.

A typical non-diagonalizable matrix is $J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$: $f_J=(\lambda-1)^2$, so the algebraic multiplicity is $m_1=2$, but $g_1=2-r(J-E)=2-1=1$, hence $J$ is not diagonalizable. This also shows that equal eigenvalues are far weaker than similarity. When $A$ is diagonalizable, powers and polynomials simplify: $$A^k=P\Lambda^kP^{-1},\qquad f(A)=Pf(\Lambda)P^{-1};$$ if $A$ is invertible (all $\lambda_i\neq0$), then also $A^{-1}=P\Lambda^{-1}P^{-1}$. This reduces matrix multiplication to operations on diagonal entries.

formulas.note: 相似的定义：P 必须可逆；P 就是两组基之间的过渡矩阵，所以相似是同一个线性变换的两种写法。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of similarity: P must be invertible, and it is the transition matrix between two bases, so similar matrices are two descriptions of one transformation.

formulas.note: 可对角化的含义：P 的列依次是 Λ 对角元所对应的特征向量，次序必须对齐。
formulas.noteEn: What diagonalizability means: the columns of P are the eigenvectors matching the diagonal entries of Λ in order.

formulas.note: 相似矩阵的特征多项式相同（代入 B=P⁻¹AP 并用 |P⁻¹||P|=1），于是特征值、行列式、迹也全都相同。
formulas.noteEn: Similar matrices have the same characteristic polynomial (substitute B=P⁻¹AP and use |P⁻¹||P|=1), hence the same eigenvalues, determinant and trace.

formulas.note: 重数判据：每个特征值的几何重数 n−r(λᵢE−A) 都必须等于它的代数重数 mᵢ。由于几何重数 ≤ 代数重数，只需检查特征向量是否「掉维」。
formulas.noteEn: Multiplicity criterion: the geometric multiplicity n−r(λᵢE−A) must equal the algebraic multiplicity mᵢ for every eigenvalue. Since the geometric one never exceeds the algebraic one, one only checks for lost dimensions.

formulas.note: 对角化最实用的功能：求高次幂时把矩阵乘法换成对角元的 k 次幂再夹上 P、P⁻¹。
formulas.noteEn: The main use of diagonalization: for high powers, matrix multiplication is replaced by k-th powers of the diagonal entries, sandwiched by P and P⁻¹.

properties: 相似是等价关系（自反、对称、传递）；相似矩阵的特征多项式、特征值、行列式、迹、秩完全相同。
特征值相同（甚至特征多项式完全相同）不一定相似；相似是比「特征值相同」强得多的条件。
A 可对角化 ⟺ A 有 n 个线性无关的特征向量 ⟺ 每个特征值的几何重数等于代数重数。
n 个互异特征值是可对角化的充分条件，却不是必要条件（单位矩阵、数量矩阵都可对角化）。
若 A 可对角化，则 A^k 与 A 的多项式 f(A) 也可对角化，特征值为 λᵢ^k 与 f(λᵢ)；A 可逆时 A⁻¹ 也可对角化，特征值为 1/λᵢ。
propertiesEn: Similarity is an equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, transitive); similar matrices have identical characteristic polynomials, eigenvalues, determinants, traces and ranks.
Having the same eigenvalues — even the same characteristic polynomial — does not imply similarity; similarity is far stronger.
A is diagonalizable ⟺ A has n linearly independent eigenvectors ⟺ the geometric multiplicity of every eigenvalue equals its algebraic multiplicity.
Having n distinct eigenvalues is sufficient for diagonalizability but not necessary (the identity and scalar matrices are diagonalizable).
If A is diagonalizable, then so are A^k and every polynomial f(A), with eigenvalues λᵢ^k and f(λᵢ); and if A is invertible, so is A⁻¹, with eigenvalues 1/λᵢ.

examples.problem: 把 $A=\begin{pmatrix}3&-1\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}$ 对角化，即求可逆矩阵 $P$ 使 $P^{-1}AP$ 为对角矩阵。
examples.solution:
特征方程：$|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-3)^2-1=\lambda^2-6\lambda+8=0$，得 $\lambda_1=4$，$\lambda_2=2$（校验：$4+2=6=\operatorname{tr}(A)$ ✓，$4\times2=8=|A|=9-1$ ✓）。

$\lambda=4$：$4E-A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_1+x_2=0$，取 $p_1=(1,-1)^T$。

$\lambda=2$：$2E-A=\begin{pmatrix}-1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_1-x_2=0$，取 $p_2=(1,1)^T$。

令 $P=(p_1,p_2)=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}$，$\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(4,2)$，列与特征值次序一致。

代回验算：$|P|=2$，$P^{-1}=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$；$AP=\begin{pmatrix}4&2\\-4&2\end{pmatrix}$；$P^{-1}AP=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}8&0\\0&4\end{pmatrix}=\operatorname{diag}(4,2)$ ✓。

examples.problem: 说明 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 不可对角化，并解释为什么「特征值相同」不等于「相似」。
examples.solution:
特征方程 $|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-1)^2=0$，唯一特征值 $\lambda=1$（代数重数 2）。

解 $(E-A)x=0$：$E-A=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_2=0$，即特征子空间为 $\{(x_1,0)^T\}$，几何重数 1 < 代数重数 2，凑不齐 2 个线性无关的特征向量，所以 A 不可对角化。

另一方面，若 A 与 $E=\operatorname{diag}(1,1)$ 相似，则存在可逆 P 使 $A=PEP^{-1}=E$，与 $A\neq E$ 矛盾。可见 E 与 A 的特征值都是 1,1（特征多项式相同），却不相似——相似要求「连 Jordan 结构都一样」；A 的 Jordan 形就是 A 自己。

symmetric-matrix-diagonalization.definition:
若 $A^T=A$，就称 $A$ 是**实对称矩阵**。它是最「乖」的一类矩阵：不仅一定可对角化，而且能用**正交矩阵**对角化——存在正交矩阵 $Q$（$Q^TQ=E$）使 $Q^{T}AQ=Q^{-1}AQ=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$。由于 $Q^{-1}=Q^T$，这一个变换同时实现了「相似」与「合同」两种关系。

三条硬性质。第一，特征值全为实数：设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$（在复数范围内），由对称性与内积的性质得 $\lambda(\alpha,\alpha)=(A\alpha,\alpha)=(\alpha,A\alpha)=\bar{\lambda}(\alpha,\alpha)$，而 $(\alpha,\alpha)=|\alpha|^2>0$，故 $\lambda=\bar{\lambda}$。第二，属于不同特征值的特征向量**自动正交**：设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，$A\beta=\mu\beta$，$\lambda\neq\mu$，由 $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$ 得 $\lambda(\alpha,\beta)=\mu(\alpha,\beta)$，于是 $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha,\beta)=0$，只能 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$。

第三，$k$ 重特征值恰有 $k$ 个线性无关的特征向量（几何重数 = 代数重数），所以永远凑得齐 $n$ 个。实际操作时：对单重特征值取一个特征向量；对重特征值解 $(\lambda E-A)x=0$ 取基础解系，只需在这一个特征子空间内部做施密特正交化——不同特征值的向量之间已经正交，不必再管。

正交对角化是「无坐标偏袒」的分解：$A=Q\Lambda Q^{T}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\lambda_iq_iq_i^{T}$（**谱分解**），其中 $q_i$ 是标准正交特征向量。几何上它说明实对称矩阵只是沿着一组互相垂直的主轴做伸缩；统计学中的协方差矩阵、力学中的惯量张量、以及二次型化标准形都依赖它。反过来，能被正交矩阵对角化的实矩阵必为对称矩阵（因为它等于 $Q\Lambda Q^{T}$），所以这个性质是实对称矩阵的**特征刻画**。
symmetric-matrix-diagonalization.definitionEn:
A real matrix with $A^T=A$ is called **symmetric**. Such matrices are the best behaved of all: not only are they always diagonalizable, they can be diagonalized by an **orthogonal** matrix — there is an orthogonal $Q$ ($Q^TQ=E$) with $Q^{T}AQ=Q^{-1}AQ=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$. Since $Q^{-1}=Q^T$, this single transformation is simultaneously a similarity and a congruence.

Three rigid facts. First, all eigenvalues are real: let $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ with complex α; symmetry and the inner product give $\lambda(\alpha,\alpha)=(A\alpha,\alpha)=(\alpha,A\alpha)=\bar{\lambda}(\alpha,\alpha)$, and since $(\alpha,\alpha)=|\alpha|^2>0$ we get $\lambda=\bar{\lambda}$. Second, eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are **automatically orthogonal**: from $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$, $A\beta=\mu\beta$, $\lambda\neq\mu$ and $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$ we get $\lambda(\alpha,\beta)=\mu(\alpha,\beta)$, hence $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha,\beta)=0$ and therefore $(\alpha,\beta)=0$.

Third, an eigenvalue of multiplicity $k$ has exactly $k$ linearly independent eigenvectors (geometric multiplicity = algebraic multiplicity), so $n$ eigenvectors are always available. In practice: take one eigenvector for each simple eigenvalue; for a repeated eigenvalue solve $(\lambda E-A)x=0$, take a fundamental system, and apply Gram–Schmidt *inside that single eigenspace* — eigenvectors for different eigenvalues are already orthogonal and need no further work.

Orthogonal diagonalization is the coordinate-free decomposition $A=Q\Lambda Q^{T}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\lambda_iq_iq_i^{T}$ (the **spectral decomposition**), where the $q_i$ are orthonormal eigenvectors. Geometrically, a real symmetric matrix merely stretches space along a set of mutually perpendicular principal axes; covariance matrices in statistics, inertia tensors in mechanics and the reduction of quadratic forms all rely on it. Conversely, a real matrix diagonalized by an orthogonal matrix must be symmetric (it equals $Q\Lambda Q^{T}$), so this property characterizes symmetric matrices.
derivation: 设 $A\in M_n(\mathbb{R})$，$A^T=A$。把 $A$ 看作复矩阵，设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，$\alpha\in\mathbb{C}^n\setminus\{0\}$，并用复内积 $(\alpha,\beta)=\beta^H\alpha$。由 $A$ 实对称得 $A^H=A$，于是 $$\lambda\|\alpha\|^2=(A\alpha,\alpha)=\alpha^HA\alpha=(\alpha,A\alpha)=\bar\lambda\|\alpha\|^2.$$ 因为 $\|\alpha\|^2>0$，所以 $\lambda=\bar\lambda$，即实对称矩阵的特征值全为实数。

不同特征值的特征向量正交。设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，$A eta=\mu eta$，$\lambda
eq\mu$，$\alpha, eta
eq0$；由第 1 步 $\lambda,\mu$ 为实数，故可取实特征向量。对实向量用 $(x,y)=y^Tx$，由 $A^T=A$ 得 $$(A\alpha, eta)= eta^TA\alpha=(A eta)^T\alpha=(\alpha,A eta).$$ 左端为 $\lambda(\alpha, eta)$，右端为 $\mu(\alpha, eta)$，故 $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha, eta)=0$。由于 $\lambda
eq\mu$，只能 $(\alpha, eta)=0$。

存在性用对维数归纳。$n=1$ 显然。设 $n\ge2$，特征多项式在 $\mathbb{C}$ 上有根，由第 1 步该根为实数，取单位实特征向量 $q_1$，$Aq_1=\lambda_1q_1$。令 $W=q_1^\perp=\{x:(x,q_1)=0\}$，则 $\dim W=n-1$。若 $x\in W$，则 $$(Ax,q_1)=(x,Aq_1)=\lambda_1(x,q_1)=0,$$ 故 $Ax\in W$，即 $W$ 是 $A$-不变子空间。限制 $A|_W$ 仍是对称的，由归纳假设 $W$ 有由 $A$ 的特征向量组成的标准正交基 $q_2,\dots,q_n$。

于是 $q_1,\dots,q_n$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的标准正交基，且 $Aq_i=\lambda_iq_i$。令 $Q=(q_1,\dots,q_n)$，则 $Q^TQ=E$，$AQ=Q\Lambda$，其中 $\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$，所以 $$Q^TAQ=Q^{-1}AQ=\Lambda.$$ 因为 $Q^{-1}=Q^T$，同一个变换既是相似又是合同；对角元全为实数。这就是实对称矩阵的正交对角化。

上述构造给出 $n$ 个线性无关特征向量，因此每个特征值的几何重数都等于代数重数：若某个 $g_i<m_i$，则由 $\sum g_i=n=\sum m_i$ 与 $g_i\le m_i$ 会推出矛盾。等价地，$k$ 重特征值恰有 $k$ 维特征子空间。写成谱分解：$$A=Q\Lambda Q^T=\sum_{i=1}^n\lambda_iq_iq_i^T,$$ 其中 $q_iq_i^T$ 是到 $\operatorname{span}(q_i)$ 的正交投影，满足 $(q_iq_i^T)^2=q_iq_i^T$、$q_iq_i^Tq_jq_j^T=0\ (i\neq j)$ 以及 $\sum_iq_iq_i^T=E$。

逆命题：若存在正交矩阵 $Q$ 使 $Q^TAQ=\Lambda$ 为对角阵，则 $A=Q\Lambda Q^T$，从而 $$A^T=Q\Lambda^TQ^T=Q\Lambda Q^T=A,$$ 故 $A$ 实对称。因此「可正交对角化」是实对称矩阵的充分必要条件。例：$A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$，特征值 $3,1$，单位特征向量 $q_1=(1,1)^T/\sqrt2$、$q_2=(1,-1)^T/\sqrt2$，令 $Q=(q_1,q_2)$，则 $Q^TAQ=\operatorname{diag}(3,1)$。注意一般可对角化矩阵未必能正交对角化，例如 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$ 特征值互异却不对称。
derivationEn: Let $A\in M_n(\mathbb{R})$ with $A^T=A$. Regard $A$ as a complex matrix and let $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ with $\alpha\in\mathbb{C}^n\setminus\{0\}$, using the complex inner product $(\alpha,\beta)=\beta^H\alpha$. Since $A$ is real symmetric, $A^H=A$, and hence $$\lambda\|\alpha\|^2=(A\alpha,\alpha)=\alpha^HA\alpha=(\alpha,A\alpha)=\bar\lambda\|\alpha\|^2.$$ Because $\|\alpha\|^2>0$, it follows that $\lambda=\bar\lambda$: every eigenvalue of a real symmetric matrix is real.

Eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal. Let $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ and $A eta=\mu eta$ with $\lambda
eq\mu$ and $\alpha, eta
eq0$; by Step 1, $\lambda,\mu$ are real, so real eigenvectors may be chosen. For real vectors use $(x,y)=y^Tx$; from $A^T=A$, $$(A\alpha, eta)= eta^TA\alpha=(A eta)^T\alpha=(\alpha,A eta).$$ The left side is $\lambda(\alpha, eta)$ and the right side is $\mu(\alpha, eta)$, so $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha, eta)=0$. Since $\lambda
eq\mu$, we get $(\alpha, eta)=0$.

Existence is proved by induction on the dimension. The case $n=1$ is clear. For $n\ge2$, the characteristic polynomial has a complex root, which is real by Step 1; choose a unit real eigenvector $q_1$ with $Aq_1=\lambda_1q_1$. Let $W=q_1^\perp=\{x:(x,q_1)=0\}$, so $\dim W=n-1$. If $x\in W$, then $$(Ax,q_1)=(x,Aq_1)=\lambda_1(x,q_1)=0,$$ so $Ax\in W$; thus $W$ is $A$-invariant. The restriction $A|_W$ is still symmetric, and by induction $W$ has an orthonormal basis $q_2,\dots,q_n$ consisting of eigenvectors of $A$.

Therefore $q_1,\dots,q_n$ is an orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $Aq_i=\lambda_iq_i$. Let $Q=(q_1,\dots,q_n)$; then $Q^TQ=E$ and $AQ=Q\Lambda$, where $\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$, so $$Q^TAQ=Q^{-1}AQ=\Lambda.$$ Since $Q^{-1}=Q^T$, the same transformation is both a similarity and a congruence; all diagonal entries are real. This is orthogonal diagonalization of a real symmetric matrix.

The construction yields $n$ linearly independent eigenvectors, so every geometric multiplicity equals the corresponding algebraic multiplicity: if some $g_i<m_i$, then $\sum g_i=n=\sum m_i$ together with $g_i\le m_i$ would give a contradiction. Equivalently, an eigenvalue of multiplicity $k$ has a $k$-dimensional eigenspace. In spectral form, $$A=Q\Lambda Q^T=\sum_{i=1}^n\lambda_iq_iq_i^T,$$ where $q_iq_i^T$ is the orthogonal projection onto $\operatorname{span}(q_i)$, with $(q_iq_i^T)^2=q_iq_i^T$, $q_iq_i^Tq_jq_j^T=0$ for $i\neq j$, and $\sum_iq_iq_i^T=E$.

Converse: if an orthogonal $Q$ makes $Q^TAQ=\Lambda$ diagonal, then $A=Q\Lambda Q^T$, so $$A^T=Q\Lambda^TQ^T=Q\Lambda Q^T=A,$$ and $A$ is real symmetric. Thus, for real matrices, orthogonal diagonalizability is equivalent to symmetry. Example: $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ has eigenvalues $3,1$ and unit eigenvectors $q_1=(1,1)^T/\sqrt2$, $q_2=(1,-1)^T/\sqrt2$; with $Q=(q_1,q_2)$, $Q^TAQ=\operatorname{diag}(3,1)$. Note that a general diagonalizable matrix need not be orthogonally diagonalizable: $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$ has distinct eigenvalues but is not symmetric.

formulas.note: 实对称矩阵的定义；由它可推出特征值全为实数、不同特征值的特征向量正交。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of a real symmetric matrix; it implies that all eigenvalues are real and that eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.

formulas.note: 正交对角化：Q 的列是一组标准正交特征向量，对角元按列序与特征值一一对应；这里的相似变换与合同变换是同一个 Q。
formulas.noteEn: Orthogonal diagonalization: the columns of Q are orthonormal eigenvectors matching the diagonal entries in order; here similarity and congruence use the same Q.

formulas.note: 对称性在内积下的表现（一般地 (Aα,β)=(α,Aᵀβ)）；用它两步就能证明不同特征值的特征向量正交。
formulas.noteEn: How symmetry shows up in the inner product (in general (Aα,β)=(α,Aᵀβ)); it yields the orthogonality of eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues in two lines.

formulas.note: 谱分解：A 沿 n 个互相垂直的主轴分别伸缩 λᵢ 再叠加，qᵢ 是标准正交特征向量。
formulas.noteEn: Spectral decomposition: A stretches space by λᵢ along n mutually perpendicular principal axes, where the qᵢ are orthonormal eigenvectors.

formulas.note: 瑞利商总介于最小与最大特征值之间，是二次型正定性、极值与特征值估计的桥梁。
formulas.noteEn: The Rayleigh quotient always lies between the smallest and largest eigenvalues; it links quadratic forms, optimization and eigenvalue estimates.

properties: 实对称矩阵的特征值全部为实数，特征向量可以取实向量。
属于不同特征值的特征向量相互正交，不需要再做正交化。
k 重特征值恰有 k 个线性无关的特征向量（几何重数 = 代数重数），所以实对称矩阵必定可对角化。
存在正交矩阵 Q 使 QᵀAQ=Q⁻¹AQ=Λ；即实对称矩阵既可正交相似、也可正交合同于对角矩阵。
反过来，能正交对角化的实矩阵必为对称矩阵；对角化后对角元中正数的个数就是二次型的正惯性指数。
propertiesEn: All eigenvalues of a real symmetric matrix are real, and its eigenvectors can be chosen real.
Eigenvectors belonging to distinct eigenvalues are mutually orthogonal, so no further orthogonalization is needed.
An eigenvalue of multiplicity k has exactly k linearly independent eigenvectors (geometric multiplicity = algebraic multiplicity), so every real symmetric matrix is diagonalizable.
There exists an orthogonal Q with QᵀAQ=Q⁻¹AQ=Λ; that is, a real symmetric matrix is both orthogonally similar and orthogonally congruent to a diagonal matrix.
Conversely, any real matrix that can be orthogonally diagonalized must be symmetric; the number of positive diagonal entries is the positive inertia index of the associated quadratic form.

examples.problem: 求正交矩阵 $Q$ 把 $A=\begin{pmatrix}0&1&1\\1&0&1\\1&1&0\end{pmatrix}$ 对角化。
证明：实对称矩阵 $A$ 的不同特征值对应的特征向量相互正交。
examples.solution:
设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，$A\beta=\mu\beta$，其中 $\alpha,\beta\neq 0$，$\lambda\neq\mu$。

由 $A^T=A$ 得 $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A^T\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$。左端 $=(\lambda\alpha,\beta)=\lambda(\alpha,\beta)$，右端 $=(\alpha,\mu\beta)=\mu(\alpha,\beta)$。

于是 $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha,\beta)=0$。因为 $\lambda\neq\mu$，只能 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$，即 $\alpha\perp\beta$。

这个证明恰恰用到了对称性 $A^T=A$：一般矩阵没有 $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$ 这一步，结论也就不成立。由此还可知道，不同特征值的特征子空间两两正交。

quadratic-form-standard.definition:
只含二次项的 $n$ 元多项式 $$f(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\sum_{i,j=1}^{n}a_{ij}x_ix_j$$ 称为**二次型**。把它写成矩阵形式 $f=x^{T}Ax$ 时，**约定 $A$ 取对称矩阵**：平方项 $x_i^2$ 的系数直接放在对角线 $a_{ii}$ 上，交叉项 $x_ix_j$（$i\neq j$）的系数平分给 $a_{ij}$ 与 $a_{ji}$。这一步不能省：只有 $A$ 对称，二次型与矩阵才一一对应，特征值方法才可用。例如 $f=x_1^2+2x_1x_2+x_2^2$ 的矩阵是 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，而不是 $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$。

若二次型只含平方项 $d_1y_1^2+\cdots+d_ny_n^2$，就称它为**标准形**。作可逆线性变换 $x=Cy$，则 $f=x^{T}Ax=y^{T}(C^{T}AC)y$，即 $A$ 变成 $C^{T}AC$。这种「两边夹一个可逆矩阵」的关系叫**合同**，记作 $A\simeq C^{T}AC$。合同与相似（$P^{-1}AP$）是两种不同的关系：相似保持特征值，合同保持二次型的正负结构；而且只要 $A$ 对称，$C^{T}AC$ 自动对称（因为 $(C^{T}AC)^T=C^{T}A^{T}C=C^{T}AC$）。

**正交变换法**：由实对称矩阵的谱定理，取正交矩阵 $Q$ 使 $Q^{T}AQ=\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$，令 $x=Qy$ 便得 $f=\lambda_1y_1^2+\cdots+\lambda_ny_n^2$。此时标准形的系数**恰好是 $A$ 的特征值**，而且变换是旋转或反射（保持长度），讨论几何形状最方便；代价是要解特征方程。

**配方法（拉格朗日法）**：逐个变量把含它的项配成完全平方，再把剩下的变量集中处理。如果所有平方项系数都为 0（例如 $f=2x_1x_2$），先用可逆替换 $x_1=y_1+y_2$，$x_2=y_1-y_2$ 制造出平方项。关键要求是每一步替换都可逆——只要配方时除掉的系数非零、所用替换取三角形式或互逆形式，整体变换就可逆，二次型的秩不会改变。标准形一般不唯一，但由惯性定理，正、负平方项的个数（正、负惯性指数）是唯一确定的。
quadratic-form-standard.definitionEn:
A polynomial in $n$ variables containing only degree-two terms, $$f(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\sum_{i,j=1}^{n}a_{ij}x_ix_j$$ is called a **quadratic form**. When writing it as $f=x^{T}Ax$ we **require $A$ to be symmetric**: the coefficient of $x_i^2$ goes straight onto the diagonal entry $a_{ii}$, while the coefficient of a cross term $x_ix_j$ ($i\neq j$) is split equally between $a_{ij}$ and $a_{ji}$. This step cannot be skipped — only with symmetric $A$ do forms and matrices correspond one-to-one and do eigenvalue methods apply. For example, $f=x_1^2+2x_1x_2+x_2^2$ has matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$, never $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$.

If a quadratic form contains only squares, $d_1y_1^2+\cdots+d_ny_n^2$, it is called a **canonical form**. For an invertible linear change $x=Cy$ we get $f=x^{T}Ax=y^{T}(C^{T}AC)y$, i.e. $A$ is replaced by $C^{T}AC$. This sandwich relation is called **congruence**, written $A\simeq C^{T}AC$. Congruence and similarity ($P^{-1}AP$) are different relations: similarity preserves eigenvalues, congruence preserves the sign structure of the form; moreover, $C^{T}AC$ is automatically symmetric whenever $A$ is, since $(C^{T}AC)^T=C^{T}A^{T}C=C^{T}AC$.

The **orthogonal transformation method**: by the spectral theorem for real symmetric matrices there is an orthogonal $Q$ with $Q^{T}AQ=\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$; setting $x=Qy$ gives $f=\lambda_1y_1^2+\cdots+\lambda_ny_n^2$.
