eq\mu$，得 $(x,y)=0$。这说明正规矩阵的特征子空间两两正交，必要时只需在各子空间内部标准正交化。

特殊谱：Hermitian 矩阵满足 $$\lambda\|x\|^2=(Ax,x)=x^HAx\in\mathbb{R},$$ 故 $\lambda=\bar\lambda$；斜 Hermitian 矩阵满足 $x^HAx=-(Ax)^Hx=-\bar\lambda\|x\|^2$，故 $\lambda=-\bar\lambda$，即特征值为纯虚数；酉矩阵满足 $\|Ux\|=\|x\|$，故 $|\lambda|=1$。实对称矩阵是 Hermitian 的实特例，可正交对角化；一般实正规矩阵只能正交化为块对角形，非实特征值成共轭对，对应 $2\times2$ 旋转—伸缩块。反例：$B=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$ 特征值 $1,2$ 互异，故可对角化，但 $$B^TB=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&5\end{pmatrix}\neq\begin{pmatrix}2&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}=BB^T,$$ 故 $B$ 不正规，不能酉对角化。
derivationEn: On $\mathbb{C}^n$ use the inner product $(\alpha,\beta)=\beta^H\alpha$, where $A^H=\bar A^T$. A matrix $A$ is normal if $$A^HA=AA^H.$$ Hermitian matrices ($A^H=A$), skew-Hermitian matrices ($A^H=-A$) and unitary matrices ($U^HU=E$) are all normal: for the first two, both $A^HA$ and $AA^H$ equal $A^2$ or $-A^2$; for a unitary matrix both equal $E$. Thus normal matrices form a common generalization of these three classes.

Norm characterization: $$\|Ax\|^2=x^HA^HAx,\qquad \|A^Hx\|^2=x^HAA^Hx.$$ Let $B=A^HA-AA^H$; then $B^H=B$ and $$\|Ax\|^2-\|A^Hx\|^2=x^HBx.$$ If $A$ is normal, $B=0$ and the two norms are equal. Conversely, if $x^HBx=0$ for every $x$, the polarization identity for Hermitian forms $$y^HBx=\frac14\sum_{k=0}^{3}i^k(x+i^ky)^HB(x+i^ky)$$ gives $y^HBx=0$ for all $x,y$. Taking $y=Bx$ yields $\|Bx\|^2=(Bx)^HBx=0$, so $Bx=0$ for every $x$, hence $B=0$, i.e. $A^HA=AA^H$. Thus normality is equivalent to $\|Ax\|=\|A^Hx\|$ for all $x$.

One direction (unitary diagonalization $\Rightarrow$ normal): let $A=U\Lambda U^H$ with $U^HU=E$ and $\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$. Then $A^H=U\bar\Lambda U^H$, so $$A^HA=U\bar\Lambda\Lambda U^H,\qquad AA^H=U\Lambda\bar\Lambda U^H.$$ Diagonal matrices commute, and $\bar\Lambda\Lambda=\Lambda\bar\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(|\lambda_i|^2)$, so $A^HA=AA^H$ and $A$ is normal. In this case the columns of $U$ are orthonormal eigenvectors, $Au_i=\lambda_i u_i$.

Converse (normal $\Rightarrow$ unitarily diagonalizable): by Schur triangularization every complex matrix can be written $A=UTU^H$ with $U$ unitary and $T$ upper triangular whose diagonal entries are the eigenvalues. Unitary similarity preserves normality: $$T^HT=U^HA^HAU,\qquad TT^H=U^HAA^HU,$$ so $T$ is normal. Compare the $(1,1)$ entries of $T^HT$ and $TT^H$: the left side is $|t_{11}|^2$ (the first column has only $t_{11}$), while the right side is $\sum_{j=1}^n|t_{1j}|^2$; hence $t_{12}=\cdots=t_{1n}=0$. Thus the first row has only $t_{11}$; applying the same argument to the submatrix starting at row $2$, column $2$ (where $t_{12}=0$ ensures the second column has only $t_{22}$) gives $t_{23}=\cdots=t_{2n}=0$, and so on, until $T$ is diagonal. Therefore $A=UTU^H$ is unitarily diagonalizable.

Corollary: eigenvectors of a normal matrix belonging to distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal. Let $Ax=\lambda x$ and $Ay=\mu y$ with $x,y
eq0$ and $\lambda
eq\mu$. Since $A-\mu E$ is still normal, Step 2 gives $$ igl\|(A-\mu E)^Hy igr\|= igl\|(A-\mu E)y igr\|=0,$$ so $A^Hy= ar\mu y$. Therefore $$\lambda(x,y)=(Ax,y)=(x,A^Hy)=\mu(x,y),$$ i.e. $(\lambda-\mu)(x,y)=0$; since $\lambda
eq\mu$, $(x,y)=0$. Thus the eigenspaces of a normal matrix are mutually orthogonal, and orthonormalization is needed only inside each eigenspace.

Special spectra: for Hermitian $A$, $$\lambda\|x\|^2=(Ax,x)=x^HAx\in\mathbb{R},$$ so $\lambda=\bar\lambda$; for skew-Hermitian $A$, $x^HAx=-(Ax)^Hx=-\bar\lambda\|x\|^2$, so $\lambda=-\bar\lambda$, i.e. eigenvalues are purely imaginary; for unitary $A$, $\|Ux\|=\|x\|$ gives $|\lambda|=1$. A real symmetric matrix is the real Hermitian case and is orthogonally diagonalizable; a general real normal matrix can only be orthogonally reduced to block diagonal form, nonreal eigenvalues occurring in conjugate pairs and corresponding to $2\times2$ rotation-dilation blocks. Counterexample: $B=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$ has distinct eigenvalues $1,2$, hence is diagonalizable, but $$B^TB=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&5\end{pmatrix}\neq\begin{pmatrix}2&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}=BB^T,$$ so $B$ is not normal and cannot be unitarily diagonalized.

formulas.note: 复内积与共轭转置：内积对第一个变量线性、对第二个变量共轭线性。
formulas.noteEn: Complex inner product and conjugate transpose; the inner product is linear in the first argument and conjugate-linear in the second.

formulas.note: 正规矩阵的定义及其范数等价刻画：等式对一切向量 x 成立，当且仅当 A 正规。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of normality and its norm characterization: the equality holds for every vector x precisely when A is normal.

formulas.note: 谱定理：可酉对角化 ⟺ 正规。对角元就是特征值，U 的列构成标准正交特征向量组。
formulas.noteEn: Spectral theorem: unitarily diagonalizable iff normal. The diagonal entries are the eigenvalues and the columns of U form an orthonormal eigenbasis.

formulas.note: 谱定理「易方向」的证明：酉对角化蕴含正规。注意这一步不能漏，定理是充要条件。
formulas.noteEn: The easy direction of the spectral theorem: unitary diagonalizability implies normality — an implication that must not be omitted, since the theorem is an equivalence.

formulas.note: 特例对照：Hermitian 谱全实、斜 Hermitian 谱全纯虚、酉矩阵谱在单位圆上（实对称、实反对称、正交阵是其实数版本）。
formulas.noteEn: Spectra of the special classes: Hermitian (real), skew-Hermitian (purely imaginary), unitary (unit circle); real symmetric, skew-symmetric and orthogonal matrices are the real counterparts.

properties: 正规矩阵族：Hermitian、斜 Hermitian、酉矩阵都是正规矩阵，其实数版本（实对称、实反对称、正交阵）亦然；酉相似保持正规性。
谱定理：A 正规 ⟺ A 可酉对角化 ⟺ 存在由特征向量构成的标准正交基。可对角化本身不够：例如 [[1,1],[0,2]] 可对角化但不正规，不能被酉对角化。
Hermitian 特例：特征值全为实数；属于不同特征值的特征向量正交；把特征向量标准正交化即得酉阵 U 使 UᴴAU 为实对角阵。
酉矩阵特例：UᴴU = UUᴴ = E，保持内积与长度（(Ux,Uy)=(x,y)），特征值模全为 1，|det U| = 1。
实情形的差异：实对称阵可被正交矩阵对角化（谱全实）；一般实正规阵只能正交化为块对角形，非实特征值成共轭对出现，对应 2×2 旋转–伸缩块。
propertiesEn: The normal family: Hermitian, skew-Hermitian and unitary matrices are normal, as are their real counterparts (symmetric, skew-symmetric, orthogonal); unitary similarity preserves normality.

Spectral theorem: A is normal iff A is unitarily diagonalizable iff it has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors. Mere diagonalizability is not enough — [[1,1],[0,2]] is diagonalizable but not normal, hence not unitarily diagonalizable.
Hermitian case: all eigenvalues are real; eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal; normalizing them yields a unitary U with UᴴAU real diagonal.
Unitary case: UᴴU = UUᴴ = E, so inner products and lengths are preserved ((Ux,Uy)=(x,y)); all eigenvalues have modulus 1 and |det U| = 1.

Real versus complex: a real symmetric matrix is orthogonally diagonalizable (real spectrum); a general real normal matrix can only be brought by an orthogonal matrix to block diagonal form, nonreal conjugate eigenvalue pairs giving 2×2 rotation-scaling blocks.

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1+i\\1-i&3\end{pmatrix}$。验证 $A$ 是 Hermitian 矩阵，并求酉阵 $U$ 使 $U^{H}AU$ 为对角阵。
examples.solution:
$A^{H}=\begin{pmatrix}2&\overline{1-i}\\\overline{1+i}&3\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2&1+i\\1-i&3\end{pmatrix}=A$，故 $A$ 是 Hermitian 矩阵。
特征多项式 $\det(\lambda E-A)=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-3)-|1+i|^{2}=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-3)-2=\lambda^{2}-5\lambda+4$，特征值为 $\lambda_1=4,\ \lambda_2=1$。
$\lambda=4$：$(A-4E)=\begin{pmatrix}-2&1+i\\1-i&-1\end{pmatrix}$，取特征向量 $v_1=(1+i,\ 2)^{T}$。
$\lambda=1$：$(A-E)=\begin{pmatrix}1&1+i\\1-i&2\end{pmatrix}$，取特征向量 $v_2=(-1-i,\ 1)^{T}$。
正交性验证：$(v_1,v_2)=v_2^{H}v_1=\overline{(-1-i)}(1+i)+2=(-1+i)(1+i)+2=-2+2=0$。长度：$\|v_1\|^{2}=6$，$\|v_2\|^{2}=3$。
单位化 $u_1=v_1/\sqrt{6}$，$u_2=v_2/\sqrt{3}$，令 $U=(u_1\ u_2)$，则 $U^{H}U=E$ 且 $U^{H}AU=\operatorname{diag}(4,1)$。数值复核：$U^{H}AU=\begin{pmatrix}4&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的偏差小于 $10^{-15}$。

examples.problem: 判定 $B=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$ 是否可对角化、是否正规，并说明与谱定理的关系。
examples.solution: $B$ 的特征值为 1 与 2，互异，故 $B$ 可对角化。但 $B^{H}B=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&5\end{pmatrix}$，$BB^{H}=\begin{pmatrix}2&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}$，两者不相等，故 $B$ 不是正规矩阵。由谱定理，$B$ 不可能被酉矩阵对角化。这说明「可对角化」严格弱于「可酉对角化」，谱定理中正规性条件是本质的。

matrix-functions.definition:
把标量函数 $f$ 作用到方阵 $A$ 上有两条等价路线。**幂级数路线**：若 $f(z)=\sum_{k\ge0}c_kz^{k}$ 的收敛半径大于 $A$ 的谱半径 $\rho(A)$，则定义 $f(A)=\sum_{k\ge0}c_kA^{k}$（逐元素绝对收敛）；典型例子 $e^{A}=\sum_{k\ge0}A^{k}/k!$ 对一切复方阵都收敛。**谱上插值路线**：求次数小于 $\deg m_A$ 的多项式 $p$，使在每个特征值 $\lambda_i$ 处 $p$ 与 $f$ 的各阶导数（直到 $\lambda_i$ 在最小多项式中的重数减 1 阶）完全相等，然后规定 $f(A)=p(A)$；由 Hermite 插值，这样的 $p$ 存在且唯一。两种定义在公共适用范围内给出同一个矩阵。

两条常用计算路线：若 $A$ 可对角化，$A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$，则 $f(A)=P\operatorname{diag}\big(f(\lambda_1),\dots,f(\lambda_n)\big)P^{-1}$；若含若尔当块 $J_m(\lambda)$，则 $f(J_m(\lambda))$ 是上三角矩阵，主对角线为 $f(\lambda)$，第 $k$ 条上副对角线为 $f^{(k)}(\lambda)/k!$（$k=1,\dots,m-1$）——位置与阶乘都不能错。

矩阵指数 $e^{tA}$ 给出 $x'=Ax$ 的基解矩阵（$t=1$ 时即最重要的矩阵函数 $e^{A}$）：$e^{A}$ 恒可逆、$\det e^{A}=e^{\operatorname{tr}A}$，当 $AB=BA$ 时满足指数律 $e^{A+B}=e^{A}e^{B}$。交换性条件在一般情形下不可省（$AB\ne BA$ 时通常两边不等），但它并不是必要条件：确有 $AB\ne BA$ 而 $e^{A+B}=e^{A}e^{B}$ 的特例。矩阵对数与平方根没有无条件的存在性，本节点只使用充分情形：当 $A$ 可对角化且特征值落在所选分支的定义域内时，$\ln A=P\ln(\Lambda)P^{-1}$、$\sqrt{A}=P\sqrt{\Lambda}P^{-1}$。
matrix-functions.definitionEn:
There are two equivalent routes for applying a scalar function $f$ to a square matrix $A$. The **power series route**: if $f(z)=\sum_{k\ge0}c_kz^{k}$ has radius of convergence larger than the spectral radius $\rho(A)$, define $f(A)=\sum_{k\ge0}c_kA^{k}$ (absolute entrywise convergence); the model case $e^{A}=\sum_{k\ge0}A^{k}/k!$ converges for every complex matrix. The **interpolation route**: find a polynomial $p$ of degree less than $\deg m_A$ such that at each eigenvalue $\lambda_i$ the values of $p$ and its derivatives agree with those of $f$ up to order (multiplicity of $\lambda_i$ in the minimal polynomial minus 1), and set $f(A)=p(A)$; by Hermite interpolation such a $p$ exists and is unique. On the common domain the two definitions agree.

Two computational routes dominate. If $A$ is diagonalizable, $A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$, then $f(A)=P\operatorname{diag}\big(f(\lambda_1),\dots,f(\lambda_n)\big)P^{-1}$. If $A$ contains a Jordan block $J_m(\lambda)$, then $f(J_m(\lambda))$ is upper triangular with $f(\lambda)$ on the diagonal and $f^{(k)}(\lambda)/k!$ along the $k$-th superdiagonal ($k=1,\dots,m-1$) — the position and the factorial both matter.

The matrix exponential $e^{tA}$ gives the fundamental matrix of $x'=Ax$ ($t=1$ yields $e^{A}$, the most important matrix function): $e^{A}$ is always invertible, $\det e^{A}=e^{\operatorname{tr}A}$, and the law of exponents $e^{A+B}=e^{A}e^{B}$ holds whenever $AB=BA$. Commutativity cannot be dropped in general ($AB\ne BA$ usually gives two different matrices), yet it is not necessary: there are examples with $AB\ne BA$ and $e^{A+B}=e^{A}e^{B}$. Matrix logarithms and square roots have no unconditional existence; only sufficient cases are used here: if $A$ is diagonalizable with eigenvalues inside the chosen branch of the domain, then $\ln A=P\ln(\Lambda)P^{-1}$ and $\sqrt{A}=P\sqrt{\Lambda}P^{-1}$.
derivation: 设 $f(z)=\sum_{k=0}^\infty c_kz^k$ 的收敛半径为 $R$，$A$ 为复方阵，谱半径 $\rho(A)<R$。定义 $$f(A)=\sum_{k=0}^\infty c_kA^k.$$ 收敛性由若尔当标准形看出：若 $A=PJP^{-1}$，$J$ 的每个块 $J_m(\lambda)=\lambda I+N$，则 $J_m(\lambda)^k=\sum_{j=0}^{m-1}\binom{k}{j}\lambda^{k-j}N^j$，其元素是 $\lambda^{k-j}$ 乘以 $k$ 的多项式；因 $|\lambda|\le\rho(A)<R$，级数逐元素绝对收敛。特别地 $e^A=\sum_{k\ge0}A^k/k!$ 对一切复方阵收敛（$R=\infty$）。

谱上插值：设最小多项式 $m_A(z)=\prod_{i=1}^s(z-\lambda_i)^{m_i}$，$\lambda_i$ 互异。若 $f$ 在谱上足够光滑（在 $\lambda_i$ 的邻域内有直到 $m_i-1$ 阶的导数），取次数小于 $\deg m_A=\sum_i m_i$ 的多项式 $p$，满足 $$p^{(j)}(\lambda_i)=f^{(j)}(\lambda_i),\qquad 0\le j<m_i,\quad i=1,\dots,s.$$ 这是 Hermite 插值问题，共有 $\sum_i m_i=\deg m_A$ 个条件，故 $p$ 存在且唯一；定义 $f(A)=p(A)$。若 $q(A)=0$，则 $m_A\mid q$，所以两个插值多项式之差在 $A$ 处为零，$f(A)$ 不依赖 $p$ 的选取。幂级数定义在公共适用范围内与它一致：在若尔当块上，幂级数展开只用到 $f$ 在特征值处的这些导数，而 $p$ 的插值条件保证展开相同。

若尔当块 $J_m(\lambda)=\lambda I+N$，$N$ 是第 $1$ 条上副对角线为 $1$、其余为 $0$ 的幂零矩阵，$N^m=0$ 且 $N^k$ 的第 $k$ 条上副对角线为 $1$。对在 $\lambda$ 附近解析的 $f$，Taylor 展开给出 $$f(J_m(\lambda))=\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}\frac{f^{(k)}(\lambda)}{k!}N^k,$$ 即主对角线为 $f(\lambda)$，第 $k$ 条上副对角线为 $f^{(k)}(\lambda)/k!$（$k=1,\dots,m-1$），其余为 $0$。位置与阶乘必须对应：把 $f'(\lambda)$ 放到第二条上副对角线，或漏掉 $1/k!$，都会得到错误的矩阵。

若 $A$ 可对角化，$A=P\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)P^{-1}$，则对任意多项式 $p$ 有 $p(A)=P\operatorname{diag}(p(\lambda_1),\dots,p(\lambda_n))P^{-1}$；取插值多项式即得 $$f(A)=P\operatorname{diag}(f(\lambda_1),\dots,f(\lambda_n))P^{-1}.$$ 更一般地 $f(P^{-1}AP)=P^{-1}f(A)P$。例：$J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}=I+N$，$N^2=0$，故 $e^J=e^{I+N}=e^{I}e^{N}=e(I+N)=\begin{pmatrix}e&e\\0&e\end{pmatrix}$；这也与若尔当块公式（对角线 $e$、上副对角线 $e$）一致。

矩阵指数 $e^A=\sum_{k\ge0}A^k/k!$ 对一切复方阵收敛，且 $e^O=I$。由 Cauchy 乘积与二项式定理（$A$ 与 $-A$ 交换），$$e^Ae^{-A}=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{1}{n!}(A-A)^n=I,$$ 故 $e^A$ 恒可逆，$(e^A)^{-1}=e^{-A}$。若用 Schur 三角化 $A=UTU^*$（$U$ 酉、$T$ 上三角），则 $e^A=Ue^TU^*$，而 $e^T$ 的对角元为 $e^{t_{ii}}$，于是 $$\det e^A=\prod_i e^{t_{ii}}=e^{\sum_i t_{ii}}=e^{\operatorname{tr}A}.$$ 又对 $t\in\mathbb{R}$，$$\frac{d}{dt}e^{tA}=Ae^{tA}=e^{tA}A,$$ 因为 $A$ 与 $e^{tA}$ 交换；因此 $e^{tA}$ 是 $x'=Ax$ 的基解矩阵。

指数律：若 $AB=BA$，则 $e^{A+B}=e^Ae^B$。证明：由二项式定理，$$\begin{aligned}e^Ae^B&=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{1}{n!}\sum_{k=0}^n\binom{n}{k}A^kB^{n-k}\\ &=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{(A+B)^n}{n!}=e^{A+B},\end{aligned}$$ 其中重排由绝对收敛保证；若 $AB\ne BA$，二项式定理一般不再成立。交换性只是充分条件，不是必要条件：取 $A=\operatorname{diag}(0,2\pi i)$、$B=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\0&2\pi i\end{pmatrix}$。则 $e^A=I$；由 $B^2=2\pi iB$ 得 $e^B=I+\frac{e^{2\pi i}-1}{2\pi i}B=I$；同理 $(A+B)^2=4\pi i(A+B)$ 给出 $e^{A+B}=I$。但 $$AB=\begin{pmatrix}0&0\\0&-4\pi^2\end{pmatrix}\ne BA=\begin{pmatrix}0&2\pi i\\0&-4\pi^2\end{pmatrix},$$ 故 $e^{A+B}=e^Ae^B$ 仍成立。
derivationEn: Let $f(z)=\sum_{k=0}^\infty c_kz^k$ have radius of convergence $R$, let $A$ be a complex square matrix, and assume $\rho(A)<R$. Define $$f(A)=\sum_{k=0}^\infty c_kA^k.$$ Convergence is visible from the Jordan form: if $A=PJP^{-1}$ and a Jordan block is $J_m(\lambda)=\lambda I+N$, then $J_m(\lambda)^k=\sum_{j=0}^{m-1}\binom{k}{j}\lambda^{k-j}N^j$, whose entries are $\lambda^{k-j}$ times a polynomial in $k$. Since $|\lambda|\le\rho(A)<R$, the series converges absolutely entrywise. In particular, $e^A=\sum_{k\ge0}A^k/k!$ converges for every complex matrix ($R=\infty$).

Spectral interpolation: let the minimal polynomial be $m_A(z)=\prod_{i=1}^s(z-\lambda_i)^{m_i}$ with distinct $\lambda_i$. If $f$ is sufficiently smooth on the spectrum (having derivatives up to order $m_i-1$ in a neighborhood of $\lambda_i$), take a polynomial $p$ of degree less than $\deg m_A=\sum_i m_i$ satisfying $$p^{(j)}(\lambda_i)=f^{(j)}(\lambda_i),\qquad 0\le j<m_i,\quad i=1,\dots,s.$$ This is a Hermite interpolation problem with $\sum_i m_i=\deg m_A$ conditions, so $p$ exists and is unique; define $f(A)=p(A)$. If $q(A)=0$, then $m_A\mid q$, so the difference of two interpolating polynomials vanishes at $A$, and $f(A)$ does not depend on the choice of $p$. The power-series definition agrees with this one on the common domain: on a Jordan block, the power series expansion uses only these derivatives of $f$ at the eigenvalues, and the interpolation conditions force the same expansion.

For a Jordan block $J_m(\lambda)=\lambda I+N$, $N$ is the nilpotent matrix with $1$ on the first superdiagonal and $0$ elsewhere; $N^m=0$, and $N^k$ has $1$ on the $k$-th superdiagonal. For $f$ analytic near $\lambda$, Taylor expansion gives $$f(J_m(\lambda))=\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}\frac{f^{(k)}(\lambda)}{k!}N^k,$$ so the diagonal is $f(\lambda)$, the $k$-th superdiagonal is $f^{(k)}(\lambda)/k!$ for $k=1,\dots,m-1$, and all other entries are $0$. Position and factorial must match: putting $f'(\lambda)$ on the second superdiagonal, or omitting $1/k!$, gives the wrong matrix.

If $A$ is diagonalizable, $A=P\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)P^{-1}$, then every polynomial $p$ satisfies $p(A)=P\operatorname{diag}(p(\lambda_1),\dots,p(\lambda_n))P^{-1}$; choosing the interpolating polynomial gives $$f(A)=P\operatorname{diag}(f(\lambda_1),\dots,f(\lambda_n))P^{-1}.$$ More generally, $f(P^{-1}AP)=P^{-1}f(A)P$. Example: $J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}=I+N$ with $N^2=0$, so $e^J=e^{I+N}=e^{I}e^{N}=e(I+N)=\begin{pmatrix}e&e\\0&e\end{pmatrix}$, consistent with the Jordan-block formula (diagonal $e$, first superdiagonal $e$).

The matrix exponential $e^A=\sum_{k\ge0}A^k/k!$ converges for every complex matrix, and $e^O=I$. By the Cauchy product and the binomial theorem ($A$ and $-A$ commute), $$e^Ae^{-A}=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{1}{n!}(A-A)^n=I,$$ so $e^A$ is always invertible, with $(e^A)^{-1}=e^{-A}$. Using a Schur triangularization $A=UTU^*$ ($U$ unitary, $T$ upper triangular), we get $e^A=Ue^TU^*$, and the diagonal entries of $e^T$ are $e^{t_{ii}}$, hence $$\det e^A=\prod_i e^{t_{ii}}=e^{\sum_i t_{ii}}=e^{\operatorname{tr}A}.$$ Also, for $t\in\mathbb{R}$, $$\frac{d}{dt}e^{tA}=Ae^{tA}=e^{tA}A,$$ because $A$ commutes with $e^{tA}$; thus $e^{tA}$ is a fundamental matrix for $x'=Ax$.

Law of exponents: if $AB=BA$, then $e^{A+B}=e^Ae^B$. Proof: the binomial theorem gives $$\begin{aligned}e^Ae^B&=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{1}{n!}\sum_{k=0}^n\binom{n}{k}A^kB^{n-k}\\ &=\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{(A+B)^n}{n!}=e^{A+B},\end{aligned}$$ where rearrangement is justified by absolute convergence; if $AB\ne BA$, the binomial theorem fails in general. Commutativity is sufficient but not necessary: take $A=\operatorname{diag}(0,2\pi i)$ and $B=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\0&2\pi i\end{pmatrix}$. Then $e^A=I$; from $B^2=2\pi iB$ we get $e^B=I+\frac{e^{2\pi i}-1}{2\pi i}B=I$; similarly $(A+B)^2=4\pi i(A+B)$ gives $e^{A+B}=I$. But $$AB=\begin{pmatrix}0&0\\0&-4\pi^2\end{pmatrix}\ne BA=\begin{pmatrix}0&2\pi i\\0&-4\pi^2\end{pmatrix},$$ so $e^{A+B}=e^Ae^B$ still holds.

formulas.note: 幂级数路线：把标量幂级数中的 z 换成 A；收敛半径超过谱半径时绝对收敛。
formulas.noteEn: Power series route: substitute A for z; convergence is absolute when the radius of convergence exceeds the spectral radius ρ(A).

formulas.note: 谱上插值路线：m_i 是特征值 λ_i 在最小多项式中的重数；次数小于 deg m_A 时 p 由 Hermite 插值唯一确定。
formulas.noteEn: Interpolation route: m_i is the multiplicity of λ_i in the minimal polynomial; for deg p < deg m_A the polynomial p is the unique Hermite interpolant.

formulas.note: 可对角化时的公式：先对每个特征值算 f，拼成对角阵，再共轭回去。
formulas.noteEn: Diagonalizable case: evaluate f at each eigenvalue, form the diagonal matrix, and conjugate back.

formulas.note: 若尔当块公式：主对角线 f(λ)，第 k 条上副对角线全为 f⁽ᵏ⁾(λ)/k!，导数阶数与位置一一对应。
formulas.noteEn: Jordan block formula: f(λ) on the diagonal and f⁽ᵏ⁾(λ)/k! along the k-th superdiagonal — derivative order and position match exactly.

formulas.note: 矩阵指数公式包：级数定义、行列式恒等式、交换时的指数律（交换是充分条件，并非必要条件）。
formulas.noteEn: The basic package for the matrix exponential: series definition, determinant identity, and the law of exponents when A and B commute (commutativity is sufficient, not necessary).

properties: 基本事实：e^A 对一切复方阵收敛，恒可逆且 (e^A)⁻¹ = e^{−A}；e^O = E；det e^A = e^{tr A}（A 为实矩阵时行列式为正）；e^{tA} 是 x′ = Ax 的基解矩阵。
指数律与交换性：AB = BA 时 e^{A+B} = e^A e^B；一般 AB ≠ BA 时 e^{A+B} ≠ e^A e^B，例如 A=[[0,1],[0,0]]、B=[[0,0],[1,0]] 时 e^Ae^B = [[2,1],[1,1]] 而 e^{A+B} = [[cosh 1, sinh 1],[sinh 1, cosh 1]]。

交换性的充分条件：AB = BA ⟹ e^Ae^B = e^Be^A（充分，但**不必要**——指数映射不是单射：存在 AB ≠ BA 而 e^Ae^B = e^Be^A 的例子，如 A=diag(0,2πi)、B=[[0,1],[0,2πi]] 时 e^A=e^B=E）；它也不适用于求和公式——存在 AB ≠ BA 而 e^{A+B} = e^Ae^B 的特例（同例中三者指数同为 E），故「AB=BA」对求和公式同样只是充分条件。
一般性质：f(P⁻¹AP) = P⁻¹f(A)P；f(A) 由 f 在谱上的取值与各阶导数值唯一决定；f 在谱上解析时有谱映射 σ(f(A)) = f(σ(A))。
对数与平方根（充分情形）：A 可对角化且特征值在所选分支定义域内时 ln A = P ln(Λ) P⁻¹，且 e^{ln A} = A；平方根同理。一般矩阵的存在性取决于谱结构与分支选择，需单独讨论。
propertiesEn: Basic facts: e^A converges for every complex matrix, is always invertible with (e^A)⁻¹ = e^{−A}; e^O = E; det e^A = e^{tr A} (positive for real A); e^{tA} is the fundamental matrix of x′ = Ax.

Law of exponents and commutativity: if AB = BA then e^{A+B} = e^A e^B; for general non-commuting A, B one has e^{A+B} ≠ e^A e^B — e.g. for A=[[0,1],[0,0]] and B=[[0,0],[1,0]], e^Ae^B = [[2,1],[1,1]] while e^{A+B} = [[cosh 1, sinh 1],[sinh 1, cosh 1]].

Sufficient condition for commuting exponentials: AB = BA ⟹ e^Ae^B = e^Be^A (sufficient, but not necessary — the exponential map is not injective: there are pairs with AB ≠ BA but e^Ae^B = e^Be^A, e.g. A=diag(0,2πi), B=[[0,1],[0,2πi]] give e^A=e^B=E); it does not transfer to the sum formula either — there exist pairs with AB ≠ BA and e^{A+B} = e^Ae^B (in the same example all three exponentials equal E), so commutativity is only sufficient there as well.
General properties: f(P⁻¹AP) = P⁻¹f(A)P; f(A) is determined by the values and derivatives of f on the spectrum; when f is analytic on the spectrum, σ(f(A)) = f(σ(A)).

Logarithms and square roots (sufficient cases): if A is diagonalizable with eigenvalues inside the chosen branch of the domain, then ln A = P ln(Λ) P⁻¹ and e^{ln A} = A; similarly for square roots. Existence for general matrices depends on the Jordan structure and branch choices and needs separate discussion.

examples.problem: 设 $J=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$。用若尔当块上的公式计算 $e^{J}$，并验证 $\det e^{J}=e^{\operatorname{tr}J}$。
examples.solution:
$J=E+N$，其中 $N=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$ 满足 $N^{2}=O$。按若尔当块公式（主对角线 $e^{\lambda}$，上副对角线 $(e^{\lambda})'=e^{\lambda}$）：$e^{J}=\begin{pmatrix}e&e\\0&e\end{pmatrix}=e\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$。
级数复核：$E$ 与 $N$ 交换，故 $e^{J}=e^{E+N}=e^{E}e^{N}=e(E+N)$，与公式一致；数值上 $e^{J}\approx\begin{pmatrix}2.7182818&2.7182818\\0&2.7182818\end{pmatrix}$。
$\operatorname{tr}J=2$，$\det e^{J}=e\cdot e-0=e^{2}=e^{\operatorname{tr}J}$，验证成立。

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\-2&-3\end{pmatrix}$。用对角化方法计算 $e^{A}$，并验证 $\det e^{A}=e^{\operatorname{tr}A}$。
examples.solution:
$f_A(\lambda)=\lambda^{2}+3\lambda+2=(\lambda+1)(\lambda+2)$，特征值为 $-1$ 与 $-2$。取 $\lambda=-1$ 的特征向量 $v_1=(1,-1)^{T}$，$\lambda=-2$ 的特征向量 $v_2=(1,-2)^{T}$，则 $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\-1&-2\end{pmatrix}$，$P^{-1}=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\-1&-1\end{pmatrix}$。
于是 $e^{A}=P\operatorname{diag}(e^{-1},e^{-2})P^{-1}=\begin{pmatrix}2e^{-1}-e^{-2}&e^{-1}-e^{-2}\\-2e^{-1}+2e^{-2}&-e^{-1}+2e^{-2}\end{pmatrix}$，数值约为 $\begin{pmatrix}0.6004236&0.2325442\\-0.4650883&-0.0972089\end{pmatrix}$，与直接对 $A$ 做数值矩阵指数一致。
$\operatorname{tr}A=-3$，而 $\det e^{A}=(2e^{-1}-e^{-2})(-e^{-1}+2e^{-2})-(e^{-1}-e^{-2})(-2e^{-1}+2e^{-2})=e^{-3}=e^{\operatorname{tr}A}$，验证成立。

generalized-inverse.definition:
普通逆矩阵只对可逆方阵存在（要求 $A$ 是方阵且 $|A|\ne0$）；但应用中大量出现奇异方阵或矩形矩阵（$m\times n$，$m\ne n$），它们没有双边逆。**广义逆**的思路是只要求「部分逆」的性质，其中应用最广的是 **Moore–Penrose 广义逆** $A^{+}$：它是满足下述四条 Penrose 方程的 $n\times m$ 矩阵。四条方程的解**存在且唯一**——奇异、矩形一律适用。

四条方程的几何含义：后两条要求 $AA^{+}$ 与 $A^{+}A$ 都是 **Hermitian 矩阵**，与前面的投影条件合起来，它们实际上是**正交投影**；前两条保证 $A^{+}$ 在 $A$ 的行空间上与真逆的作用相同、在零空间上取零。计算方面最好用奇异值分解：若 $A=U\Sigma V^{H}$，则 $A^{+}=V\Sigma^{+}U^{H}$，只需把非零奇异值取倒数并转置形状。若 $A$ 可逆则 $A^{+}=A^{-1}$；满列秩时 $A^{+}=(A^{H}A)^{-1}A^{H}$（左逆）；满行秩时 $A^{+}=A^{H}(AA^{H})^{-1}$（右逆）——两个条件不能互混。

最重要的应用是最小二乘：对任意 $b$，$x^{+}=A^{+}b$ 既是 $\min\|Ax-b\|$ 的解，又是所有极小解中范数最小者；当 $A$ 秩亏、最小二乘解不唯一时这一点尤其关键，它把「解集」收敛为唯一向量。使用时务必注意：$(AB)^{+}$ 一般**不等于** $B^{+}A^{+}$（只有 $A$ 满列秩且 $B$ 满行秩等附加条件下反序律才成立），而 $(A^{+})^{+}=A$、$(A^{H})^{+}=(A^{+})^{H}$ 是无条件成立的。
generalized-inverse.definitionEn:
The ordinary inverse exists only for invertible square matrices ($A$ square with $|A|\ne0$); yet applications abound with singular square matrices or rectangular ones ($m\times n$, $m\ne n$), which have no two-sided inverse. The idea of a **generalized inverse** is to require only a partial inverse. The most useful one is the **Moore–Penrose inverse** $A^{+}$: the $n\times m$ matrix satisfying the four Penrose equations below. Such a matrix **exists and is unique** — singular or rectangular, no matter.

The four equations have a geometric reading: the last two demand that $AA^{+}$ and $A^{+}A$ be **Hermitian**, which together with the projection-type identities makes them **orthogonal projections**; the first two force $A^{+}$ to act like the true inverse on the row space of $A$ and to kill the null space. Computationally the singular value decomposition is ideal: if $A=U\Sigma V^{H}$ then $A^{+}=V\Sigma^{+}U^{H}$ — just invert the nonzero singular values and transpose the shape. If $A$ is invertible, $A^{+}=A^{-1}$; if $A$ has full column rank, $A^{+}=(A^{H}A)^{-1}A^{H}$ (left inverse); if $A$ has full row rank, $A^{+}=A^{H}(AA^{H})^{-1}$ (right inverse) — the two hypotheses must not be mixed up.

The most important application is least squares: for every $b$, the vector $x^{+}=A^{+}b$ minimizes $\|Ax-b\|$ and, among all minimizers, has the smallest norm; this matters especially when $A$ is rank-deficient and least-squares solutions are not unique, since it collapses the solution set into a single vector. Two warnings: $(AB)^{+}$ is generally **not** $B^{+}A^{+}$ (the reverse-order law needs extra hypotheses such as $A$ of full column rank and $B$ of full row rank), whereas $(A^{+})^{+}=A$ and $(A^{H})^{+}=(A^{+})^{H}$ hold unconditionally.
derivation: 设 $A\in\mathbb C^{m\times n}$。若 $X\in\mathbb C^{n\times m}$ 满足四条 **Penrose 方程** $$\begin{aligned}&(1)\ AXA=A,\\&(2)\ XAX=X,\\&(3)\ (AX)^{\mathrm H}=AX,\\&(4)\ (XA)^{\mathrm H}=XA,\end{aligned}$$ 则称 $X=A^{+}$ 为 $A$ 的 **Moore–Penrose 广义逆**。形状必须匹配：$A$ 是 $m\times n$，$A^{+}$ 必须是 $n\times m$，这样 $AX$ 为 $m$ 阶、$XA$ 为 $n$ 阶，Hermitian 条件才有意义。对任意矩阵（奇异、矩形、零矩阵）四条方程的解存在且唯一。当 $A$ 可逆时，仅 $(1)(2)$ 就迫使 $X=A^{-1}$；广义逆多出两条 Hermitian 条件，正是为了在秩亏或矩形情形下仍然锁定唯一解。

唯一性证明。设 $X,Y$ 都满足四条方程。先证 $AX=AY$：由 $(1)(2)$，
$$(AX)^2=AXAX=A(XAX)=AX,$$
且 $(AX)^{\mathrm H}=AX$，故 $AX$ 是 Hermitian 幂等阵；它的像含于 $\operatorname{col}(A)$，而在 $\operatorname{col}(A)$ 上恒等（对 $v=Au$，$AXv=AXAu=Au=v$），所以 $AX$ 是到 $\operatorname{col}(A)$ 的正交投影。同理 $AY$ 也是到同一子空间的正交投影，而正交投影由子空间唯一确定，故 $AX=AY$。
再证 $XA=YA$：$XA$ 是 Hermitian 幂等阵，且 $\operatorname{col}(XA)=\operatorname{col}(X)$（由 $X=XAX$）。又
$$X=(XA)^{\mathrm H}X=A^{\mathrm H}X^{\mathrm H}X,$$
故 $\operatorname{col}(X)\subseteq\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$；而 $A=AXA$ 与 $X=XAX$ 给出 $\operatorname{rank}A\le\operatorname{rank}X\le\operatorname{rank}A$，所以 $\operatorname{rank}X=\operatorname{rank}A=\operatorname{rank}A^{\mathrm H}$，从而 $\operatorname{col}(X)=\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$。同理 $\operatorname{col}(Y)=\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$，故 $XA=YA$。
最后
$$X=XAX=X(AX)=X(AY)=(XA)Y=(YA)Y=YAY=Y,$$
唯一性得证。

存在性用 SVD 构造。设
$$A=U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}$$
为满型 SVD：$U$ 为 $m$ 阶酉矩阵，$V$ 为 $n$ 阶酉矩阵，$\Sigma$ 为 $m\times n$，对角元 $\sigma_1\ge\cdots\ge\sigma_r>0$，其余为 $0$。定义 $\Sigma^{+}$ 为 $n\times m$ 矩阵：把 $\sigma_1,\dots,\sigma_r$ 换成 $1/\sigma_1,\dots,1/\sigma_r$ 并放在转置位置，其余为 $0$。令
$$X=V\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H}.$$
直接代入，利用 $V^{\mathrm H}V=I$、$U^{\mathrm H}U=I$ 与 $\Sigma\Sigma^{+}\Sigma=\Sigma$：
$$AXA=U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}V\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H}U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}
=U\Sigma\Sigma^{+}\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}=U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}=A.$$
同理 $XAX=X$，因为 $\Sigma^{+}\Sigma\Sigma^{+}=\Sigma^{+}$。又
$$AX=U\Sigma\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H},\qquad XA=V\Sigma^{+}\Sigma V^{\mathrm H},$$
而 $\Sigma\Sigma^{+}$ 与 $\Sigma^{+}\Sigma$ 都是对角元为 $1$（前 $r$ 个）和 $0$ 的 Hermitian 幂等阵，故 $(AX)^{\mathrm H}=AX$、$(XA)^{\mathrm H}=XA$。于是 $X$ 满足四条方程，由唯一性 $A^{+}=V\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H}$。

满秩情形的显式公式。若 $A$ 列满秩（$r=n\le m$），则 $A^{\mathrm H}A$ 可逆：若 $A^{\mathrm H}Ax=0$，则
$$0=x^{\mathrm H}A^{\mathrm H}Ax=\|Ax\|^2,$$
故 $Ax=0$，再由列满秩得 $x=0$。令
$$X=(A^{\mathrm H}A)^{-1}A^{\mathrm H}.$$
则 $XA=E_n$，于是 $XAX=X$、$AXA=A$ 自动成立；$XA=E_n$ 是 Hermitian，且
$$AX=A(A^{\mathrm H}A)^{-1}A^{\mathrm H}$$
是 Hermitian 幂等阵（到 $\operatorname{col}(A)$ 的正交投影）。所以
$$A^{+}=(A^{\mathrm H}A)^{-1}A^{\mathrm H},$$
这是 $A$ 的**左逆**。若 $A$ 行满秩（$r=m\le n$），同理 $AA^{\mathrm H}$ 可逆，且
$$A^{+}=A^{\mathrm H}(AA^{\mathrm H})^{-1},\qquad AA^{+}=E_m,$$
这是**右逆**。两个条件不能互换：列满秩用 $A^{\mathrm H}A$，行满秩用 $AA^{\mathrm H}$。若 $A$ 可逆，两式都化为 $A^{-1}$。

最小二乘最小范数解。对任意 $b$，令 $x^{+}=A^{+}b$。把 $b$ 分解为
$$b_1=AA^{+}b\in\operatorname{col}(A),\qquad
b_2=(E_m-AA^{+})b\in\operatorname{col}(A)^{\perp},$$
因为 $AA^{+}$ 是到 $\operatorname{col}(A)$ 的正交投影。对任意 $x$，$Ax\in\operatorname{col}(A)$，故
$$\|Ax-b\|^2=\|Ax-b_1\|^2+\|b_2\|^2\ge\|b_2\|^2,$$
等号当且仅当 $Ax=b_1$。而 $Ax^{+}=AA^{+}b=b_1$，所以 $x^{+}$ 是最小二乘解。若 $x$ 也是最小二乘解，则 $Ax=Ax^{+}$，即 $x-x^{+}\in\ker A$。又 $x^{+}=A^{+}b\in\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$，而
$$\ker A=(\operatorname{col}A^{\mathrm H})^{\perp},$$
故由勾股定理
$$\|x\|^2=\|x^{+}\|^2+\|x-x^{+}\|^2\ge\|x^{+}\|^2,$$
等号仅当 $x=x^{+}$。因此 $x^{+}$ 是唯一的最小范数最小二乘解；全部最小二乘解为
$$x^{+}+(E_n-A^{+}A)y,\qquad y\in\mathbb C^n\ \text{任意}.$$

无条件恒等式与反序律。由 $A=AA^{+}A$ 与 $A^{+}=A^{+}AA^{+}$ 夹逼得 $$\operatorname{rank}A^{+}=\operatorname{rank}A.$$ 四条方程在把 $A$ 与 $A^{+}$ 互换后仍然成立，故 $$(A^{+})^{+}=A.$$ 对四条方程整体取 Hermitian 转置，可知 $(A^{\mathrm H})^{+}=(A^{+})^{\mathrm H}$。但反序律一般失败：$$(AB)^{+}\ne B^{+}A^{+}.$$ 例如 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\end{pmatrix}$、$B=\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}$，则 $AB=(1)$ 可逆，$(AB)^{+}=(1)$；而 $$A^{+}=\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix},\qquad B^{+}=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad B^{+}A^{+}=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}=\frac12\ne(1).$$ 反序律成立的常用充分条件是 $A$ 列满秩且 $B$ 行满秩（此时 $A^{+}A=E$、$BB^{+}=E$），但不能把它当成普遍公式。
derivationEn: Let $A\in\mathbb C^{m\times n}$. If $X\in\mathbb C^{n\times m}$ satisfies the four **Penrose equations** $$\begin{aligned}&(1)\ AXA=A,\\&(2)\ XAX=X,\\&(3)\ (AX)^{\mathrm H}=AX,\\&(4)\ (XA)^{\mathrm H}=XA,\end{aligned}$$ then $X=A^{+}$ is the **Moore–Penrose inverse** of $A$. The shapes must match: $A$ is $m\times n$, so $A^{+}$ must be $n\times m$; then $AX$ is $m\times m$ and $XA$ is $n\times n$, which makes the Hermitian conditions meaningful. For every matrix — singular, rectangular, or zero — a solution of the four equations exists and is unique. When $A$ is invertible, $(1)(2)$ alone force $X=A^{-1}$; the two extra Hermitian conditions are exactly what pins down a unique generalized inverse in the rank-deficient or rectangular case.

Proof of uniqueness. Suppose $X$ and $Y$ both satisfy the four equations. First show $AX=AY$. From $(1)(2)$,
$$(AX)^2=AXAX=A(XAX)=AX,$$
and $(AX)^{\mathrm H}=AX$, so $AX$ is Hermitian and idempotent. Its range lies in $\operatorname{col}(A)$, and it fixes $\operatorname{col}(A)$: for $v=Au$, $AXv=AXAu=Au=v$. Hence $AX$ is the orthogonal projection onto $\operatorname{col}(A)$. Likewise $AY$ is the orthogonal projection onto the same subspace, and an orthogonal projection is determined by its subspace, so $AX=AY$.
Next show $XA=YA$. The matrix $XA$ is Hermitian and idempotent, and $\operatorname{col}(XA)=\operatorname{col}(X)$ because $X=XAX$. Moreover
$$X=(XA)^{\mathrm H}X=A^{\mathrm H}X^{\mathrm H}X,$$
so $\operatorname{col}(X)\subseteq\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$. From $A=AXA$ and $X=XAX$ we get $\operatorname{rank}A\le\operatorname{rank}X\le\operatorname{rank}A$, hence $\operatorname{rank}X=\operatorname{rank}A=\operatorname{rank}A^{\mathrm H}$, and therefore $\operatorname{col}(X)=\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$. The same argument gives $\operatorname{col}(Y)=\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$, so $XA=YA$.
Finally,
$$X=XAX=X(AX)=X(AY)=(XA)Y=(YA)Y=YAY=Y,$$
which proves uniqueness.

Existence is constructed from the SVD. Let
$$A=U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}$$
be a full SVD: $U$ is unitary of order $m$, $V$ is unitary of order $n$, and $\Sigma$ is $m\times n$ with diagonal entries $\sigma_1\ge\cdots\ge\sigma_r>0$ and zeros elsewhere. Define $\Sigma^{+}$ as the $n\times m$ matrix obtained by replacing $\sigma_1,\dots,\sigma_r$ by $1/\sigma_1,\dots,1/\sigma_r$ in the transposed positions and setting all other entries to $0$. Put
$$X=V\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H}.$$
Using $V^{\mathrm H}V=I$, $U^{\mathrm H}U=I$, and $\Sigma\Sigma^{+}\Sigma=\Sigma$,
$$AXA=U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}V\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H}U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}
=U\Sigma\Sigma^{+}\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}=U\Sigma V^{\mathrm H}=A.$$
Similarly $XAX=X$, because $\Sigma^{+}\Sigma\Sigma^{+}=\Sigma^{+}$. Also
$$AX=U\Sigma\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H},\qquad XA=V\Sigma^{+}\Sigma V^{\mathrm H},$$
and $\Sigma\Sigma^{+}$ and $\Sigma^{+}\Sigma$ are Hermitian idempotent matrices with $r$ ones and the remaining diagonal entries zero. Hence $(AX)^{\mathrm H}=AX$ and $(XA)^{\mathrm H}=XA$. Thus $X$ satisfies all four equations, and uniqueness gives $A^{+}=V\Sigma^{+}U^{\mathrm H}$.

Explicit formulas in the full-rank cases. If $A$ has full column rank ($r=n\le m$), then $A^{\mathrm H}A$ is invertible: if $A^{\mathrm H}Ax=0$, then
$$0=x^{\mathrm H}A^{\mathrm H}Ax=\|Ax\|^2,$$
so $Ax=0$, and full column rank forces $x=0$. Set
$$X=(A^{\mathrm H}A)^{-1}A^{\mathrm H}.$$
Then $XA=E_n$, so $XAX=X$ and $AXA=A$ hold automatically. Moreover $XA=E_n$ is Hermitian, and
$$AX=A(A^{\mathrm H}A)^{-1}A^{\mathrm H}$$
is Hermitian and idempotent (the orthogonal projection onto $\operatorname{col}(A)$). Therefore
$$A^{+}=(A^{\mathrm H}A)^{-1}A^{\mathrm H},$$
the **left inverse** of $A$. If $A$ has full row rank ($r=m\le n$), then $AA^{\mathrm H}$ is invertible and, analogously,
$$A^{+}=A^{\mathrm H}(AA^{\mathrm H})^{-1},\qquad AA^{+}=E_m,$$
the **right inverse**. The hypotheses must not be interchanged: full column rank uses $A^{\mathrm H}A$, full row rank uses $AA^{\mathrm H}$. If $A$ is invertible, both formulas reduce to $A^{-1}$.

Least-squares minimum-norm solution. For any $b$, let $x^{+}=A^{+}b$. Decompose $b$ as
$$b_1=AA^{+}b\in\operatorname{col}(A),\qquad
b_2=(E_m-AA^{+})b\in\operatorname{col}(A)^{\perp},$$
since $AA^{+}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $\operatorname{col}(A)$. For every $x$, $Ax\in\operatorname{col}(A)$, so
$$\|Ax-b\|^2=\|Ax-b_1\|^2+\|b_2\|^2\ge\|b_2\|^2,$$
with equality exactly when $Ax=b_1$. Since $Ax^{+}=AA^{+}b=b_1$, the vector $x^{+}$ is a least-squares solution. If $x$ is also a least-squares solution, then $Ax=Ax^{+}$, so $x-x^{+}\in\ker A$. Also $x^{+}=A^{+}b\in\operatorname{col}(A^{\mathrm H})$, and
$$\ker A=(\operatorname{col}A^{\mathrm H})^{\perp}.$$
By Pythagoras,
$$\|x\|^2=\|x^{+}\|^2+\|x-x^{+}\|^2\ge\|x^{+}\|^2,$$
with equality only when $x=x^{+}$. Hence $x^{+}$ is the unique least-squares solution of minimum norm; all least-squares solutions are
$$x^{+}+(E_n-A^{+}A)y,\qquad y\in\mathbb C^n\ \text{arbitrary}.$$

Unconditional identities and the reverse-order law. From $A=AA^{+}A$ and $A^{+}=A^{+}AA^{+}$, $$\operatorname{rank}A^{+}=\operatorname{rank}A.$$ The four equations remain valid after interchanging $A$ and $A^{+}$, so $$(A^{+})^{+}=A.$$ Taking the Hermitian transpose of all four equations gives $(A^{\mathrm H})^{+}=(A^{+})^{\mathrm H}$. The reverse-order law, however, fails in general: $$(AB)^{+}\ne B^{+}A^{+}.$$ For example, take $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\end{pmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}$. Then $AB=(1)$ is invertible and $(AB)^{+}=(1)$, while $$A^{+}=\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix},\qquad B^{+}=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad B^{+}A^{+}=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}=\frac12\ne(1).$$ A common sufficient condition for the reverse-order law is that $A$ have full column rank and $B$ full row rank (then $A^{+}A=E$ and $BB^{+}=E$), but it is not a universal formula.

formulas.note: Penrose 四方程：满足它的 A⁺ 对任意矩阵存在且唯一，这是 Moore–Penrose 逆的定义。
formulas.noteEn: The four Penrose equations; the matrix A⁺ satisfying them exists and is unique for every matrix — this is the definition of the Moore–Penrose inverse.

formulas.note: 由 SVD 计算：只把非零奇异值取倒数，Σ⁺ 的形状与 Σ 互为转置；r = rank(A)。
formulas.noteEn: Computation via SVD: invert the nonzero singular values only; Σ⁺ has the transpose shape of Σ, and r = rank(A).

formulas.note: 满秩情形的显式公式：满列秩用 AᴴA（左逆），满行秩用 AAᴴ（右逆），条件不能写反。
formulas.noteEn: Explicit formulas in the full-rank cases: use AᴴA for full column rank (left inverse) and AAᴴ for full row rank (right inverse); do not swap them.

formulas.latex: x^{+}=A^{+}b\quad\text{极小化}\ \|Ax-b\|,\qquad\text{且在全部极小解中}\ \|x\|\ \text{最小}
formulas.note: 最小二乘最小范数解定理：对任意 b、任意矩阵 A 成立（含秩亏情形）；全部最小二乘解为 x⁺ + (E − A⁺A)y。
formulas.noteEn: Least-squares minimum-norm solution: holds for every b and every A, including rank-deficient ones; all least-squares solutions are x⁺ + (E − A⁺A)y.

formulas.note: 常用恒等式；反序律一般不成立，(AB)⁺ = B⁺A⁺ 仅在 A 满列秩且 B 满行秩等附加条件下成立。
formulas.noteEn: Standard identities; the reverse-order law fails in general — (AB)⁺ = B⁺A⁺ requires extra hypotheses such as A of full column rank and B of full row rank.

properties: 存在唯一性：任意 m×n 复矩阵 A（奇异、矩形均可）都有唯一的 A⁺ 满足四条 Penrose 方程。
与普通逆的统一：A 可逆时 A⁺ = A⁻¹；满列秩时 A⁺A = E（左逆）；满行秩时 AA⁺ = E（右逆）；零矩阵的广义逆是相应形状的零矩阵。
投影解释：AA⁺ 是到列空间 range(A) 的正交投影，A⁺A 是到行空间 range(Aᴴ) 的正交投影，E − AA⁺ 是到 null(Aᴴ) 的正交投影。
最小二乘：x⁺ = A⁺b 是最小二乘最小范数解；全部最小二乘解为 x⁺ + (E − A⁺A)y（y 任意）；b ∈ range(A) 时 x⁺ 是方程 Ax = b 的精确解且范数最小，A 满列秩时精确解唯一。
恒等式与反序律：rank A⁺ = rank A、(A⁺)⁺ = A、(Aᴴ)⁺ = (A⁺)ᴴ 恒成立；而 (AB)⁺ ≠ B⁺A⁺ 一般成立不了（需要附加条件）。
propertiesEn: Existence and uniqueness: every m×n complex matrix A, singular or rectangular, has a unique A⁺ satisfying the four Penrose equations.

Unifying special cases: A⁺ = A⁻¹ for invertible A; A⁺A = E for full column rank (left inverse); AA⁺ = E for full row rank (right inverse); the pseudoinverse of a zero matrix is a zero matrix of the transposed shape.
Projection interpretation: AA⁺ is the orthogonal projection onto range(A), A⁺A the orthogonal projection onto range(Aᴴ), and E − AA⁺ the orthogonal projection onto null(Aᴴ).

Least squares: x⁺ = A⁺b is the least-squares minimum-norm solution; all least-squares solutions are x⁺ + (E − A⁺A)y for arbitrary y; if b ∈ range(A), then x⁺ is an exact solution of minimal norm, and the exact solution is unique when A has full column rank.
Identities and reverse-order law: rank A⁺ = rank A, (A⁺)⁺ = A and (Aᴴ)⁺ = (A⁺)ᴴ always hold; by contrast (AB)⁺ ≠ B⁺A⁺ in general (extra hypotheses are needed).

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2&3\\2&4&6\end{pmatrix}$。求 $A^{+}$，验证四条 Penrose 方程，并求 $b=(1,0)^{T}$ 时的最小二乘最小范数解。
examples.solution:
$A$ 的两行成比例，$\operatorname{rank}A=1$，可写成 $A=xy^{T}$，其中 $x=(1,2)^{T}$，$y=(1,2,3)^{T}$。秩 1 矩阵的 Moore–Penrose 逆公式为 $A^{+}=\dfrac{yx^{T}}{\|x\|^{2}\|y\|^{2}}$，其中 $\|x\|^{2}=5$，$\|y\|^{2}=14$，于是 $A^{+}=\dfrac{1}{70}\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&4\\3&6\end{pmatrix}$。
验证四条件：$AA^{+}=\dfrac{1}{5}\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}$ 为对称阵，故 $(AA^{+})^{H}=AA^{+}$，且 $AA^{+}A=A$；$A^{+}A=\dfrac{1}{14}\begin{pmatrix}1&2&3\\2&4&6\\3&6&9\end{pmatrix}$ 为对称阵，故 $(A^{+}A)^{H}=A^{+}A$，且 $A^{+}AA^{+}=A^{+}$。数值复核四式误差均小于 $10^{-15}$。
最小二乘最小范数解：$x^{+}=A^{+}b=\dfrac{1}{70}(1,2,3)^{T}$。此时 $Ax^{+}=\dfrac{1}{5}(1,2)^{T}$ 正是 $b$ 在 $A$ 的列空间（直线 span{(1,2)ᵀ}）上的正交投影，残差 $b-Ax^{+}=\left(\dfrac45,-\dfrac25\right)^{T}$，$\|b-Ax^{+}\|=2/\sqrt{5}$；在满足 $x_1+2x_2+3x_3=1/5$ 的全部向量中 $x^{+}$ 的范数最小（沿 $y$ 方向、长度为 $1/(5\|y\|)$）。

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&2\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$（满列秩）。用 $A^{+}=(A^{H}A)^{-1}A^{H}$ 求 $A^{+}$，并验证 $A^{+}A=E$。
examples.solution:
$A^{T}A=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&1\\0&2&1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&2\\1&1\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&5\end{pmatrix}$，$\det(A^{T}A)=9$，$(A^{T}A)^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{9}\begin{pmatrix}5&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$。
$A^{+}=\dfrac{1}{9}\begin{pmatrix}5&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1&0&1\\0&2&1\end{pmatrix}=\dfrac{1}{9}\begin{pmatrix}5&-2&4\\-1&4&1\end{pmatrix}$。
验证：$A^{+}A=\dfrac{1}{9}\begin{pmatrix}5&-2&4\\-1&4&1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&2\\1&1\end{pmatrix}=\dfrac{1}{9}\begin{pmatrix}9&0\\0&9\end{pmatrix}=E$，即左逆成立；$AA^{+}=A(A^{T}A)^{-1}A^{T}$ 为对称幂等阵（到列空间的正交投影），四条 Penrose 方程经数值复核全部成立。

eigenvalue-variational.definition:
设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶 Hermitian 矩阵，特征值按升序排列 $\lambda_1\le\lambda_2\le\cdots\le\lambda_n$。对任意非零向量 $x$，称 $R(x)=\dfrac{x^{H}Ax}{x^{H}x}$ 为 **Rayleigh 商**。Hermitian 性保证 $R(x)$ 取实值，且 $R$ 只与 $x$ 的方向有关（$R(cx)=R(x)$，$c\ne0$）。把 $x$ 按标准正交特征基展开 $x=\sum_{i}c_iu_i$ 可见 $R(x)=\sum_{i}\lambda_i|c_i|^{2}\big/\sum_{i}|c_i|^{2}$，即 $R(x)$ 是特征值以 $|c_i|^{2}$ 为权的加权平均。

由此立刻得到两侧夹逼：$\lambda_{\min}\le R(x)\le\lambda_{\max}$，且等号成立当且仅当 $x$ 是对应端点的特征向量。中间特征值不能用单个向量刻画，但可以用**子空间的极小极大**刻画——这就是 Courant–Fischer 定理：$\lambda_k$ 等于「在所有 $k$ 维子空间 $S$ 上取 $\max_{x\in S}R(x)$，再对 $S$ 取 $\min$」，也等于其对偶形式「在所有 $n-k+1$ 维子空间 $T$ 上取 $\min$，再对 $T$ 取 $\max$」。min 与 max 的先后顺序、子空间的维数方向，都不能写反。

变分刻画把特征值问题变成优化问题：$\lambda_{\max}$ 是二次函数在单位球面上的最大值、$\lambda_{\min}$ 是最小值，而 $R$ 在单位球面上的驻点恰是特征向量。对主子阵还有**交错定理**：删除一行一列得到的 $n-1$ 阶主子阵 $B$ 的特征值 $\mu_1\le\cdots\le\mu_{n-1}$ 被原矩阵特征值逐一夹逼：$\lambda_k\le\mu_k\le\lambda_{k+1}$。这些结论是幂法、子空间迭代、Lanczos 等数值方法与特征值扰动分析的理论基础。
eigenvalue-variational.definitionEn:
Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Hermitian matrix with eigenvalues in increasing order $\lambda_1\le\lambda_2\le\cdots\le\lambda_n$. For every nonzero vector $x$, the quantity $R(x)=\dfrac{x^{H}Ax}{x^{H}x}$ is the **Rayleigh quotient**. Hermitian symmetry makes $R(x)$ real, and it depends only on the direction of $x$ ($R(cx)=R(x)$, $c\ne0$). Expanding $x=\sum_ic_iu_i$ in an orthonormal eigenbasis shows $R(x)=\sum_i\lambda_i|c_i|^{2}\big/\sum_i|c_i|^{2}$, a weighted average of the eigenvalues with weights $|c_i|^{2}$.

Two-sided bounds follow at once: $\lambda_{\min}\le R(x)\le\lambda_{\max}$, with equality iff $x$ is an eigenvector for the corresponding endpoint. Intermediate eigenvalues cannot be captured by a single vector, but they have a **subspace min-max** characterization — the Courant–Fischer theorem: $\lambda_k$ equals the minimum over all $k$-dimensional subspaces $S$ of the maximum of $R$ on $S$, and equally the maximum over all $(n-k+1)$-dimensional subspaces $T$ of the minimum of $R$ on $T$. The order of min and max and the dimension of the subspaces must not be swapped.

This turns eigenvalue problems into optimization problems: $\lambda_{\max}$ is the maximum of the quadratic form on the unit sphere, $\lambda_{\min}$ the minimum, and the stationary points of $R$ on the unit sphere are exactly the eigenvectors. For principal submatrices there is moreover the **interlacing theorem**: the eigenvalues $\mu_1\le\cdots\le\mu_{n-1}$ of the $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ principal submatrix $B$ obtained by deleting one row and column interlace those of $A$: $\lambda_k\le\mu_k\le\lambda_{k+1}$. These facts underlie power iteration, subspace iteration, Lanczos methods, and eigenvalue perturbation theory.
derivation: 设 $A\in\mathbb{C}^{n\times n}$ 为 Hermitian（$A^{H}=A$），特征值按升序排列 $\lambda_1\le\cdots\le\lambda_n$，并取标准正交特征基 $u_1,\dots,u_n$：$Au_i=\lambda_iu_i$，$u_i^{H}u_j=\delta_{ij}$。对 $x\ne0$ 定义 Rayleigh 商 $$R(x)=\frac{x^{H}Ax}{x^{H}x}.$$ 写 $x=\sum_{i=1}^{n}c_iu_i$，则 $x^{H}Ax=\sum_i\lambda_i|c_i|^2$、$x^{H}x=\sum_i|c_i|^2$，所以 $$R(x)=\frac{\sum_i\lambda_i|c_i|^2}{\sum_i|c_i|^2}.$$ 它是特征值以 $|c_i|^2$ 为权的加权平均，特别地取实值，且 $R(cx)=R(x)$（$c\ne0$）。

由加权平均立刻得到 $\lambda_1\le R(x)\le\lambda_n$。取 $x=u_1$ 得 $R=\lambda_1$，取 $x=u_n$ 得 $R=\lambda_n$，故 $$\lambda_1=\min_{x\ne0}R(x),\qquad \lambda_n=\max_{x\ne0}R(x).$$ 等号条件也可读出：$R(x)=\lambda_1$ 当且仅当所有权重集中在 $\lambda_1$ 对应的特征向量上，即 $x$ 属于 $\lambda_1$ 的特征子空间；$\lambda_n$ 同理。中间特征值一般不能写成单个 $R(x)$ 的极值。

Courant–Fischer（min-max 形式）：对 $k=1,\dots,n$，$$\lambda_k=\min_{\dim S=k}\ \max_{0\ne x\in S}R(x).$$ 证明：取 $S_0=\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_k\}$，对 $x\in S_0$ 有 $R(x)\le\lambda_k$，故 $\max_{S_0}R\le\lambda_k$，从而 $\min_S\max_SR\le\lambda_k$。反向，任取 $k$ 维子空间 $S$，令 $T=\operatorname{span}\{u_k,\dots,u_n\}$，$\dim T=n-k+1$。因 $\dim S+\dim T=n+1>n$，存在 $0\ne x\in S\cap T$；写 $x=\sum_{i=k}^{n}c_iu_i$，得 $R(x)\ge\lambda_k$，故 $\max_SR\ge\lambda_k$，对 $S$ 取极小得 $\min_S\max_SR\ge\lambda_k$。两端合并即得。极值在单位球面上可达，因为 $R$ 连续。

对偶（max-min）形式：$$\lambda_k=\max_{\dim T=n-k+1}\ \min_{0\ne x\in T}R(x).$$ 取 $T_0=\operatorname{span}\{u_k,\dots,u_n\}$，对 $x\in T_0$ 有 $R(x)\ge\lambda_k$，故 $\min_{T_0}R\ge\lambda_k$，从而 $\max_T\min_TR\ge\lambda_k$。反向，任取 $\dim T=n-k+1$ 的子空间，令 $S=\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_k\}$；由 $\dim S+\dim T=n+1>n$ 可取 $0\ne x\in S\cap T$，则 $R(x)\le\lambda_k$，故 $\min_TR\le\lambda_k$，对 $T$ 取上确界得 $\max_T\min_TR\le\lambda_k$。两种形式中 $\min$ 与 $\max$ 的次序、子空间维数都不能互换。

驻点刻画：在约束 $\|x\|=1$ 下，$R(x)=x^{H}Ax$。实对称情形（Hermitian 情形把转置换成共轭转置，结论相同） $$\nabla R(x)=\frac{2(Ax-R(x)x)}{x^{T}x}.$$ 令梯度为零（等价于用 Lagrange 乘子处理约束 $\|x\|^2=1$）得 $Ax=R(x)x$，即 $x$ 是 $A$ 的特征向量，驻值就是相应特征值。反过来，每个单位特征向量都满足该方程，故约束驻点恰为特征向量。这解释了第 2 步的端点极值：它们同时也是驻点。

应用（Cauchy 交错）：设 $B$ 是 $A$ 的 $n-1$ 阶主子阵（例如删去最后一行与最后一列），特征值为 $\mu_1\le\cdots\le\mu_{n-1}$。记 $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$ 或 $\mathbb{C}$；把 $\mathbb{K}^{n-1}$ 的向量 $\tilde x$ 嵌入 $\mathbb{K}^n$ 为 $(\tilde x,0)$，则 $R_A(\tilde x)=R_B(\tilde x)$。对任意 $k$ 维 $S\subset\mathbb{K}^{n-1}$，由 $\lambda_k$ 的极小极大性，$\lambda_k(A)\le\max_{x\in S}R_A(x)=\max_{x\in S}R_B(x)$；对 $S$ 取极小得 $\lambda_k(A)\le\mu_k(B)$。另一方面取 $S=\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_{k+1}\}$，则 $\dim(S\cap\mathbb{K}^{n-1})\ge k$，且在 $S$ 上 $R_A\le\lambda_{k+1}(A)$，于其中取 $k$ 维子空间即得 $\mu_k(B)\le\lambda_{k+1}(A)$。合并得 $$\lambda_k(A)\le\mu_k(B)\le\lambda_{k+1}(A),\qquad k=1,\dots,n-1.$$ 以上证明的是 $n-1$ 阶主子阵。对一般 $m$ 阶主子阵，可对补空间维数归纳（或反复使用 $n-1$ 阶情形），得到 $$\lambda_k(A)\le\mu_k(B)\le\lambda_{k+n-m}(A),\qquad k=1,\dots,m.$$
derivationEn: Let $A\in\mathbb{C}^{n\times n}$ be Hermitian ($A^{H}=A$) with eigenvalues in increasing order $\lambda_1\le\cdots\le\lambda_n$, and choose an orthonormal eigenbasis $u_1,\dots,u_n$: $Au_i=\lambda_iu_i$, $u_i^{H}u_j=\delta_{ij}$. For $x\ne0$ define the Rayleigh quotient $$R(x)=\frac{x^{H}Ax}{x^{H}x}.$$ Writing $x=\sum_{i=1}^{n}c_iu_i$ gives $x^{H}Ax=\sum_i\lambda_i|c_i|^2$ and $x^{H}x=\sum_i|c_i|^2$, hence $$R(x)=\frac{\sum_i\lambda_i|c_i|^2}{\sum_i|c_i|^2}.$$ This is a weighted average of the eigenvalues with weights $|c_i|^2$; in particular it is real, and $R(cx)=R(x)$ for $c\ne0$.

The weighted-average formula immediately gives $\lambda_1\le R(x)\le\lambda_n$. Taking $x=u_1$ gives $R=\lambda_1$, and $x=u_n$ gives $R=\lambda_n$; therefore $$\lambda_1=\min_{x\ne0}R(x),\qquad \lambda_n=\max_{x\ne0}R(x).$$ Equality conditions also follow: $R(x)=\lambda_1$ iff all weight is concentrated on eigenvectors for $\lambda_1$, i.e. $x$ lies in the $\lambda_1$-eigenspace; similarly for $\lambda_n$. An intermediate eigenvalue generally cannot be written as an extremum of $R$ over single vectors.

Courant–Fischer (min–max form): for $k=1,\dots,n$, $$\lambda_k=\min_{\dim S=k}\ \max_{0\ne x\in S}R(x).$$ Proof: take $S_0=\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_k\}$. For $x\in S_0$, $R(x)\le\lambda_k$, so $\max_{S_0}R\le\lambda_k$ and hence $\min_S\max_SR\le\lambda_k$. Conversely, for any $k$-dimensional $S$, let $T=\operatorname{span}\{u_k,\dots,u_n\}$, of dimension $n-k+1$. Since $\dim S+\dim T=n+1>n$, there is $0\ne x\in S\cap T$; writing $x=\sum_{i=k}^{n}c_iu_i$ gives $R(x)\ge\lambda_k$, so $\max_SR\ge\lambda_k$, and taking the minimum over $S$ yields $\min_S\max_SR\ge\lambda_k$. The two inequalities coincide. The extrema are attained because $R$ is continuous on the unit sphere.

Dual (max–min) form: $$\lambda_k=\max_{\dim T=n-k+1}\ \min_{0\ne x\in T}R(x).$$ Take $T_0=\operatorname{span}\{u_k,\dots,u_n\}$. For $x\in T_0$, $R(x)\ge\lambda_k$, so $\min_{T_0}R\ge\lambda_k$ and hence $\max_T\min_TR\ge\lambda_k$. Conversely, for any $T$ of dimension $n-k+1$, let $S=\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_k\}$. Since $\dim S+\dim T=n+1>n$, choose $0\ne x\in S\cap T$; then $R(x)\le\lambda_k$, so $\min_TR\le\lambda_k$, and taking the supremum over $T$ gives $\max_T\min_TR\le\lambda_k$. In both forms neither the order of min and max nor the subspace dimensions may be interchanged.

Stationary points: on the constraint $\|x\|=1$ we have $R(x)=x^{H}Ax$. In the real symmetric case (for the Hermitian case replace the transpose by the conjugate transpose; the conclusion is the same), $$\nabla R(x)=\frac{2(Ax-R(x)x)}{x^{T}x}.$$ Setting the gradient to zero (equivalently, applying a Lagrange multiplier to $\|x\|^2=1$) gives $Ax=R(x)x$, so $x$ is an eigenvector of $A$ and the stationary value is the corresponding eigenvalue. Conversely, every unit eigenvector satisfies this equation, so the constrained stationary points are exactly the eigenvectors. This explains why the endpoint extrema in Step 2 are also stationary points.

Application (Cauchy interlacing): let $B$ be an $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ principal submatrix of $A$ (for instance, delete the last row and column), with eigenvalues $\mu_1\le\cdots\le\mu_{n-1}$. Let $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$; embed $\tilde x\in\mathbb{K}^{n-1}$ as $(\tilde x,0)\in\mathbb{K}^n$; then $R_A(\tilde x)=R_B(\tilde x)$. For every $k$-dimensional $S\subset\mathbb{K}^{n-1}$, the min–max characterization gives $\lambda_k(A)\le\max_{x\in S}R_A(x)=\max_{x\in S}R_B(x)$; taking the minimum over $S$ yields $\lambda_k(A)\le\mu_k(B)$. Conversely, take $S=\operatorname{span}\{u_1,\dots,u_{k+1}\}$; then $\dim(S\cap\mathbb{K}^{n-1})\ge k$, and on $S$ we have $R_A\le\lambda_{k+1}(A)$, so choosing a $k$-dimensional subspace of the intersection gives $\mu_k(B)\le\lambda_{k+1}(A)$. Hence $$\lambda_k(A)\le\mu_k(B)\le\lambda_{k+1}(A),\qquad k=1,\dots,n-1.$$ This proves the case of an $(n-1)$-st order principal submatrix. For a general $m$-th order principal submatrix, induct on the codimension (or iterate the $(n-1)$ case) to obtain $$\lambda_k(A)\le\mu_k(B)\le\lambda_{k+n-m}(A),\qquad k=1,\dots,m.$$

formulas.note: Rayleigh 商的定义；Hermitian 情形取实值，且只依赖 x 的方向。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of the Rayleigh quotient; it is real-valued for Hermitian A and depends only on the direction of x.

formulas.note: 端点刻画：等号成立当且仅当 x 是对应端点的特征向量。
formulas.noteEn: Endpoint characterization: equality holds iff x is an eigenvector for the corresponding endpoint eigenvalue.

formulas.latex: \lambda_k=\min_{\dim S=k}\ \max_{0\ne x\in S}R(x)=\max_{\dim T=n-k+1}\ \min_{0\ne x\in T}R(x),\qquad k=1,\dots,n
formulas.note: Courant–Fischer 极小极大原理（特征值升序）：min-max 与 max-min 形式等价，子空间维数与 min/max 次序都不能颠倒。
formulas.noteEn: Courant–Fischer min-max principle (eigenvalues in increasing order): the min-max and max-min forms are equivalent, and neither the subspace dimensions nor the order of min/max may be swapped.

formulas.note: Cauchy 交错定理：B 为 A 的 n−1 阶主子阵，μ 为其特征值；一般 m 阶主子阵满足 λ_k(A) ≤ μ_k(B) ≤ λ_{k+n−m}(A)。
formulas.noteEn: Cauchy interlacing: B is an (n−1)×(n−1) principal submatrix with eigenvalues μ; for an m×m principal submatrix, λ_k(A) ≤ μ_k(B) ≤ λ_{k+n−m}(A).

formulas.note: 特征值加权平均表示（u_i 为标准正交特征基）：夹逼性质与驻点性质都由此推出。
formulas.noteEn: Weighted-average representation using an orthonormal eigenbasis (u_i): both the bounding and stationary-point properties follow from it.

properties: 齐次性：R(cx) = R(x)（c ≠ 0），故只需在单位球面 ‖x‖ = 1 上考察。
端点刻画：λmin = min R，λmax = max R；等号成立当且仅当 x 为相应端点的特征向量。
驻点：Hermitian 情形在约束 ‖x‖ = 1 下，R 的驻点恰为 A 的特征向量，驻值即相应特征值；实对称阵的梯度为 ∇R(x) = 2(Ax − R(x)x)/(xᵀx)。
Courant–Fischer 与单调性推论：每个 λ_k 都有极小极大刻画；若 A ⪯ B（即 B − A 半正定），则 λ_k(A) ≤ λ_k(B)（Weyl 单调性）。
交错定理：n−1 阶主子阵的特征值被原矩阵特征值逐一夹逼（λ_k ≤ μ_k ≤ λ_{k+1}）；一般 m 阶主子阵满足 λ_k(A) ≤ μ_k(B) ≤ λ_{k+n−m}(A)。
propertiesEn: Homogeneity: R(cx) = R(x) for c ≠ 0, so one may work on the unit sphere ‖x‖ = 1.
Endpoint characterization: λmin = min R and λmax = max R; equality holds iff x is an eigenvector for the corresponding endpoint.

Stationary points: for Hermitian A and the constraint ‖x‖ = 1, the stationary points of R are exactly the eigenvectors, the stationary values being the eigenvalues; for real symmetric A, ∇R(x) = 2(Ax − R(x)x)/(xᵀx).
Courant–Fischer and monotonicity corollaries: every λ_k has a min-max characterization; if A ⪯ B (B − A positive semidefinite), then λ_k(A) ≤ λ_k(B) (Weyl monotonicity).
Interlacing: eigenvalues of an (n−1)×(n−1) principal submatrix interlace those of A (λ_k ≤ μ_k ≤ λ_{k+1}); for an m×m principal submatrix, λ_k(A) ≤ μ_k(B) ≤ λ_{k+n−m}(A).

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$。直接求特征值，并用 Courant–Fischer 定理验证。
examples.solution:
$f_A(\lambda)=\begin{vmatrix}\lambda-2&-1\\-1&\lambda-2\end{vmatrix}=(\lambda-2)^2-1=(\lambda-1)(\lambda-3)$，故 $\lambda_1=1$，$\lambda_2=3$。
变分侧：对单位向量 $x=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)^{T}$，$R(x)=x^{T}Ax=2\cos^{2}\theta+2\sin\theta\cos\theta+2\sin^{2}\theta=2+\sin 2\theta$，其值域为 $[1,3]$：$\min R=1$，$\max R=3$，与两个特征值一致。
按 Courant–Fischer 核对：当 $k=1$，一维子空间是过原点的直线，$R$ 在直线 $\theta=-\pi/4$（即 $\lambda_1=1$ 的特征方向 $(1,-1)^{T}$）上恒等于 1，故 $\min_{\dim S=1}\max_{x\in S}R(x)=1=\lambda_1$；当 $k=2$，全平面上 $\max R=3=\lambda_2$。对偶（max-min）形式：$\dim T=2$ 时得 $1$，$\dim T=1$ 时沿方向 $(1,1)^{T}$ 的直线取最大值 $3$，同样与 $\lambda_1,\lambda_2$ 相符。数值抽样复核：$10^{4}$ 个随机单位向量的 $R$ 值全部落在 $[1,3]$ 内，与端点之差小于 $10^{-6}$。

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1&0\\1&2&1\\0&1&2\end{pmatrix}$，$B$ 为删除 $A$ 的第一行第一列所得的主子阵。验证交错定理。
examples.solution:
先算 $A$ 的特征多项式：$|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-2)\big[(\lambda-2)^2-1\big]-(\lambda-2)=(\lambda-2)\big[(\lambda-2)^2-2\big]$，故 $\lambda_1=2-\sqrt{2}\approx0.5858$，$\lambda_2=2$，$\lambda_3=2+\sqrt{2}\approx3.4142$。
$B=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ 的特征值为 $\mu_1=1$，$\mu_2=3$。
交错链 $\lambda_1\le\mu_1\le\lambda_2\le\mu_2\le\lambda_3$ 即 $0.5858\le1\le2\le3\le3.4142$，逐项成立；用数值特征值程序复核，四个不等式中最小间隔为 $\lambda_3-\mu_2\approx0.4142>0$（另一处 $\mu_1-\lambda_1$ 取到同样的值）。

sylvester-lyapunov.definition:
把两个矩阵「拼」成一个大矩阵的标准方式是 **Kronecker 积**：设 $A=(a_{ij})$ 是 $m\times n$ 矩阵、$B$ 是 $p\times q$ 矩阵，则 $A\otimes B=(a_{ij}B)$，即把 $A$ 的第 $(i,j)$ 个元素换成整个 $B$ 的数乘块。于是 $A\otimes B$ 的尺寸是 $mp\times nq$——两个方向的尺寸都相乘。它满足与矩阵乘法相容的混合积公式 $(A\otimes B)(C\otimes D)=(AC)\otimes(BD)$（在 $AC$ 与 $BD$ 都有意义时），但它本身不交换：$A\otimes B$ 与 $B\otimes A$ 一般不相同，彼此只差一个置换相似。

**vec 算子**把矩阵按列拉直成列向量：$\operatorname{vec}(X)$ 就是把 $X$ 的各列自上而下排成一列。它与 Kronecker 积的配合给出恒等式 $\operatorname{vec}(AXB)=(B^{\mathsf T}\otimes A)\operatorname{vec}(X)$：$B$ 在乘积的右边，转置之后跑到左侧，顺序不能反。利用这个恒等式，形如 $AX+XB=C$ 的 **Sylvester 方程**（$A$ 为 $m\times m$、$B$ 为 $n\times n$、$X$ 与 $C$ 为 $m\times n$）就等价于一个 $mn$ 阶的普通线性方程组，其可解性完全由系数矩阵的可逆性决定。

**Sylvester 方程的可解性判据**：对任意右端项 $C$ 都存在唯一解，当且仅当 $A$ 与 $-B$ 没有公共特征值，等价地说 $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)\ne 0$ 对一切 $i,j$ 成立。原因是线性算子 $X\mapsto AX+XB$ 的谱恰恰由这些两两之和 $\lambda_i+\mu_j$ 组成（见公式中的 $A\otimes I+I\otimes B$）。注意判据的量化方式是「对任意 $C$ 都成立」：某个特定的 $C$ 恰有解，并不需要这个条件。

**Lyapunov 方程**是 Sylvester 方程最常用的特例。本文统一采用约定 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$（$A$ 为 $n\times n$）。它唯一可解当且仅当 $\lambda_i+\bar\lambda_j\ne 0$ 对一切 $i,j$ 成立；当 $A$ 稳定（所有特征值的实部都小于 0）时该条件自动满足，对任意 $Q$ 都有唯一解，并可写成积分 $X=-\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt$。文献里也常把方程写成 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$，此时同一个积分不带负号——引用公式之前务必看清方程中 $Q$ 的符号，这是最容易混淆的一处约定。
sylvester-lyapunov.definitionEn:
The standard way to combine two matrices into a larger one is the **Kronecker product**: if $A=(a_{ij})$ is $m\times n$ and $B$ is $p\times q$, then $A\otimes B=(a_{ij}B)$ is the block matrix obtained by replacing each entry $a_{ij}$ of $A$ with the scaled block $a_{ij}B$. Its size is $mp\times nq$: both dimensions multiply. It obeys the mixed-product rule $(A\otimes B)(C\otimes D)=(AC)\otimes(BD)$ whenever the products $AC$ and $BD$ are defined, but it is not commutative: $A\otimes B$ and $B\otimes A$ usually differ and are related only by a permutation similarity.

The **vec operator** stacks a matrix into a single column, column by column. Combined with the Kronecker product it gives the identity $\operatorname{vec}(AXB)=(B^{\mathsf T}\otimes A)\operatorname{vec}(X)$: the right factor $B$ is transposed and moved to the left, and the order cannot be reversed. With this identity the **Sylvester equation** $AX+XB=C$ ($A$ of size $m\times m$, $B$ of size $n\times n$, $X$ and $C$ of size $m\times n$) becomes an ordinary linear system of order $mn$, whose solvability is governed entirely by the invertibility of its coefficient matrix.

**Solvability criterion.** The Sylvester equation has a unique solution for every right-hand side $C$ if and only if $A$ and $-B$ share no eigenvalue, equivalently $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)\ne 0$ for all $i,j$. The reason is that the spectrum of the linear operator $X\mapsto AX+XB$ consists precisely of these pairwise sums $\lambda_i+\mu_j$ (the eigenvalues of $A\otimes I+I\otimes B$). Note the quantifier: the criterion guarantees a solution for every $C$; a particular $C$ may well be solvable without it.

The **Lyapunov equation** is the most important special case. Throughout we fix the convention $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ with $A$ of size $n\times n$. It is uniquely solvable if and only if $\lambda_i+\bar\lambda_j\ne 0$ for all $i,j$; when $A$ is stable (every eigenvalue has negative real part) this holds automatically, and the unique solution admits the integral representation $X=-\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt$. The equation is also commonly written $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$, in which case the same integral carries no minus sign. Always check the sign of $Q$ in the equation before quoting a solution formula; this is the most error-prone convention in the subject.
derivation: 设 $A=(a_{ij})$ 为 $m\times n$、$B$ 为 $p\times q$。Kronecker 积 $$A\otimes B=\begin{pmatrix}a_{11}B&\cdots&a_{1n}B\\ \vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\ a_{m1}B&\cdots&a_{mn}B\end{pmatrix}$$ 是 $mp\times nq$ 矩阵。只要乘积有意义，就有混合积公式 $(A\otimes B)(C\otimes D)=(AC)\otimes(BD)$；另有 $(A\otimes B)^{\mathsf T}=A^{\mathsf T}\otimes B^{\mathsf T}$、$(A\otimes B)^{-1}=A^{-1}\otimes B^{-1}$（$A,B$ 可逆）。若 $A$ 为 $r\times r$、$B$ 为 $s\times s$，则 $$\begin{aligned}\det(A\otimes B)&=(\det A)^s(\det B)^r,\\ \sigma(A\otimes B)&=\{\lambda_i(A)\mu_j(B)\}.\end{aligned}$$ $A\otimes B$ 与 $B\otimes A$ 一般不同，但只差一个置换相似，故特征值（含重数）相同。

vec 算子按列拉直：若 $A$ 为 $m\times n$、$X$ 为 $n\times p$、$B$ 为 $p\times q$，记 $X=(x_1,\dots,x_p)$，则 $XB$ 的第 $j$ 列为 $\sum_{k=1}^p b_{kj}x_k$，故 $AXB$ 的第 $j$ 列为 $\sum_{k=1}^p b_{kj}Ax_k$。按列堆叠得 $$\begin{aligned}\operatorname{vec}(AXB)&=\sum_{k=1}^p\begin{pmatrix}b_{k1}Ax_k\\ \vdots\\ b_{kq}Ax_k\end{pmatrix}\\ &=(B^{\mathsf T}\otimes A)\operatorname{vec}(X).\end{aligned}$$ 注意 $B$ 被转置后移到左边，转置与顺序都不能改。

取 $A$ 为 $m\times m$、$B$ 为 $n\times n$、$X,C$ 为 $m\times n$。Sylvester 方程 $AX+XB=C$ 中，$AX=AXI_n$、$XB=I_mXB$，由 vec 公式得 $$\begin{aligned}\operatorname{vec}(AX+XB)&=\bigl(I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m\bigr)\operatorname{vec}(X)\\ &=\operatorname{vec}(C).\end{aligned}$$ 这是 $mn$ 阶线性方程组，系数矩阵 $L=I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m$。取 $A$ 与 $B^{\mathsf T}$ 的 Schur 三角化 $A=U A_U U^*$、$B^{\mathsf T}=V B_V V^*$，其中 $A_U,B_V$ 为上三角。在张量基 $U\otimes V$ 下，$I_n\otimes A$ 与 $B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m$ 同时上三角，且对角元分别为 $\lambda_i(A)$ 与 $\mu_j(B)$；因此 $L$ 的对角元取遍所有 $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)$，故 $$\sigma(L)=\{\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B):1\le i\le m,\ 1\le j\le n\},$$ 其中 $\mu_j(B)$ 取遍 $B$ 的特征值（$B^{\mathsf T}$ 与 $B$ 特征值相同）。

因此以下条件等价：① 对每个 $C$ 方程 $AX+XB=C$ 有唯一解；② $L$ 可逆；③ $0
otin\sigma(L)$；④ $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)
e0$ 对一切 $i,j$；⑤ $A$ 与 $-B$ 没有公共特征值。此时 $$\operatorname{vec}(X)=L^{-1}\operatorname{vec}(C).$$ 注意量词：判据保证的是「对任意 $C$ 都唯一可解」。若某个 $\lambda_i+\mu_j=0$，$L$ 奇异，则存在右端项 $C$ 无解（$\operatorname{vec}(C)
otin\operatorname{Im}L$），但某些特殊的 $C$ 仍可能有解，且解不唯一。

Lyapunov 方程取约定 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$（$A,X,Q$ 均为 $n\times n$）。它是对每个 $Q$ 唯一可解的充要条件是 $\lambda_i(A)+\overline{\lambda_j(A)}\ne0$ 对一切 $i,j$ 成立。若 $A$ 稳定（所有特征值实部小于 $0$），则 $\operatorname{Re}(\lambda_i+\overline{\lambda_j})=\operatorname{Re}\lambda_i+\operatorname{Re}\lambda_j<0$，条件自动满足，且 $$X=-\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt.$$ 验证：令 $F(t)=e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}$，则 $F'(t)=A^{\mathsf H}F(t)+F(t)A$，故 $$\begin{aligned}\int_0^\infty F'(t)\,dt&=F(\infty)-F(0)=-Q,\\ A^{\mathsf H}X+XA&=-\int_0^\infty F'(t)\,dt=Q.\end{aligned}$$ 若方程写成 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$，同一积分为 $X=+\int_0^\infty F(t)\,dt$，符号必须随约定调整。

解的结构与算例。若 $Q$ Hermite，对 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ 取共轭转置得 $A^{\mathsf H}X^{\mathsf H}+X^{\mathsf H}A=Q$，由唯一性 $X^{\mathsf H}=X$；当 $A$ 稳定且 $Q\prec0$ 时 $X\succ0$（Lyapunov 定理）。算例：$A=\operatorname{diag}(1,2)$、$B=\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\0&4\end{pmatrix}$、$C=I_2$。$A$ 的特征值为 $1,2$，$-B$ 的特征值为 $-3,-4$，无公共特征值，故唯一解存在。设 $X=\begin{pmatrix}x_{11}&x_{12}\\x_{21}&x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$，展开 $$AX+XB=\begin{pmatrix}4x_{11}&x_{11}+5x_{12}\\5x_{21}&x_{21}+6x_{22}\end{pmatrix}=I_2,$$ 解得 $X=\begin{pmatrix}\frac14&-\frac1{20}\\0&\frac16\end{pmatrix}$。Kronecker 核对：$L$ 的特征值为 $1+3,1+4,2+3,2+4$，即 $4,5,5,6$，均非零，$\det L=600\ne0$，与唯一可解一致。
derivationEn: Let $A=(a_{ij})$ be $m\times n$ and $B$ be $p\times q$. The Kronecker product $$A\otimes B=\begin{pmatrix}a_{11}B&\cdots&a_{1n}B\\ \vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\ a_{m1}B&\cdots&a_{mn}B\end{pmatrix}$$ is an $mp\times nq$ matrix. Whenever the products make sense, $(A\otimes B)(C\otimes D)=(AC)\otimes(BD)$; also $(A\otimes B)^{\mathsf T}=A^{\mathsf T}\otimes B^{\mathsf T}$ and $(A\otimes B)^{-1}=A^{-1}\otimes B^{-1}$ for invertible $A,B$. If $A$ is $r\times r$ and $B$ is $s\times s$, then $$\begin{aligned}\det(A\otimes B)&=(\det A)^s(\det B)^r,\\ \sigma(A\otimes B)&=\{\lambda_i(A)\mu_j(B)\}.\end{aligned}$$ In general $A\otimes B\ne B\otimes A$, but the two differ only by a permutation similarity, so their eigenvalues, with multiplicities, coincide.

The vec operator stacks a matrix column by column. If $A$ is $m\times n$, $X$ is $n\times p$, $B$ is $p\times q$, and $X=(x_1,\dots,x_p)$, then column $j$ of $XB$ is $\sum_{k=1}^p b_{kj}x_k$, so column $j$ of $AXB$ is $\sum_{k=1}^p b_{kj}Ax_k$. Stacking these columns gives $$\begin{aligned}\operatorname{vec}(AXB)&=\sum_{k=1}^p\begin{pmatrix}b_{k1}Ax_k\\ \vdots\\ b_{kq}Ax_k\end{pmatrix}\\ &=(B^{\mathsf T}\otimes A)\operatorname{vec}(X).\end{aligned}$$ Note that $B$ is transposed and moved to the left; neither the transpose nor the order may be changed.

Take $A$ of size $m\times m$, $B$ of size $n\times n$, and $X,C$ of size $m\times n$. In the Sylvester equation $AX+XB=C$, write $AX=AXI_n$ and $XB=I_mXB$; the vec identity gives $$\begin{aligned}\operatorname{vec}(AX+XB)&=\bigl(I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m\bigr)\operatorname{vec}(X)\\ &=\operatorname{vec}(C).\end{aligned}$$ This is a linear system of order $mn$ with coefficient matrix $L=I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m$. Take Schur triangularizations $A=U A_U U^*$ and $B^{\mathsf T}=V B_V V^*$, with $A_U,B_V$ upper triangular. In the tensor basis $U\otimes V$, the matrices $I_n\otimes A$ and $B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m$ are simultaneously upper triangular, with diagonal entries $\lambda_i(A)$ and $\mu_j(B)$ respectively; hence the diagonal entries of $L$ run through all $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)$, and $$\sigma(L)=\{\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B):1\le i\le m,\ 1\le j\le n\},$$ where $\mu_j(B)$ runs over the eigenvalues of $B$ (and $B^{\mathsf T}$ has the same eigenvalues as $B$).

Therefore the following conditions are equivalent: (1) for every $C$ the equation $AX+XB=C$ has a unique solution; (2) $L$ is invertible; (3) $0
otin\sigma(L)$; (4) $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)
e0$ for all $i,j$; (5) $A$ and $-B$ have no common eigenvalue. In that case $$\operatorname{vec}(X)=L^{-1}\operatorname{vec}(C).$$ Mind the quantifier: the criterion guarantees unique solvability for every $C$. If some $\lambda_i+\mu_j=0$, then $L$ is singular; some right-hand sides $C$ are unsolvable ($\operatorname{vec}(C)
otin\operatorname{Im}L$), while certain special $C$ may still be solvable, and then the solution is not unique.

Use the convention $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ for the Lyapunov equation ($A,X,Q$ all $n\times n$). It is uniquely solvable for every $Q$ if and only if $\lambda_i(A)+\overline{\lambda_j(A)}\ne0$ for all $i,j$. If $A$ is stable (every eigenvalue has negative real part), then $\operatorname{Re}(\lambda_i+\overline{\lambda_j})=\operatorname{Re}\lambda_i+\operatorname{Re}\lambda_j<0$, so the condition holds automatically and $$X=-\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt.$$ Verification: let $F(t)=e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}$; then $F'(t)=A^{\mathsf H}F(t)+F(t)A$, hence $$\begin{aligned}\int_0^\infty F'(t)\,dt&=F(\infty)-F(0)=-Q,\\ A^{\mathsf H}X+XA&=-\int_0^\infty F'(t)\,dt=Q.\end{aligned}$$ If the equation is written $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$, the same integral is $X=+\int_0^\infty F(t)\,dt$; the sign must be adjusted with the convention.

Structure of solutions and a worked example. If $Q$ is Hermitian, taking conjugate transposes in $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ gives $A^{\mathsf H}X^{\mathsf H}+X^{\mathsf H}A=Q$, and uniqueness forces $X^{\mathsf H}=X$. When $A$ is stable and $Q\prec0$, one has $X\succ0$ (Lyapunov's theorem). Example: $A=\operatorname{diag}(1,2)$, $B=\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\0&4\end{pmatrix}$, $C=I_2$. The eigenvalues of $A$ are $1,2$ and those of $-B$ are $-3,-4$, with no common eigenvalue, so a unique solution exists. Write $X=\begin{pmatrix}x_{11}&x_{12}\\x_{21}&x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$; then $$AX+XB=\begin{pmatrix}4x_{11}&x_{11}+5x_{12}\\5x_{21}&x_{21}+6x_{22}\end{pmatrix}=I_2,$$ which gives $X=\begin{pmatrix}\frac14&-\frac1{20}\\0&\frac16\end{pmatrix}$. Kronecker check: the eigenvalues of $L$ are $1+3,1+4,2+3,2+4$, namely $4,5,5,6$, all nonzero, and $\det L=600\ne0$, consistent with unique solvability.

formulas.latex: A\otimes B=\begin{pmatrix} a_{11}B & \cdots & a_{1n}B \\ \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ a_{m1}B & \cdots & a_{mn}B\end{pmatrix}
formulas.note: Kronecker 积的分块定义：$A$ 为 $m\times n$、$B$ 为 $p\times q$ 时，$A\otimes B$ 是 $mp\times nq$ 矩阵，逐块看就是「用 $A$ 的每个元素缩放整个 $B$」。
formulas.noteEn: Block definition of the Kronecker product: for $A$ of size $m\times n$ and $B$ of size $p\times q$, the result $A\otimes B$ has size $mp\times nq$, each block being $B$ scaled by an entry of $A$.

formulas.latex: (A\otimes B)(C\otimes D)=(AC)\otimes(BD),\qquad (A\otimes B)^{-1}=A^{-1}\otimes B^{-1},\qquad (A\otimes B)^{\mathsf T}=A^{\mathsf T}\otimes B^{\mathsf T}
formulas.note: 混合积公式（要求 $AC$ 与 $BD$ 都有意义）、逆与转置都逐因子处理；另有 $\operatorname{tr}(A\otimes B)=\operatorname{tr}(A)\operatorname{tr}(B)$。注意 $A\otimes B\ne B\otimes A$，它们只是置换相似。
formulas.noteEn: Mixed-product rule (valid when $AC$ and $BD$ make sense), with inverses and transposes taken factorwise; also $\operatorname{tr}(A\otimes B)=\operatorname{tr}(A)\operatorname{tr}(B)$. Beware that $A\otimes B\ne B\otimes A$ in general; the two are only permutation-similar.

formulas.latex: \det(A\otimes B)=(\det A)^{q}(\det B)^{p}\quad (A\in M_p,\ B\in M_q),\qquad \sigma(A\otimes B)=\{\lambda_i\mu_j\},\qquad \sigma(A\otimes I+I\otimes B)=\{\lambda_i+\mu_j\}
formulas.note: 行列式的指数最容易记反：$A$ 是 $p\times p$，所以 $B$ 的指数是 $p$（即 $\det(A\otimes B)=\det(B\otimes A)$）。特征值成对相乘；而 $A\otimes I+I\otimes B$ 的特征值是成对相加，这正是 Sylvester 方程可解判据的来源。
formulas.noteEn: The exponents are the classic trap: since $A$ is $p\times p$, the exponent attached to $\det B$ is $p$ (equivalently $\det(A\otimes B)=\det(B\otimes A)$). Eigenvalues multiply in pairs, while those of $A\otimes I+I\otimes B$ add in pairs — the source of the Sylvester solvability criterion.

formulas.note: vec 按列拉直；$B$ 要转置后放到左边，转置与顺序都不能动。$X\mapsto AX+XB$ 因此化归为 $mn$ 阶系数矩阵 $I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m$ 的可逆性问题。
formulas.noteEn: The vec operator flattens column by column, and $B$ must be transposed and placed on the left — neither the transpose nor the order may be changed. This turns $X\mapsto AX+XB$ into the invertibility question for the $mn\times mn$ matrix $I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m$.

formulas.latex: A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q:\quad \text{唯一解}\iff \lambda_i+\bar\lambda_j\ne 0\ \ \forall i,j;\qquad A\ \text{稳定}\ \Longrightarrow\ X=-\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt
formulas.note: 本文采用的 Lyapunov 约定。$A$ 稳定时对任意 $Q$ 唯一可解（实部全负保证两两之和实部为负，不会为 0），解的积分表示中带负号；若方程写成 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$，该积分不带负号。
formulas.noteEn: Our Lyapunov convention. If $A$ is stable there is a unique solution for every $Q$ (negative real parts make every pairwise sum have negative real part, hence nonzero), and the integral carries a minus sign; for the equivalent form $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$ the same integral has no minus sign.

properties: Kronecker 积不交换，但 $A\otimes B$ 与 $B\otimes A$ 只差一个置换相似，因此行列式与特征值（含重数）完全相同：$\sigma(A\otimes B)=\sigma(B\otimes A)=\{\lambda_i\mu_j\}$。

Sylvester 方程 $AX+XB=C$ 对每个 $C$ 有唯一解 $\iff$ $A$ 与 $-B$ 无公共特征值 $\iff$ $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)\ne 0$ $\iff$ 算子 $X\mapsto AX+XB$ 可逆；此时 $\operatorname{vec}(X)=(I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m)^{-1}\operatorname{vec}(C)$。
Lyapunov 定理：$A$ 稳定 $\iff$ 对任意 $Q\succ0$，方程 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$ 有唯一正定解，且该解为 $X=\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt$。按本文约定 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ 则写作 $Q\prec0$ 时 $X\succ0$。
$Q$ Hermite 时解 $X$ 也 Hermite：对 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ 取共轭转置得 $A^{\mathsf H}X^{\mathsf H}+X^{\mathsf H}A=Q$，由唯一性 $X^{\mathsf H}=X$。解还是 $Q$ 的线性函数，可解时 $Q\mapsto X$ 是线性同构。

两个易错点：行列式公式的指数（$A$ 为 $p\times p$、$B$ 为 $q\times q$ 时 $\det(A\otimes B)=(\det A)^{q}(\det B)^{p}$）与 vec 公式的顺序（是 $B^{\mathsf T}\otimes A$ 而不是 $A\otimes B^{\mathsf T}$）；对 $A\otimes I+I\otimes B$ 求特征值时必须确认 $A$、$B$ 的尺寸。
propertiesEn: The Kronecker product is not commutative, but $A\otimes B$ and $B\otimes A$ differ only by a permutation similarity, so they have the same determinant and the same eigenvalues with multiplicities: $\sigma(A\otimes B)=\sigma(B\otimes A)=\{\lambda_i\mu_j\}$.

The Sylvester equation $AX+XB=C$ has a unique solution for every $C$ $\iff$ $A$ and $-B$ have no common eigenvalue $\iff$ $\lambda_i(A)+\mu_j(B)\ne 0$ $\iff$ the operator $X\mapsto AX+XB$ is invertible; then $\operatorname{vec}(X)=(I_n\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_m)^{-1}\operatorname{vec}(C)$.

Lyapunov's theorem: $A$ is stable $\iff$ for every $Q\succ0$ the equation $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA+Q=0$ has a unique positive definite solution, namely $X=\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt$. In our convention $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ the same statement reads: $Q\prec0$ implies $X\succ0$.

If $Q$ is Hermitian then so is the solution $X$: taking conjugate transposes in $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ gives $A^{\mathsf H}X^{\mathsf H}+X^{\mathsf H}A=Q$, and uniqueness forces $X^{\mathsf H}=X$. The solution is also a linear function of $Q$, so $Q\mapsto X$ is a linear isomorphism whenever the equation is uniquely solvable.

Two perennial slips: the exponents in the determinant formula ($\det(A\otimes B)=(\det A)^{q}(\det B)^{p}$ for $A$ of size $p\times p$ and $B$ of size $q\times q$) and the order in the vec identity (it is $B^{\mathsf T}\otimes A$, not $A\otimes B^{\mathsf T}$); when computing eigenvalues of $A\otimes I+I\otimes B$, always double-check the sizes.

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$、$B=\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\0&4\end{pmatrix}$、$C=I_2$。解 Sylvester 方程 $AX+XB=C$ 并代回验证。
examples.solution:
先看可解性：$A$ 的特征值为 $1,2$，$B$ 的特征值为 $3,4$，于是 $-B$ 的特征值为 $-3,-4$，与 $A$ 没有公共特征值，故唯一解存在。
设 $X=\begin{pmatrix}x_{11}&x_{12}\\x_{21}&x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$，直接展开：$AX=\begin{pmatrix}x_{11}&x_{12}\\2x_{21}&2x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$，$XB=\begin{pmatrix}3x_{11}&x_{11}+4x_{12}\\3x_{21}&x_{21}+4x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$，相加得 $AX+XB=\begin{pmatrix}4x_{11}&x_{11}+5x_{12}\\5x_{21}&x_{21}+6x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$。
令其等于 $I_2$，逐元素解：$4x_{11}=1\Rightarrow x_{11}=\tfrac14$；$x_{11}+5x_{12}=0\Rightarrow x_{12}=-\tfrac{1}{20}$；$5x_{21}=0\Rightarrow x_{21}=0$；$x_{21}+6x_{22}=1\Rightarrow x_{22}=\tfrac16$。
所以 $X=\begin{pmatrix}\tfrac14&-\tfrac{1}{20}\\0&\tfrac16\end{pmatrix}$。
代回：$AX=\begin{pmatrix}\tfrac14&-\tfrac{1}{20}\\0&\tfrac13\end{pmatrix}$，$XB=\begin{pmatrix}\tfrac34&\tfrac14-\tfrac15\\0&\tfrac23\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}\tfrac34&\tfrac{1}{20}\\0&\tfrac23\end{pmatrix}$，两者相加 $=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}=I_2$ ✓。
Kronecker 形式核对：$A$ 与 $B$ 的特征值两两之和为 $1+3=4$、$1+4=5$、$2+3=5$、$2+4=6$，均非零，故 $I_2\otimes A+B^{\mathsf T}\otimes I_2$ 的行列式为 $4\cdot5\cdot5\cdot6=600\ne0$，与唯一可解一致。

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}-1&0\\0&-2\end{pmatrix}$，按约定 $A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=Q$ 取 $Q=-I_2$，求解并验证；用积分表示核对，并判明 $X$ 的正定性。
examples.solution:
$A$ 是实对称矩阵，特征值 $-1,-2$ 的实部都为负，故 $A$ 稳定，唯一解存在。设 $X=\begin{pmatrix}x_{11}&x_{12}\\x_{21}&x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$。由于 $A^{\mathsf H}=A=\operatorname{diag}(-1,-2)$，有 $A^{\mathsf H}X=\begin{pmatrix}-x_{11}&-x_{12}\\-2x_{21}&-2x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$，$XA=\begin{pmatrix}-x_{11}&-2x_{12}\\-x_{21}&-2x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$，相加得 $\begin{pmatrix}-2x_{11}&-3x_{12}\\-3x_{21}&-4x_{22}\end{pmatrix}$。
令其等于 $Q=-I_2$：$-2x_{11}=-1\Rightarrow x_{11}=\tfrac12$；$-4x_{22}=-1\Rightarrow x_{22}=\tfrac14$；$-3x_{12}=0$、$-3x_{21}=0\Rightarrow x_{12}=x_{21}=0$。于是 $X=\operatorname{diag}(\tfrac12,\tfrac14)\succ0$ 正定（与 $Q=-I_2\prec0$、$A$ 稳定时解正定的结论一致）。
积分核对：按约定 $X=-\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}Qe^{At}\,dt=\int_0^\infty e^{A^{\mathsf H}t}(-Q)e^{At}\,dt=\int_0^\infty e^{2At}\,dt=\operatorname{diag}\left(\int_0^\infty e^{-2t}\,dt,\ \int_0^\infty e^{-4t}\,dt\right)=\operatorname{diag}(\tfrac12,\tfrac14)$ ✓（用了 $e^{At}=\operatorname{diag}(e^{-t},e^{-2t})$）。
代回验证：$A^{\mathsf H}X+XA=\operatorname{diag}(-\tfrac12,-\tfrac12)+\operatorname{diag}(-\tfrac12,-\tfrac12)=\operatorname{diag}(-1,-1)=-I_2=Q$ ✓。

nonnegative-matrices.definition:
**非负矩阵**指每个元素都 $\ge 0$ 的实矩阵，记作 $A\ge 0$；若每个元素都严格大于 0 则记作 $A>0$。对实方阵定义**谱半径** $\rho(A)=\max_i|\lambda_i|$，即所有特征值模长的最大值。非负矩阵的特殊之处在于：它的谱半径总是被特征值取到，而且取到的方式可以逐元素验证——这就是 Perron–Frobenius 定理的内容。

**Perron–Frobenius 定理（基础形式）**：若 $A\ge0$ 且 $A\ne0$，则 $\rho(A)$ 是 $A$ 的特征值，并且存在非零的非负向量 $x\ge0$ 使 $Ax=\rho(A)x$。若 $A$ 还是**不可约**的（例如 $A>0$，或对应的有向图强连通），结论加强为：$\rho(A)>0$，特征向量可取成严格正向量 $x>0$，且在不计正倍数下唯一，$\rho(A)$ 作为特征值是单重的。若 $A$ 还是**本原**的（存在 $k\ge1$ 使 $A^k>0$），则更强：$\rho(A)$ 是唯一模长为 $\rho(A)$ 的特征值，其余特征值全部满足 $|\lambda|<\rho(A)$。

这一定理把抽象的谱信息变成了可以逐元素检验的事实，因此出现在 Markov 链（行随机矩阵必有特征值 1）、投入产出模型、数值迭代与 PageRank 里。要注意方向：对**行随机**矩阵（每行和为 1），全 1 向量是**右**特征向量；对**列随机**矩阵，全 1 向量是**左**特征向量，两者对应不同的对象，混用是最常见的错误。

必须强调，「$\rho(A)$ 必是特征值」是**非负矩阵独有的性质**，不能向一般实矩阵推广：例如平面旋转 $90^\circ$ 的矩阵特征值为 $\pm i$，$\rho=1$ 却不是特征值。一般矩阵永远只有 $|\lambda|\le\rho(A)$，等号能否取到完全取决于结构。
nonnegative-matrices.definitionEn:
A **nonnegative matrix** is a real matrix all of whose entries are $\ge 0$, written $A\ge 0$; if every entry is strictly positive we write $A>0$. The **spectral radius** of a square matrix is $\rho(A)=\max_i|\lambda_i|$, the largest modulus of an eigenvalue. What makes nonnegative matrices special is that their spectral radius is always attained by an eigenvalue, and the attaining eigenvector can be taken entrywise nonnegative — the content of the Perron–Frobenius theorem.

**Perron–Frobenius (basic form).** If $A\ge0$ and $A\ne0$, then $\rho(A)$ is an eigenvalue of $A$ and there is a nonzero nonnegative vector $x\ge0$ with $Ax=\rho(A)x$. If moreover $A$ is **irreducible** (for instance $A>0$, or the associated directed graph is strongly connected), the conclusion sharpens: $\rho(A)>0$, the eigenvector can be taken strictly positive, it is unique up to a positive multiple, and $\rho(A)$ is a simple eigenvalue. If $A$ is in addition **primitive** (some power $A^k$ is strictly positive), then $\rho(A)$ is the only eigenvalue of modulus $\rho(A)$, all others satisfying $|\lambda|<\rho(A)$.

The theorem converts abstract spectral information into entrywise verifiable facts, which is why it appears in Markov chains (a row-stochastic matrix always has eigenvalue $1$), input–output economics, numerical iteration and PageRank. Beware of the direction: for a **row-stochastic** matrix (rows summing to $1$) the all-ones vector is a **right** eigenvector; for a **column-stochastic** matrix the all-ones vector is a **left** eigenvector. The two directions refer to different objects, and mixing them is the most common slip.

One must stress that 「$\rho(A)$ is an eigenvalue」 is a property **special to nonnegative matrices** and does not extend to general real matrices: the $90^\circ$ rotation has eigenvalues $\pm i$, yet $\rho=1$ is not an eigenvalue. For a general matrix one only knows $|\lambda|\le\rho(A)$, and whether equality is attained depends entirely on the structure.
derivation: 非负矩阵指每个元素都 $\ge0$ 的实矩阵，记 $A\ge0$；所有元素严格大于 $0$ 记 $A>0$。谱半径 $\rho(A)=\max_i|\lambda_i|$，其中 $\lambda_i$ 取遍 $A$ 的复特征值。对任意实方阵都有 $|\lambda|\le\rho(A)$，但 $\rho(A)$ 本身未必是特征值：逆时针旋转 $90^\circ$ 的矩阵 $\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ 特征值为 $\pm i$，$\rho=1$ 不是特征值（尽管 $|\pm i|=1$）。非负性正是排除这种情形的关键结构条件。

Perron–Frobenius（基础形式）：若 $A\ge0$ 且 $A\ne0$，则 $\rho(A)$ 是 $A$ 的特征值，且存在 $x\ge0$、$x\ne0$ 使 $Ax=\rho(A)x$。证明思路：对 $\varepsilon>0$ 令 $A_\varepsilon=A+\varepsilon E$，其中 $E$ 为全 $1$ 矩阵，则 $A_\varepsilon>0$。正矩阵的 Perron 定理（可由 Brouwer 不动点定理证明）给出 $x_\varepsilon>0$、$\|x_\varepsilon\|_1=1$ 与 $A_\varepsilon x_\varepsilon=\rho(A_\varepsilon)x_\varepsilon$。由谱半径对元素的连续性，$\rho(A_\varepsilon)\to\rho(A)$；单位球面紧，取子列 $x_\varepsilon\to x\ge0$，$\|x\|_1=1$。令 $\varepsilon\to0$，得 $Ax=\rho(A)x$，故 $\rho(A)$ 是特征值。

在 $A\ge0$、$A\ne0$ 的前提下，若 $A$ 不可约（不存在置换矩阵 $P$ 使 $P^{\mathsf T}AP=\begin{pmatrix}A_{11}&A_{12}\\0&A_{22}\end{pmatrix}$ 分成两个非空对角块；等价地，关联有向图强连通），则 $\rho(A)>0$，Perron 向量可取严格正 $x>0$，且在不计正倍数下唯一，$\rho(A)$ 是单特征值。正性来自连通性：若 $x\ge0$、$Ax=\rho x$ 且某个 $x_i>0$，则对每个 $j$ 存在 $k$ 使 $(A^k)_{ji}>0$，于是 $\rho^k x_j=(A^kx)_j\ge(A^k)_{ji}x_i>0$；唯一性：设 $x,y>0$ 都是对应于 $\rho$ 的特征向量，取 $t=\min_j x_j/y_j$，则 $z=x-ty\ge0$ 且某分量为 $0$；若 $z\ne0$，由上述正性论证得 $z>0$，矛盾，故 $z=0$。单性（代数重数 $1$）是定理的加强部分，标准证明通过预解式 $(zI-A)^{-1}$ 在 $z=\rho$ 处的单极点。

本原：存在 $k\ge1$ 使 $A^k>0$。若 $A\ge0$ 本原，则 $\rho(A)$ 是唯一模长为 $\rho(A)$ 的特征值，其余特征值满足 $|\lambda|<\rho(A)$。理由：不可约非负矩阵的周边谱（模长等于 $\rho$ 的特征值）由 $\rho e^{2\pi ij/h}$（$j=0,\dots,h-1$）组成，共有 $h$ 个点，$h$ 称为周期；若 $h>1$，则 $A^k$ 的周边谱仍有 $h$ 个点（计重数）：当 $h\nmid k$ 时，模长 $\rho^k$ 的特征值不止一个；当 $h\mid k$ 时，$\rho^k$ 的重数至少为 $h$。两种情形都与 $A^k>0$ 的正矩阵 Perron 定理（唯一且单重）矛盾，故 $h=1$。本原性是充分条件；在不可约情形它其实等价于周边谱只有一个点。若去掉不可约性，本原性不是必要的：$\operatorname{diag}(1,0)$ 不是本原的，却只有唯一模长最大的特征值 $1$。不可约但非本原的例子是置换矩阵 $\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$，其特征值 $1,-1$ 的模长都等于 $\rho=1$。

例：$A=\begin{pmatrix}0&2\\3&1\end{pmatrix}$。特征多项式 $\lambda^2-\lambda-6=(\lambda-3)(\lambda+2)$，特征值 $3,-2$，故 $\rho(A)=3$。解 $(A-3I)x=0$：$-3x_1+2x_2=0$，取 $x=(2,3)^{\mathsf T}\ge0$，验证 $A(2,3)^{\mathsf T}=(6,9)^{\mathsf T}=3(2,3)^{\mathsf T}$。$A$ 的有向图强连通（$1\leftrightarrow2$，且有 $2\to2$ 的环），故不可约；$A^2=\begin{pmatrix}6&2\\3&7\end{pmatrix}>0$，故本原。于是 $\rho=3$ 是单特征值，Perron 向量严格正且在不计正倍数下唯一；另一特征值 $-2$ 满足 $|-2|=2<3$，符合本原情形的严格不等式。

应用与边界。行随机矩阵每行和为 $1$，故 $A\boldsymbol 1=\boldsymbol 1$，$\rho(A)=1$；列随机矩阵则是 $\boldsymbol 1^{\mathsf T}A=\boldsymbol 1^{\mathsf T}$，全 $1$ 向量是左特征向量。不可约行随机矩阵的平稳分布唯一，它解左特征方程 $\pi^{\mathsf T}A=\pi^{\mathsf T}$，而不是右特征方程；方向不能混。单调性：$0\le B\le A$ 逐元素蕴含 $\rho(B)\le\rho(A)$。若 $A\ge0$ 本原，则 $\rho^{-k}A^k$ 收敛到秩一矩阵 $xy^{\mathsf T}$，其中 $Ax=\rho x$、$y^{\mathsf T}A=\rho y^{\mathsf T}$、$y^{\mathsf T}x=1$；并且 $A^k\to0\iff\rho(A)<1$。最后，「$\rho(A)$ 必是特征值」对非负矩阵成立，但不能推广到一般实矩阵（旋转 $90^\circ$ 的反例见第 1 步）。
derivationEn: A nonnegative matrix is a real matrix all of whose entries are $\ge0$, written $A\ge0$; if every entry is strictly positive we write $A>0$. The spectral radius is $\rho(A)=\max_i|\lambda_i|$, where $\lambda_i$ runs over the complex eigenvalues of $A$. Every real square matrix satisfies $|\lambda|\le\rho(A)$, but $\rho(A)$ itself need not be an eigenvalue: the matrix of a counterclockwise $90^\circ$ rotation, $\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$, has eigenvalues $\pm i$, and $\rho=1$ is not an eigenvalue (although $|\pm i|=1$). Nonnegativity is the key structural condition that rules out this behavior.

Perron–Frobenius (basic form): if $A\ge0$ and $A\ne0$, then $\rho(A)$ is an eigenvalue of $A$, and there is $x\ge0$, $x\ne0$ with $Ax=\rho(A)x$. Proof idea: for $\varepsilon>0$ let $A_\varepsilon=A+\varepsilon E$, where $E$ is the all-ones matrix, so $A_\varepsilon>0$. Perron's theorem for positive matrices (provable via Brouwer's fixed point theorem) gives $x_\varepsilon>0$, $\|x_\varepsilon\|_1=1$ and $A_\varepsilon x_\varepsilon=\rho(A_\varepsilon)x_\varepsilon$. Spectral radius is continuous in the entries, so $\rho(A_\varepsilon)\to\rho(A)$; the unit sphere is compact, so a subsequence $x_\varepsilon\to x\ge0$ with $\|x\|_1=1$ exists. Letting $\varepsilon\to0$ yields $Ax=\rho(A)x$, hence $\rho(A)$ is an eigenvalue.

Under $A\ge0$, $A\ne0$, if $A$ is irreducible (there is no permutation matrix $P$ with $P^{\mathsf T}AP=\begin{pmatrix}A_{11}&A_{12}\\0&A_{22}\end{pmatrix}$ split into two nonempty diagonal blocks; equivalently, the associated directed graph is strongly connected), then $\rho(A)>0$, the Perron vector can be taken strictly positive, $x>0$, it is unique up to a positive multiple, and $\rho(A)$ is a simple eigenvalue. Positivity comes from connectedness: if $x\ge0$, $Ax=\rho x$ and some $x_i>0$, then for each $j$ there is $k$ with $(A^k)_{ji}>0$, so $\rho^k x_j=(A^kx)_j\ge(A^k)_{ji}x_i>0$. For uniqueness, let $x,y>0$ be eigenvectors for $\rho$ and set $t=\min_j x_j/y_j$. Then $z=x-ty\ge0$ has a zero component; if $z\ne0$, the positivity argument above gives $z>0$, a contradiction, so $z=0$. Simplicity (algebraic multiplicity $1$) is the sharpened part of the theorem, and the standard proof uses the simple pole of the resolvent $(zI-A)^{-1}$ at $z=\rho$.

Primitive: some $k\ge1$ satisfies $A^k>0$. If $A\ge0$ is primitive, then $\rho(A)$ is the only eigenvalue of modulus $\rho(A)$, and every other eigenvalue satisfies $|\lambda|<\rho(A)$. Reason: the peripheral spectrum (eigenvalues of modulus $\rho$) of an irreducible nonnegative matrix consists of $\rho e^{2\pi ij/h}$ ($j=0,\dots,h-1$), so there are $h$ of them, and $h$ is called the period. If $h>1$, the peripheral spectrum of $A^k$ still has $h$ points counted with multiplicity: when $h\nmid k$ there is more than one eigenvalue of modulus $\rho^k$, and when $h\mid k$ the eigenvalue $\rho^k$ has multiplicity at least $h$.
